author: Michaelchan2024
body: 如果“拥有1000家赌场”真的如反对者所言是一个无法承受的泡沫，那么市场规律这只“看不见的手”早已发挥作用： · 激烈的竞争会自然淘汰效率低下、缺乏吸引力的赌场。 · 市场的饱和会阻止新资本的进入，并促使经营不善者退出。 · 经济周期的波动会清洗掉最脆弱的参与者。 因此，这个数字（1000家）本身并不值得恐慌。真正关键的是，这个数字背后所揭示的产业结构、市场适应性和经济规律。 🤣😂

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 所以...赌场的数量本身不是关键问题，它只是市场供需关系的自然结果。 如果赌场真的过多， 市场早就自我调整了...经营不善的会倒闭，总数会减少。 现在能维持这个数量，恰恰说明市场存在足够的需求，支撑着一个多元化、有竞争力的产业。 所以，重要的不是具体有多少家，而是这个数字背后所反映出的市场适应力和产业平衡。 🤣

Tioga Downs Casino Resort 这些赌场都能合法经营 真人荷官桌上游戏（live dealer table games）、老虎机（slots）、以及体育博彩（sports betting） 等完整项目。 --- 那为什么 Resorts World Catskills还不赚钱？ RWC 的确长期处于亏损状态... 原因主要有以下几点： --- 1)地理位置不利 RWC 位于纽约上州的 Monticello，离纽约市车程约 2 小时多。 → 地点偏远，交通不便。 → 冬季天气恶劣时更影响人流。 → 许多纽约客宁愿去大西洋城（Atlantic City）或康州的 Mohegan Sun、Foxwoods。 --- 2)市场饱和，竞争激烈 Upstate 地区已有几家赌场分布相对密集，再加上周边州份（如新泽西、宾夕法尼亚、康乃狄克）也有赌场，竞争异常激烈。 → 共享同一客源池（特别是纽约客与周边居民）。 → 很难吸引新赌客。 --- 3)运营初期债务庞大 Resorts World Catskills 是由 Genting Malaysia 及 Kien Huat 投资建立的高端度假赌场， 建设成本高达 约12亿美元。 → 高融资成本（利息支出庞大） → 前期折旧重 → 入不敷出。 --- 4)疫情后恢复缓慢 虽然旅游业恢复，但上州地区依然较冷清， RWC 的人流量远不及纽约市或拉斯维加斯。 → 即使收入恢复，仍不足以覆盖利息与营运成本。 --- 5)尚未受益于 Downstate 新牌照机会 RWC 的 sister property —— Resorts World New York City才是金矿所在， 若 RWNYC 拿到 Downstate 的 full licence， 它能开真人赌桌，利润潜力将远超上州的 RWC。

body: 纽约州上下两地(Upstate 与 Downstate)其实是整个云顶集团 Resorts World在美国市场战略布局的核心。 让我一步步拆解说明: --- 什么是纽约州上下两地？ 上州 Upstate New York: - 纽约市以北的广大地区（Hudson Valley、Catskills、Schenectady 等） 地广人少、以度假、自然风景、旅游为主 下州 Downstate New York - 包括纽约市（五大行政区：Manhattan, Queens, Brooklyn, Bronx, Staten Island）及周边 人口密集、经济中心、交通便利 --- 云顶集团的“上下联动布局”是什么？ 云顶旗下的 Resorts World 系列在纽约州，已经形成了一个 Upstate + Downstate 双核心战略佈局： 上州（Upstate): - Resorts World Catskills（凯茨基尔） - Resorts World Hudson Valley（哈德逊谷） - 有全牌照赌场（有真人荷官、桌面游戏） - 度假村、酒店、高尔夫球场、SPA、旅游目的地 下州（Downstate): - Resorts World New York City（RWNYC） - 位于纽约市皇后区，靠近JFK机场 - 目前为 VLT 类型（电子博彩机）， - 正申请升级为 full casino licence（全牌照）

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 上下联动战略的意义 云顶的思路不是“单点开花”，而是“上下呼应、资源互补”： 1)资金留在纽约州内部 > 下州赌场赚钱后，不让赌资外流，而是通过上州的设施再投资、再消费。 举例：RWNYC 提供 $70 million 激励，鼓励赌客去上州 Catskills 度假打球。 2) 形成“都市 + 度假”双市场 > 下州负责城市娱乐与便利体验； > 上州提供高端度假与旅游体验； 一进一出，满足不同客群。 3) 促进全州经济 > 不只是纽约市赚钱，上州也能因此获得人流、就业、税收。 这正是纽约州政府最希望看到的“共荣共赢”结构。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 为什么这对云顶是竞争优势？ 目前申请 Downstate 全牌照的竞争者（如 MGM、Caesars、Las Vegas Sands）： 大多只在 下州或外州 有业务； 很多与 新泽西 Atlantic City 有合作或投资； 利润可能流出纽约州。 而云顶不同： ✅ 在上州已有深厚基础（Catskills + Hudson Valley）； ✅ 在下州已有成熟运营（RWNYC）； ✅ 政府看到它能让全州受益，政治上最容易通过。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Apa conditional offer? Conditional → still negotiable / dependent on conditions What happens when the offer becomes Unconditional? An unconditional offer means: All conditions have been satisfied (here, Genting now owns 50.105% of GenM). The offer must be completed by law. Both the bidder (Genting) and the shareholders who agreed are now legally bound. Shareholders cannot reject the offer anymore. If some shareholders still refuse to sell, a Mandatory Offer or compulsory transfer mechanism kicks in. The deal cannot be “undone” or renegotiated based on dissenting shareholders.

body: 如果最終LKT得到75%以上的票，不过少过90%.. · 我们的票是不是就不能在市场上买卖？ · 不一定。 在这个阶段（例如75%-90%），收购要约通常仍在开放期内。股票理论上仍然可以在市场上交易。 · 但实际上，交易会变得非常困难且不活跃。 因为绝大多数股份已经被收购者锁定，市场上的流通股非常少，买卖价差可能会很大，很难找到买家。 可以说，流动性已经基本枯竭。

body: 建议: 1. 紧密关注公司公告：LKT必须就收购事宜发布详细的通函和公告，里面会包含所有关键信息：要约价格、要约期限、接受要约的方法等。这是您最重要的信息来源。 2. 在要约期内行动：最主动和稳妥的做法就是在要约截止日期前， 接受该收购要约。这是您保障自身权益、顺利套现的最佳方式。 3. 咨询您的股票经纪人：如果您对操作流程不熟悉，请立即联系您开户的证券行或经纪人。他们经常处理此类业务，可以为您提供具体的操作指导。 4. 不要指望市场交易：正如前面所说，在要约期间，公开市场的流动性极差， 通过市场卖出很可能不是个好选择。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Let’s make a realistic ownership trajectory for Genting Berhad (GenB) from 50% to 90% for Genting Malaysia (GenM), based on typical market behavior during a takeover. I’ll break it down step by step. --- Assumptions 1. Current ownership: 50.1% 2. Official RM2.35 offer closes: 24 Nov 2025 3. Typical acceptance rate for voluntary offers: 20–40% of remaining shares (varies by shareholder type: institutional vs retail) 4. Post-offer open market accumulation: gradual purchases, possibly 1–2% per month 5. Compulsory acquisition threshold: 90%

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Step 1: Offer Period (up to 24 Nov 2025) Current remaining shares held by other shareholders: 49.9% If 30% of them accept the offer: 49.9% × 30% ≈ 15% acquired Ownership rises: 50.1% + 15% ≈ 65% by 24 Nov 2025 > Realistically, 65–70% is typical if there’s strong interest, but reaching 90% is very unlikely by the closing date. --- Step 2: Post-Offer Open Market Purchases (late Nov 2025 – Jan 2026) GenB can continue buying via brokers at ≥ RM2.35 Assume they acquire 1–2% per month of the total shares: End of Dec 2025: ~67–68% End of Jan 2026: ~69–70% --- Step 3: Approaching Compulsory Acquisition (≥90%) GenB needs to acquire ~20–25% more shares to reach 90% Likely strategy: 1. Continue open market purchases gradually 2. Negotiate block purchases with large shareholders Realistically, 90% threshold could be reached by Feb–Mar 2026, depending on market liquidity and shareholder willingness. --- Step 4: Compulsory Acquisition and Delisting Once 90% is reached: GenB can force the remaining shareholders to sell Delisting of GenM occurs shortly after

body: A compelling read!!! A powerful perspective that changes how you see Genting Berhad 🇲🇾 GENTING BERHAD — ALIGNING WITH AMERICA’S NEXT GREAT ECONOMIC RENAISSANCE A Malaysian Powerhouse Poised to Ride the Next Wave of U.S. Growth When history rhymes, fortunes are made. Genting Berhad — Malaysia’s global entertainment and leisure conglomerate — is quietly positioning itself at the center of what may become the most lucrative international alignment of the decade: the revival of U.S. growth and pro-business policy under Donald Trump’s economic vision. While most regional corporations hesitate amid global uncertainty, Genting has been executing an audacious long-term plan — investing billions of dollars across America’s strategic entertainment and tourism corridors. This is not coincidence. It’s calculated alignment with a U.S. policy environment that rewards infrastructure, job creation, tourism, and hospitality — the very sectors Genting dominates. 🇺🇸 1️⃣ From the Strip to the Skyline — Building America’s Next Icons Genting Berhad has already proven its global calibre through Resorts World Las Vegas, a US$4.3 billion marvel that redefined the North Strip when it opened in 2021. Today, it stands as one of the largest integrated resorts ever built by an Asian company in the United States — a 3,500-room destination employing thousands of Americans and drawing millions of tourists annually. The project’s success did not go unnoticed in Washington. Genting’s ability to deliver a world-class asset during a period of global turbulence perfectly matched Trump’s long-standing emphasis on “Made in America jobs, built by global partners who believe in America.” Now, Genting is scaling that success to the East Coast. 🏙️ 2️⃣ The US$5.5 Billion New York Vision The next chapter unfolds in New York City, where Genting’s subsidiary — Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) — is preparing to invest US$5.5 billion in expanding its Queens property into a full-scale integrated casino resort, pending the state’s issuance of full gaming licenses. With MGM and Wynn having exited the race, Genting stands as a front-runner. The proposed expansion aligns perfectly with Trump-era priorities: Urban revitalization, transforming Queens into a tourism engine. Massive job creation, potentially exceeding 5,000 local hires. Infrastructure investment, strengthening U.S. capital inflows and construction. Such a move situates Genting not just as an operator but as a long-term stakeholder in America’s economic regeneration.

body: 🇲🇾 云顶集团——正与美国下一轮经济复兴浪潮完美接轨 马来西亚的全球劲旅，正准备迎接美国增长的新纪元 当历史再度押韵，财富就会重现。 云顶集团（Genting Berhad）——马来西亚最具全球影响力的娱乐与综合度假集团，正悄然站上未来十年最具潜力的国际经济交汇点：美国经济重启与亲商政策的再度崛起。 当许多企业仍因全球不确定性而犹豫观望时，云顶早已果断出击，以雄厚资本布局美国最具战略价值的娱乐与旅游中心。这并非巧合，而是精准的战略——顺应一个奖励基建投资、创造就业与推动旅游业的政策环境，而这些，正是云顶的核心强项。 🇺🇸 1️⃣ 从赌城大道到天际线——打造美国新地标 云顶早已凭借 耗资43亿美元的拉斯维加斯名胜世界（Resorts World Las Vegas） 展现其世界级实力。 自2021年开业以来，这座度假城不仅重塑了北拉斯维加斯大道的格局，也成为亚洲企业在美国投资的最大单体项目之一——拥有3,500间客房、数以千计的本地员工，每年吸引数百万名旅客。 这一成功引起了华盛顿的关注。 云顶能在全球动荡时期完成如此宏伟工程，完美契合特朗普长期倡导的理念： > “在美国创造就业，由信任美国的全球伙伴共同建设。” 如今，云顶正把这一成功模式延伸至美国东岸。 🏙️ 2️⃣ 纽约55亿美元蓝图 下一章在纽约展开。 云顶旗下的 Resorts World New York City（RWNYC） 正计划投资 55亿美元 扩建皇后区度假综合体，打造东岸首个完整赌场度假村（正等待州政府发放全面赌场执照）。 在MGM与永利集团退出竞争后，云顶成为最有力的竞标者。 这一计划完美契合特朗普时代的经济优先方向： 城市复兴：将皇后区打造成旅游新引擎。 创造就业：预计将新增超过5,000个本地岗位。 基建投入：强化美国资本流入与建筑产业链。 云顶不只是经营者，而是美国经济重建的长期合作伙伴。 🌴 3️⃣ 从拉斯维加斯到加勒比海——云顶的美洲版图 极少有马来西亚企业能在美国拥有如此多元的布局。云顶的战略资产包括： 迈阿密黄金海岸地块，未来有潜力发展为大型度假或合作项目； 巴哈马比米尼名胜世界（Resorts World Bimini），连接佛罗里达与加勒比海的奢华度假胜地。 这些投资体现了“特朗普式”的投资哲学——高影响力、重就业、促旅游的全球资本模式。 🏛️ 4️⃣ 政治与外交优势 在特朗普阵营重掌经济政策的背景下，凡能直接创造美国就业、发展房地产与振兴旅游业的外资企业，均将获得政策与监管层面的善意。 云顶的数十亿美元投资，正是国际社会对美国经济信心的象征。 从地缘角度看，这同样是马来西亚的外交资产。 云顶在美国的扩张，已成为马来西亚企业实力与信誉的代表，提升了马国在全球投资者眼中的形象，也成为政府引以为傲的国际名片。 💼 5️⃣ 投资者为何必须关注云顶 对于希望同时布局美国增长与马来西亚稳健经济的投资者而言，云顶集团提供了独一无二的机会： 推动因素 优势描述 特朗普式亲商政策 促进就业、基建与旅游业的政策直接利好云顶在美项目。 全球旅游复苏 疫后旅游潮与2026年世界杯将推动拉斯维加斯、纽约及迈阿密客流飙升。 资产重估潜力 全球资产重估后每股净值或超过 RM13.80。 潜在私有化催化 云顶大马若被整合入母公司，股东价值有望全面释放。 ✨ 6️⃣ 沉睡巨人苏醒 云顶集团不只是投资赌场，而是在重塑美国经济复兴的商业结构。 当全球资本重回基建、休闲与旅游主导的时代，云顶的美国布局正好位于“愿景、时机与政策”三者交汇的黄金点。 对马来西亚而言，云顶的国际成功不仅带来国家荣耀，也加强了与美国的双边关系，成为马来西亚企业走向全球的象征。 🏆 结语 > 在每一次经济周期中，总有一家公司领先大众，看见未来的浪潮—— 云顶集团正是当下的那一家。 它与美国经济政策的战略契合、卓越的执行力与长期远见，使其成为亚洲最被低估、却最具潜力的全球巨擘之一。 💬 这是一篇引人入胜的深度专文，一种能彻底改变投资者看待云顶集团的强大视角。

body: Let’s make a realistic ownership trajectory for Genting Berhad (GenB) from 50% to 90% for Genting Malaysia (GenM), based on typical market behavior during a takeover. I’ll break it down step by step. --- Assumptions 1. Current ownership: 50.1% 2. Official RM2.35 offer closes: 24 Nov 2025 3. Typical acceptance rate for voluntary offers: 20–40% of remaining shares (varies by shareholder type: institutional vs retail) 4. Post-offer open market accumulation: gradual purchases, possibly 1–2% per month 5. Compulsory acquisition threshold: 90%

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Step 1: Offer Period (up to 24 Nov 2025) Current remaining shares held by other shareholders: 49.9% If 30% of them accept the offer: 49.9% × 30% ≈ 15% acquired Ownership rises: 50.1% + 15% ≈ 65% by 24 Nov 2025 > Realistically, 65–70% is typical if there’s strong interest, but reaching 90% is very unlikely by the closing date. --- Step 2: Post-Offer Open Market Purchases (late Nov 2025 – Jan 2026) GenB can continue buying via brokers at ≥ RM2.35 Assume they acquire 1–2% per month of the total shares: End of Dec 2025: ~67–68% End of Jan 2026: ~69–70% --- Step 3: Approaching Compulsory Acquisition (≥90%) GenB needs to acquire ~20–25% more shares to reach 90% Likely strategy: 1. Continue open market purchases gradually 2. Negotiate block purchases with large shareholders Realistically, 90% threshold could be reached by Feb–Mar 2026, depending on market liquidity and shareholder willingness. --- Step 4: Compulsory Acquisition and Delisting Once 90% is reached: GenB can force the remaining shareholders to sell Delisting of GenM occurs shortly after

author: RInvest
body: Who Are These “Sell Now at RM2.35” Posters? When you see many accounts or forum users saying things like “Just accept the offer lah, delist sure one,” or “After delist cannot sell already, better take RM2.35,” Broker/Dealer-Linked:- Want retail to sell for easier transaction flow. Some brokers earn handling fees for manual tender or offloading shares. Often post “informative” instructions about submission forms, deadlines, etc. Institutional or Paid PR Accounts :- Sometimes companies or related parties seed messages to encourage tender acceptance. Not illegal if general, but unethical if pretending to be independent investors. Repeat identical narratives across platforms, always pro-offer, avoid discussing undervaluation. Retail Traders (Scared or Herd Mentality):- Genuinely believe delisting = total loss, so they panic-sell and tell others. Emotional tone, not coordinated but amplifies the same fear. some of those “sell now” messages could be influenced or hired, especially if the pattern looks coordinated or identical across multiple forums (e.g., Lowyat, i3investor, Reddit MalaysiaInvest). Watch for these red flags: Many new or inactive accounts suddenly posting “accept la, don’t be hero” within short time. Copy-paste paragraphs about deadlines or same justification (“delist already cannot sell anymore, useless”). Avoid engaging when you bring up fair valuation, casino licence, or RWNYC project value. Use psychological tactics: fear of missing deadline, fear of losing everything. That’s textbook social sentiment steering — done subtly to push retail holders to accept lowball takeovers. Why Genting Would Benefit From Such Influence If more minorities accept at RM 2.35, GENT can: Cross 75% threshold → delist easily. Possibly reach 90% → compulsory acquisition → full privatization. Save billions in undervalued equity, since GENM’s book value per share ≈ RM 3.20–3.40. So, yes — it’s financially rational for GENT (or intermediaries acting in their favor) to encourage acceptance. Even a small percentage swing in retail participation can tip them over 75%. What You Should Do Don’t rely on forum chatter. Read the Offer Document, Independent Adviser’s Opinion (IA report), and Bursa filings only. Wait for IA conclusion. If IA says “Not fair but reasonable,” it often means undervalued — holding may be smarter. Remember: if offer fails (<75%), share price often rebounds afterward. author: Michaelchan2024
body: Logical sequencing... why the takeover must come first? GenB must first gain full or near-total control of GenM. Otherwise, it can’t legally or efficiently move GenM’s US assets (Empire/RWNYC) into GenUS. With full control, Genting can restructure internally without needing minority approval or risking conflict of interest. Hence: The buying of GenM is a prerequisite to the restructuring efforts mentioned in the Offer Doc.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Step-by-step chain of events Phase: Takeover Offer (Oct 2025) Description: GenB offers to buy all GenM shares at RM2.35 Purpose: Consolidate ownership Phase: Post-offer (2025–2026) Description: GenB reaches >90% ownership (likely triggers delisting) Purpose: Full control of GenM Phase: Internal Restructuring (2026) Description: Combine GenM’s US assets (RWNYC, Empire) with GenB’s RWLV under a new US holding — GenUS Purpose: Create unified US gaming platform Phase: US Listing (2027) Description: GenUS IPO / listing on Nasdaq or NYSE Purpose: Unlock value, raise funds, expand presence So the GenB → GenM buyout is not only implied — it’s essential to make the GenUS plan work. Without it, Genting couldn’t freely combine the two groups’ assets.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: So in short: 2025–2026 = preparation & restructuring 2027 = US listing & value explosion 2028+ = sustainable global expansion

author: alenac
body: No listing plan only intention to list with "Ifss" , any company can say that. Yes — there are publicly-available documents and disclosures from Genting Berhad (“Genting”) and its U.S. subsidiary Resorts World Las Vegas LLC (“RWLV”) that touch on the topic of a potential U.S. listing, but no definitive roadmap or fixed timeline for a listing has been publicly committed. Below is a summary of what the documentation reveals, and how strong the listing case appears. ✅ What the documents say about U.S. listing intentions In a report titled “Special Report: Genting details VGO rationale, plans for Las Vegas and Singapore operations” (Oct 2025), Genting responded to media queries and stated: “At the same time … it is constantly reviewing the consolidation of its US operations … Still, Genting has no plan to list Resorts World Las Vegas in the immediate term …” KLSE Screener +1 This comes from a direct response by the company, indicating listing is under review, but not immediate. Another disclosure: Genting’s management (President & COO) noted at an AGM that: “Listing in the United States can unlock shareholder value … We will obviously pay attention to this matter, but we also need to observe the environment in the U.S., and it will depend on the situation.” IAG +1 This shows that U.S. listing remains part of strategy (“keen on US listing”) but subject to market/regulatory conditions. In the RWLV‐related filings, the focus is primarily on debt issuance, refinancing and credit facilities rather than direct listing documents. For example: RWLV issued US$1 billion senior notes (4.625% due 2029) in 2019 to fund the resort. IAG +1 RWLV’s 2023 offering of US$400 million senior notes (8.45% due 2030) was detailed in a document, showing RWLV as a financing entity. Malay Mail +1 These show solid capital market activity, but not listing plans per se.

body: Jim Murren, the chairman of the Authority, has stepped in as interim CEO, taking on the role immediately. In his statement, Murren recognized the significant impact Mullally had on the organization, noting his vital role in developing the Authority’s governance and regulatory framework. As Murren takes the helm, he emphasized that the GCGRA will continue to focus on its next phase of growth. He reiterated the agency’s dedication to regulatory excellence, promoting responsible gaming, and ensuring public trust in the UAE’s approach to overseeing commercial gaming. Major changes for the UAE gambling industry The leadership transition at the GCGRA comes alongside the appointment of Jennifer Carleton as the new chief of licensing and investigations. This change is part of the regulator’s broader strategy to enhance its licensing framework for both land-based and online gaming operations. The GCGRA aims to implement a licensing model that allocates one online B2C gambling license per emirate, mirroring the existing “one license per emirate” approach used for land-based casinos. Currently, Wynn Resorts Limited holds the only land-based license in the UAE, located in Ras Al Khaimah. Industry reports indicate that Abu Dhabi may soon receive approval for its own land-based casino license, while only two or three emirates are expected to initially advance with online operator licenses. Additionally, the regulator has already issued vendor licenses for B2B suppliers as part of its phased rollout of regulations.

author: Michael Lee
body: 1️⃣ Ringgit Strengthening to RM 4.17 per USD — GOOD NEWS Genting Berhad holds USD-denominated debt, especially for Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV). When the Ringgit strengthens, the value of that USD debt shrinks in Ringgit terms. → Lower reported gearing, lower interest expense in Ringgit. It also boosts the group’s net-asset position (RM debt looks smaller vs USD assets). ✅ Net impact: Stronger Ringgit = lower leverage + healthier balance sheet = POSITIVE. 2️⃣ US Federal Reserve Rate Cut — GOOD NEWS Genting Berhad’s USD loans (especially in the U.S.) are often floating-rate linked to LIBOR/SOFR. → When Fed cuts rates, Genting’s interest burden drops immediately. Lower U.S. rates also: Stimulate travel, consumption and gaming spend in the U.S. (helping RWLV). Support global equity sentiment and tourism recovery. Improve asset valuations (esp. for its large U.S. property and resort assets). ✅ Net impact: Cheaper financing + stronger visitor spending = POSITIVE. 🎯 Conclusion > Genting Berhad enjoys two independent tailwinds: ① Ringgit appreciation (balance-sheet benefit) ② Fed rate cut (financing & demand benefit) Together, these form a double good-news catalyst for Genting Berhad’s earnings outlook and valuation.

author: Michael Lee
body: Take a look at.... USD/MYR rate of ~ 1 USD = MYR 4.159637 and assuming the rate moves from a weaker MYR (say USD = MYR 4.30) to the stronger rate, we can estimate potential savings/gains for USD-denominated debt. GENM Estimate If GENM has USD 2.89 billion long‐term debt: At USD = MYR 4.30 → MYR equivalent = 2.89 billion × 4.30 = MYR 12.427 billion At USD = MYR 4.159637 → MYR equivalent = 2.89 billion × 4.159637 = MYR 12.030 billion Difference = ~ MYR 397 million So because of the rate move, GENM could have ~ MYR ≈ 400 million reduction in the MYR equivalent debt cost (or potential translation benefit) assuming all debt is USD and no hedging etc. Given they already posted ~RM 601.8 million gain in one quarter, this ballpark seems reasonable. Genting Berhad Estimate If Genting Berhad has USD 9.05 billion debt: At 4.30 rate → MYR 9.05b × 4.30 = MYR 38.915 billion At 4.159637 rate → MYR 9.05b × 4.159637 = MYR 37.639 billion Difference = ~ MYR 1.276 billion So for the parent company, the beneficial impact from the rate move could be around MYR ≈ 1.3 billion in favourable translation/servicing cost terms. ✅ Summary GENM: ~ MYR 400 million potential gain from rate movement under the assumptions. Genting Berhad: ~ MYR 1.3 billion potential gain under similar assumptions.

author: Michael Lee
body: Good analysis.... USD weakening (MYR strengthening) is one gain for Genting Berhad & Genting Malaysia Berhad — but the U.S. Federal Reserve cutting interest rates brings an additional, direct financial benefit, because both groups have large USD-denominated floating-rate loans. Let’s combine both effects clearly 👇 🇺🇸 1️⃣ Effect #1 — USD → MYR Strengthening (Already Covered) Company USD-Denominated Debt (est.) Rate move 4.30 → 4.16 MYR Translation Gain (≈) Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) USD 2.89 b -3.26 % MYR move ~ RM 397 million Genting Berhad (Parent) USD 9.05 b -3.26 % MYR move ~ RM 1.28 billion These gains are one-off paper or balance-sheet translation benefits (FX revaluation). 🇺🇸 2️⃣ Effect #2 — U.S. Fed Rate Cuts × 3 → Interest Savings Assume: Total USD borrowings (as above). Average interest margin = SOFR + spread (≈ 6 % → 5 % after 3 cuts of 0.25 % each). That means an average 0.75 % interest-rate reduction on floating USD debt. 🔹 Genting Malaysia Berhad USD 2.89 b × 0.75 % = USD 21.7 million annual interest saved → × 4.16 MYR/USD ≈ RM 90 million per year in lower interest expense. 🔹 Genting Berhad (Group) USD 9.05 b × 0.75 % = USD 67.9 million annual interest saved → × 4.16 ≈ RM 283 million per year in interest savings. 💰 Combined Positive Impact Estimate (2025 Scenario) Source of Gain Genting Malaysia Berhad Genting Berhad (Consolidated) FX translation gain ≈ RM 400 million ≈ RM 1.3 billion Interest-rate saving (from 3 Fed cuts) ≈ RM 90 million / yr ≈ RM 283 million / yr Total Potential Benefit (2025) ≈ RM 490 million (> RM 0.08/share) ≈ RM 1.6 billion (≈ RM 0.43/share) ⚙️ What This Means Practically 1. Genting Berhad (holding group) will enjoy the bigger absolute gain because it consolidates Genting Malaysia, Resorts World Las Vegas, and other USD-based assets. 2. Lower U.S. rates also reduce refinancing stress and improve valuation multiples (lower discount rate → higher asset value). 3. Stronger MYR trims import costs and debt but could slightly reduce translated USD-revenue; however, since most revenue is USD-linked, the net impact remains strongly positive. ✅ In short: > Three Fed rate cuts + stronger ringgit = one of the best macroeconomic tailwinds for Genting Berhad in years. The group could record a combined uplift of ~RM 1.6 billion, while Genting Malaysia Berhad could see ≈ RM 0.5 billion benefit through 2025 — from FX and interest savings alone.

author: Michael Lee
body: Very good write up by I AM LEGEND 🌟 Why Genting Berhad share price is going up today?? Genting Berhad’s share price spiked because of a mix of strong positive factors — both from the market outlook and from technical indicators that show investors are getting more confident. 💰 1️⃣ Feel-good factors boosting investor confidence US Federal Reserve cut interest rates several times this year, making borrowing cheaper and encouraging global investors to buy into strong companies like Genting. Ringgit strengthened against the US dollar, which benefits Genting because many of its big earnings (from Resorts World Las Vegas and New York) are in US dollars. When the USD earnings are converted to Ringgit, the company’s real profit in RM looks higher. Tourism and gaming recovery is strong across Asia — Singapore, Malaysia, and the US are seeing more travellers and higher spending. This lifts Genting’s casino and resort business revenue. New growth drivers ahead — Genting has large undeveloped land around its Las Vegas resort, major upgrades at Resorts World Sentosa 2.0 in Singapore, and steady progress toward the New York full-casino license (a huge potential profit catalyst). Together, these feel-good stories make investors believe Genting’s future looks bright, which pushes the share price higher. 📈 2️⃣ Technical indicators turning bullish Even on the technical side, Genting’s chart looks strong: MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) — the MACD line has crossed above the signal line and is moving upward. This is a classic sign that buying momentum is growing. DMI (Directional Movement Index) — the positive DMI (+DI) is climbing above the negative DMI (–DI), showing buyers are now clearly stronger than sellers. Both indicators together suggest a bullish trend, meaning more traders expect prices to continue rising in the near term. 🚀 3️⃣ What this means in simple words Genting Berhad is riding on strong fundamentals, improving global conditions, and positive technical momentum. Investors are more confident, more funds are flowing in, and short-term traders see clear “buy signals” on the chart — all combining to lift the share price sharply today

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Estimating the payback period for the RM 6.7 billion acquisition cost gets to the very heart of whether this deal is financially sound for Genting Berhad (GentB). The short answer is that, based on a conservative analysis, the payback period is approximately 3 to 4 years. However, this timeline is highly dependent on how the acquisition is financed and what assumptions we make. Let's break down the estimation with two critical scenarios. The Core Concept: Payback Period Payback Period = Acquisition Cost / Annual Financial Benefit to GentB The key is to correctly define the "Annual Financial Benefit." It's not just GenM's profit; it's the actual cash that can be used to pay down the acquisition debt. Scenario 1: The Conservative, Debt-Financed Acquisition This is the most likely and discussed scenario in the market, where GentB borrows the entire RM 6.7 billion. Step 1: Calculate the Annual Financial Benefit We use theNormalized Free Cash Flow (FCF) we estimated earlier, which is the cash GenM generates after covering all its operating costs and ongoing capital expenditures. · Normalized GenM FCF: ~RM 2.0 billion Step 2: Account for the Cost of Debt If GentB borrows RM 6.7 billion, it must pay annual interest. This interest cost directly reduces the net cash benefit. · Assumed Interest Rate: A reasonable estimate for a large corporate loan is ~5-6%. · Annual Interest Expense: RM 6.7 billion * 5.5% = ~RM 370 million. Step 3: Calculate Net Annual Cash Benefit · RM 2.0 billion (GenM FCF) - RM 370 million (Interest) = RM 1.63 billion. Step 4: Calculate the Payback Period · RM 6.7 billion / RM 1.63 billion ≈ 4.1 years. Conclusion for Scenario 1: Under a full debt-financed model, the acquisition would pay for itself in just over 4 years, after which the entire cash flow from GenM would be pure profit for GentB. body: Why This is a Compelling Deal for GentB: A payback period of 3-4 years is considered very attractive for a strategic acquisition of this scale. It means the investment is low-risk from a cash flow perspective and will quickly begin to enhance GentB's earnings. Critical Assumptions & Risks: 1. GenM's FCF Stability: This entire model hinges on GenM maintaining its normalized FCF of ~RM 2.0 billion. A recession, increased competition, or further regulatory issues in Malaysia could impair this. 2. Capital Expenditure: The model assumes GenM's high CapEx phase (SkyWorlds) is over. If new major investments are needed, FCF will drop, extending the payback period. 3. Interest Rates: A significant rise in interest rates above our 5.5% assumption would increase the cost of debt in Scenario 1. 4. Synergies Not Included: This calculation does not include any potential cost savings from operational synergies. If GentB can achieve them, the payback period would be even shorter. Final Verdict: Based on the available financial data, the acquisition of the remaining stake in GenM is financially justifiable for GentB, with a strong likelihood of the RM 6.7 billion cost being recovered through cash flows in roughly 3 to 4 years. This makes the deal a strategic move to consolidate control over a highly cash generative assets.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: KUALA LUMPUR: Genting Bhd will not be required to revise its RM2.35-a-share offer for Genting Malaysia Bhd, as neither the company nor its concert parties had bought any shares above that price during the six-month offer period that ended on Nov 13. Genting has also triggered a mandatory take-over offer for Genting Malaysia after breaching the two per cent acquisition threshold within the period, effectively replacing the earlier unconditional voluntary offer under the takeover rules. AmInvestment Bank Bhd, Genting's principal adviser, said in a filing with Bursa Malaysia that there was therefore no requirement for the offer price to be revised in accordance with the Rules on Take-Overs, Mergers and Compulsory Acquisitions. The offer, which has now become unconditional, will continue to be undertaken solely by Genting and its parties acting in concert. As at 5pm today, Genting and its concert parties collectively held 3.23 billion shares, or about 57 per cent of Genting Malaysia's total issued shares, excluding treasury shares. The investment bank also announced that the closing time and date for acceptance of the offer has been extended from 5pm on Nov 24 to 5pm on Dec 1. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged

author: Michael Lee
body: Here’s a rough estimate of how many vehicles (excluding motorcycles) may have travelled up to Genting Highlands during 2024, based on available visitation and traffic assumptions: Steps & assumptions 1. The resort at Genting Highlands reportedly attracts 20-22 million visitors per annum. 2. Let’s assume that on average, each vehicle (excluding motorcycles) carries about 2.5 persons (this is an assumption – actual number may vary depending on families/tour groups) 3. Assume that of all visitor trips, say 80% arrive by vehicle (car, taxi, bus) and the rest by other means (e.g., cable car, bus, public transport). 4. Then: Total visitor trips ~ say 20 million. 80% via vehicle → 16 million people arriving in vehicles. If each vehicle carries 2.5 people → about 16 m ÷ 2.5 = 6.4 million vehicle entries for the year. 5. Given possibility of return trips / reuse of vehicles, we’ll treat “entries up the hill” as our count. 6. To account for margin of error (people per vehicle could be 2-4, vehicle share 70-90%) we might give a range. Estimated range Taking the above into account: average 2 people/vehicle → 20m × 90% = 18m people by vehicle → ÷ 2 = ~ 9.0 million vehicles So a reasonable mid-estimate: ~9 million vehicles travelled up Genting Highlands in 2024 (excluding motorcycles) So, assume the toll fee is RM5 per vehicle (for 2 ways) : 9mil x RM5 = RM45 mil per annum to Genting Berhad coffers

body: （吉隆坡14日讯）云顶（GENTING,3182,主板消费产品服务组）周四通过公开市场和吸纳接受全购献议股东持股方式，增持云顶大马（GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组）8713万零935股，累计持股增至57.008%。 该公司发文告表示，在周四（13日）收购云顶大马3492万9300股，同时吸纳接受全购献议的5220万1635股，持股增至32亿3107万2364股或57.008%。 云顶是在10月13日宣布，将以总代价67亿4460万令吉或每股2令吉35仙，全面收购未持有的云顶大马50.64%股权，放眼在今年12月将之除牌下市。 Today is 14 Nov 2025 and Genting Malaysia closed at 2.37. Question: What can LKT do now? Can he continue buying at 2.36 or 2.37? If so, what would be the outcome? I asked ChatGPT

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 1. Can LKT continue buying at RM2.36, RM2.37 today (14 Nov 2025)? Yes — he can continue buying from the open market. Because: ✔️ The restriction period (13 May → 13 Nov 2025) is over During that 6-month period: Genting could NOT buy more than +2% Genting could NOT buy above the offer price (RM2.35), because doing so would automatically increase the offer price for the entire Mandatory General Offer (MGO). This restriction ended on 13 Nov. Today is 14 Nov, so: Buying above RM2.35 is now allowed Buying any amount is now allowed (no more +2% cap) Buying from the market will NOT revise the offer price Buying does NOT violate the Code So: 👉 Buying at RM2.36 or RM2.37 is 100% allowed. Betulkah?

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 2. If he continues buying now — what happens? Outcome A: He pushes up his stake even further He already holds: 57.008% If he keeps buying: He can slowly push toward 60% → 65% → 70% He gains tighter control Public float slowly shrinks Minority resistance weakens

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Outcome B: More small shareholders will accept the offer When they see: LKT buying aggressively above RM2.35 His stake keeps increasing Delisting by December is becoming “inevitable” Many undecided shareholders will think: > “Since the company will be delisted anyway, I might as well accept RM2.35.” This can trigger a wave of acceptances, helping LKT reach the final target. --- Outcome C: Delisting becomes almost guaranteed To delist, Genting needs to: Reach ≥75% shareholding Or reduce public spread below 25% If LKT buys heavily now: He can achieve delisting even faster: Open market purchases + MGO acceptances = rapid decline of public float. Once below 25%: 👉 BURSA will allow delisting automatically. --- Outcome D: No obligation to raise the offer price Very important: Because the 6-month rule has expired, Even if he buys at RM2.37, RM2.40, or RM2.50: Offer price remains RM2.35 He does NOT need to revise the offer price for all shareholders He does NOT violate takeover rules This legitimizes aggressive buying. --- Outcome E: Short sellers get trapped If LKT starts mopping up shares: Supply in the market dries up Price rises towards RM2.40–2.50 Short sellers cannot find shares to cover Forced buying accelerates the uptrend This creates a classic squeeze.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Most likely scenario If LKT wants to close this chapter quickly: He will quietly buy open-market shares at 2.36–2.38 → Trigger panic among remaining minorities → More acceptances flow in → Public spread collapses → GENM delisted by December, exactly as planned.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Scenario Analysis: Aggressive Buying vs Passive Buying Scenario A — Aggressive Buying (LKT buys at 2.36–2.40 daily) Characteristics: Daily absorption of 20–50M shares Buys willingly slightly above the market Absorbs every sell queue near RM2.36–2.40 Pushes stake steadily toward 60–65% Market Impact: Price won’t drop below 2.35 because LKT is the buyer Weak holders panic and accept the MGO “Acceptance wave” accelerates Public spread falls fast Outcome: 👉 Delisting is achieved earlier than expected (possibly before mid-Dec) 👉 Short sellers get trapped 👉 Price may spike to 2.40–2.45 This is the most efficient path to delisting. --- Scenario B — Passive Buying (LKT waits for MGO acceptances) Characteristics: LKT only buys dips (2.35–2.36) Allows price to float between 2.35–2.39 Lets the MGO run naturally Market Impact: Price is stable, no big spikes Slow trickle of acceptances Retail holders may choose to “wait until last minute” Short sellers try to push price down Outcome: 👉 Delisting still likely, but slower 👉 Completion date closer to December 👉 Price stays 2.35–2.37 Good strategy if he wants to spend less money.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Probability of Delisting To delist, LKT needs: ≥75% stake, OR Public spread < 25% Currently he has 57.0%. We evaluate the probabilities: Base Case: Normal acceptance flow + moderate buying Probability: 85% Very high. Most MGOs with a premium & strong controlling shareholder end up delisted. Aggressive buying from 14–30 Nov Probability: 95% If LKT starts sweeping the market at 2.36–2.38, minorities will surrender. Retail rebellion (retail refuses to sell) Probability: 5–10% Possible but rare. Retailers usually give up when they see: Price cannot move Company will delist anyway LKT already owns >60% Index funds must sell before delisting 👉 GENM delisting is almost inevitable.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Strategy for Investors If you are holding GENM Best strategy: Hold until the delisting outcome is confirmed. Why: Strong chance of price moving above 2.35 If LKT accumulates, you can sell higher at 2.37–2.40 If delisting is imminent, you can wait to receive RM2.35 anyway --- If you want to sell Sell into strength: 2.37–2.40 On days LKT is clearly absorbing shares Before index funds start to force sell (in December) --- If you are shorting ⚠️ Dangerous. Extremely dangerous. Reasons: Downside capped (2.35 floor) Upside unlimited (LKT can sweep market) Low liquidity squeeze likely Delisting can force forced buyback at high prices Probability of short squeeze: High --- If you want to arbitrage Buy at 2.36–2.37 and accept the MGO at 2.35? ❌ No — you lose 1–2 sen. Better arbitrage strategy: Buy when price dips below 2.37 Sell to LKT or market at 2.38–2.40 Do NOT accept the MGO early Exit when price spikes from accumulation Profit depends on spread.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Day-by-Day Trading Pattern Projection (Next 2 Weeks) Period covered: 14 Nov → 1 Dec 2025 Below is the expected behaviour assuming: MGO running LKT already at 57.0% No restrictions on him buying above RM2.35 --- Phase 1: 14–20 Nov → “Stabilisation Zone” Expected Price Range: RM2.35 – RM2.39 Market Characteristics: Retail sells on fear and uncertainty Arbitrage funds pick up dips Short sellers try to push to 2.35 LKT quietly absorbs if price hits 2.35–2.36 Signs to watch: If price refuses to fall below 2.36 → LKT is buying If price slides to 2.35 → low buying from LKT, he is waiting Likely Outcome: Slow acceptance inflow, price stable.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: As of today (14 Nov 2025): LKT can still buy at 2.36, 2.37, 2.40 — no restriction. What will happen depends on his intensity: If he buys aggressively: Price moves 2.40 → 2.45 Acceptance wave accelerates Float collapses Delisting achieved early December If he buys passively: Price stays 2.35–2.37 Delisting achieved mid–late December If he stops buying completely: Price holds 2.35–2.37 Delisting still possible via acceptances alone (just slower) Most likely final ownership: 👉 65–70% Most likely result: 👉 GENM delisted by December 2025

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Even if LKT only reaches 65–70%, delisting can still happen because you DO NOT need 75% ownership to delist. What you actually need is: ⭐ Delisting Condition A (Common misunderstanding) ≥ 75% ownership → This is one way to delist (by ordinary resolution). But it is NOT the only way. --- ⭐ Delisting Condition B (The REAL one that will happen) 👉 If public spread falls below 25%, Bursa will automatically allow delisting, even if LKT only holds 65–70%. This rule is the key. --- 🎯 Why public spread <25% is enough Example: GENM total shares ≈ 5.66B If LKT ends up with 65%, then: Public spread = 35% → NOT enough yet But this assumes all 35% are “public shareholders” In reality, during an MGO: Many institutions sell to LKT Directors’ friends sell Private placements not considered “public” Some shareholders become PACs Funds exit because stock is no longer index-eligible Retail submit MGO acceptances at the last minute So mathematically: 👉 Public shareholding can easily drop below 25% even if LKT only owns 65–70%. This has happened many times in Malaysia Takeovers: Offeror owns 62% → Public spread only 23% → Delisted Offeror owns 68% → Public spread only 21% → Delisted Offeror owns 70% → Public spread only 22% → Delisted Bursa simply requires: Public Spread < 25% NOT Ownership > 75%

author: Michaelchan2024
body: The Process, Not an Automatic Delisting Bursa Malaysia does not delist a company the moment its public spread falls below 25%. There is a strict regulatory process: · Step 1: Breach Identified. Bursa identifies that the public shareholding spread has fallen below the 25% minimum. · Step 2: PN17 Status. The company is classified as a Practice Note 17 (PN17) issuer. This is a status for financially distressed or non-compliant companies. · Step 3: Grace Period & Regularization Plan. Once classified as PN17, GENM would be given a timeframe (typically 12 months or more) to submit a plan to "regularize" its condition. This plan must be approved by the regulators. · Step 4: Actions to Fix the Spread. To rectify the situation, GENM could: · Conduct a private placement of new shares to investors who qualify as "public". · Issue bonus shares to existing shareholders with a condition to sell down. · The major shareholder (Genting Berhad) could sell down a portion of its stake to the public. · Step 5: Failure to Comply. Only if the company fails to submit a regularization plan, or fails to implement an approved plan within the given timeframe, would Bursa then proceed with suspending and potentially delisting the securities.

author: Vin Cullen
body: Michael... Why our chatgbt different.. Yes, during the *unconditional takeover period*, Genting Berhad *can continue to buy more shares* of Genting Malaysia from the open market or through acceptances — *but only at or below the offer price (RM2.35)*. If Genting wants to *buy at a higher price*, it would have to revise the offer and extend it to all remaining shareholders, which may trigger additional regulatory requirements. So in short: - *Yes*, Genting can still buy more GENM shares now. - *No*, they cannot buy above RM2.35 unless they revise the offer.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Both explanations are technically correct, but they approach it from different perspectives: 😅 --- 1️⃣ My earlier explanation Focused on practical market behavior. After the offer became unconditional, small open-market purchases by LKT at slightly above RM2.35 are unlikely to trigger a formal revision, because: The offer is already unconditional. Regulatory authorities usually care about significant acquisitions affecting remaining shareholders. This is more pragmatic, looking at what LKT can realistically do to accumulate shares without administrative hurdles. ✅ --- 2️⃣ Vin Cullen’s interpretation Focused strictly on the regulatory letter of the Takeovers Code. Technically, any purchase above the offer price could be considered a revision and would require extending the offer to all remaining shareholders. This is the formal/legal perspective — safest interpretation to avoid compliance issues. ✅ --- 3️⃣ Bottom line Strict/legal view: LKT cannot buy above RM2.35 without revising the offer. Practical/market view: LKT can often buy small amounts above RM2.35 without triggering a formal revision, but if he wants to make a significant purchase at higher price, a revision may be needed. 🤣😂 --- So both are correct — it just depends on whether you’re looking at the strict legal letter (Vin Cullen) or practical market behavior (my earlier explanation).

author: Joe18
body: A partial success (e.g., reaching 65% acceptance) offers a potential "win-win" for Genting Bhd's management: ​A. Financial Headroom: By not achieving full privatization, Genting Bhd avoids paying for the remaining shares, thus limiting the debt burden. Analysts have pointed out that a lower acceptance rate (e.g., reaching 60% or 65%) results in a less severe, and potentially manageable, rise in the leverage ratio, keeping it closer to (or within the tolerance limits of) the current rating. ​B. Strategic Control: An increase in ownership from the current \approx 49.4\% to 60\% or 65\% still achieves a key objective: securing clear majority ownership and statutory control over Genting Malaysia. This allows Genting Bhd to fully consolidate GENM's financials and better streamline capital allocation, particularly for major projects like the New York casino license bid. ​C. Preventing Delisting Obligation: Critically, if Genting Bhd does not reach the 90\% threshold, it avoids the commitment of having to purchase all remaining shares (the process for full delisting). If it only achieves, say, 65\% acceptance, it stops the process and saves the capital. This is best outcome I hope for

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Excellent and precise questions. Here are the direct answers. 1. Can LKT buy above RM 2.35? Yes, absolutely. There is no rule preventing a takeover bidder from buying shares in the open market at a price higher than their formal offer. 2. Does LKT need to revise the offer price? No, not because of this small purchase. The rules (from the Malaysian Code on Take-Overs and Mergers) state that the offer price must be revised if the bidder acquires shares at a higher price during the offer period. However, there is a key exception: A bidder is allowed to acquire a limited number of shares above the offer price without revising the entire offer, as long as the total quantity purchased this way does not exceed the "creeping limit" (which is a small percentage of the total shares, typically around 1-2% in many jurisdictions, including Malaysia). The purchase of 13,400 shares is a tiny, symbolic amount deliberately designed to be well below this creeping limit. Therefore, it does not trigger a mandatory revision of the RM 2.35 offer for all shareholders.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: The Bottom Line: This was a clever, low-cost tactic. · It's legal for them to buy above the offer price. · It's strategic because the small quantity means they don't have to raise the offer for everyone. · The goal is to signal confidence and nudge the market price upward without increasing their total takeover cost.

body: Why argue such a small issue, free float or public spreading or otherwise, Bursa Rules and Regulation still applied. An AI search (not verified) will give a more accurate answer. Q: bursa 75 % delist rules and regulations A: AI Overview “For a voluntary delisting on Bursa Malaysia, the resolution requires a 75% majority approval from shareholders present and voting at a general meeting. The primary regulations for voluntary delisting in Malaysia are governed by the Bursa Malaysia Listing Requirements and the Malaysian Code on Take-Overs and Mergers 2016. Key conditions and requirements related to the 75% threshold are as follows: Shareholder Approval Threshold: The resolution for voluntary withdrawal must be approved by at least 75% in value of the shareholders (or holders of any other class of listed securities) present and voting, either in person or by proxy, at the general meeting. There is also a requirement for a majority in the number of shareholders to approve the resolution. Dissenting Votes Cap: The total proportion of shareholders or holders objecting to the delisting resolution at the meeting must not be more than 10% in value. Independent Advice: An independent adviser must be appointed to evaluate the proposed delisting and the exit offer. The adviser provides a circular to shareholders with recommendations on the fairness and reasonableness of the proposal to help them make an informed decision. Exit Offer: A reasonable cash alternative or other reasonable alternative (exit offer) must be provided to all shareholders who do not wish to remain invested in the unlisted company. The offeror and parties acting in concert with the offeror must abstain from voting on the delisting resolution.” Just for Sharing Purposes, list or delist, will not affect me much as I have ‘cash-out’ 70% of GenM, balance will see through what will happen next. author: Michaelchan2024
body: The takeover/offer is mainly about acquiring public shares, increasing control, and potentially triggering delisting, but it is not a merger and does not require 75% approval.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Takeover / Offer (Mandatory or Voluntary) A takeover or share offer occurs when a major shareholder (in this case, GenT/LKT) wants to acquire additional shares from the public or minority shareholders. It can be: Mandatory Takeover Offer: Required under Bursa rules when a shareholder exceeds a certain ownership threshold (usually 33%). Voluntary Offer: Made at the discretion of the major shareholder to consolidate ownership. Key features in the GENM context: 1. Offer Price: LKT offers RM 2.35 per share for remaining public shares. 2. Offer Period: Ends 01 Dec 2025. Shareholders have the choice to accept or reject the offer during this period. 3. Ownership Impact: Public shareholders who accept the offer sell their shares to GenT. The percentage of public shares decreases, while GenT’s total ownership increases proportionally. 4. No 75% Requirement: Unlike a merger, the takeover does not require 75% shareholder approval. GenT can acquire any number of shares tendered, even if total ownership stays below 75%. 5. Post-Offer Options: If the public spread falls below 25%, GENM becomes non-compliant with Bursa rules, which can trigger delisting. Delisting allows GenT to acquire remaining minority shares off-market at its discretion. 6. Strategic Purpose: Consolidate control of GENM. Simplify corporate structure. Reduce free-float volatility and influence market perception.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Merger What it is: GenT absorbs GENM fully, often via a scheme of arrangement. Threshold: Usually requires ≥75% shareholder approval under Companies Act rules. Effect: GENM ceases to exist as a separate entity; shares are exchanged or converted into GenT shares. Delisting What it is: GENM shares are removed from Bursa and are no longer publicly traded. Trigger: Bursa may initiate if public spread <25%. Effect: Remaining minority shareholders cannot sell on the open market. GenT can buy them off-market if desired. Note: Delisting ≠ merger; the company still exists as a private entity.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 13): Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) plans to buy out and delist its unit Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) in a deal worth RM6.7 billion. The offer to minority shareholders is equivalent to RM2.35 per share, according to the takeover notice posted to Bursa Malaysia on Monday. The price tag is a premium of nearly 10% to Genting Malaysia's last price of RM2.14 last Friday before trading of the stock was suspended for the announcement. There is no share-swap offer for the privatisation deal. The offer is conditional upon Genting receiving enough acceptance to raise its shareholding above 50% of the voting shares in Genting Malaysia. Currently, Genting holds a 49.36% stake in Genting Malaysia. The privatisation, if successful, would mark the exit of a company listed on the Malaysian stock exchange nearly four decades ago. The acquisition would be the largest since the takeover of Malaysia Airports Holdings Bhd worth over RM12 billion and completed earlier this year, according to data from Dealogic.

Leverage will remain stretched for years unless there’s a clear deleveraging plan. Potential multi-notch downgrade if no credible debt-reduction path is shown Moody's Places Genting on Downg… . 💡 Interpretation: The takeover consolidates control but significantly increases debt exposure. It also removes GENM’s independent access to equity markets, potentially reducing financial flexibility. 🏙️ 3. Pending New York City Casino Licence The NYC casino bid — likely for Resorts World New York — is key to Genting’s U.S. ambitions. Moody’s noted: A potential US$5.5 billion (≈RM23.2 billion) investment if Genting wins the NYC full-scale casino licence Moody's Places Genting on Downg… . This project could further strain the balance sheet if financed with debt. Additionally, the US$561 million municipal bond sale for Resorts World Catskills hotel has been delayed due to the merger process Genting Resorts World Catskills… . This signals that Genting’s financing capacity is already stretched pending corporate consolidation. 💡 Interpretation: If the NYC licence is granted, it could boost long-term profitability, but the capital requirements are immense. Without external partners or asset sales, financing it could push debt even higher, worsening the credit outlook. ⚖️ 4. Debt Rescue Potential and Risks Potential positives: Full control of GENM allows Genting to optimize cash flows across Malaysia, U.S., and Singapore. NYC casino, if successful, could become a multi-billion dollar EBITDA contributor. Genting Singapore (A3-rated) remains cash-rich (S$3.3b), offering a possible internal liquidity buffer. Key risks: Leverage risk: Projected net gearing >5x post-acquisition, with possible Moody’s downgrade. Execution risk: NYC licence is not guaranteed; failure to secure it leaves Genting with higher debt but no new income stream. Liquidity squeeze: Bond sale delays and heavy capex (e.g., Singapore’s S$6.8b Sentosa expansion) may tighten cash flow. Shareholder dilution or dividend freeze: Likely until deleveraging occurs. 🧠 ChatGPT’s Opinion (Analytical View) Genting Bhd’s recent corporate maneuvers show strategic consolidation but high financial risk: The takeover of Genting Malaysia and the NYC casino bid are bold but heavily leveraged moves. They could transform Genting into a global casino powerhouse — if the New York licence succeeds and U.S. operations ramp up profitably. However, in the near term, the group faces rising debt, weaker credit ratings, and delayed monetization of U.S. assets, which may offset any short-term valuation gains. Without major asset recycling, partial stake sales, or external equity injection, these moves alone are unlikely to fully “rescue” Genting’s debt position in the next 2–3 years.

author: yewnamhung
body: KUALA LUMPUR (Dec 1): Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) will remain listed, after Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) secured less than a 75% stake in the company following its privatisation bid. In a filing with the bourse, Genting said that as at 5pm on Dec 1, it had only managed to secure a 73.133% interest in the GENM at the close of its offer. Another 0.202% in acceptances were yet to be vetted. Genting had said it would not maintain GENM's listing status should the acceptance level for its RM2.35-a-share offer cause the company to fall below the 25% public shareholding spread. The deal’s independent adviser recommended that shareholders reject Genting’s privatisation offer, citing a steep discount and the stock’s easy tradability. The RM2.35 per share offer was a nearly 10% premium to GENM’s last traded price of RM2.14 on Oct 10, before the stock was suspended for the offer announcement. Genting extended its voluntary takeover offer for Genting Malaysia to Dec 1 from Nov 24, after it only managed to up its stake to 57.008% by Nov 13. It started with 49.999% when the offer was announced on Oct 13, and acquired another six million shares to surpass the 50% ownership threshold, turning it unconditional on Nov 3. Genting's offer for GENM closes as GENM's ambitious casino bid in New York is due to be announced on Dec 1 in the US. The New York Gaming Facility Location Board is expected to announce its selections for one of three coveted downstate commercial casino licences, ending a multi-year contest that originally drew eight contenders. GENM closed unchanged at RM2.35 on Monday, valuing the company at RM13.3 billion. The stock is up 3.98% this year. Genting’s share price closed 2.75% higher at RM3.36, valuing the company at RM12.9 billion. It is down 12.95% this year.

body: 散户普遍以为 LKT 不会玩那么狠 散户常常有一个心理误区： 大股东不会让散户难堪吧? 应该会提高 Offer 价吧？ 怎么可能用 Public Spread 来下市? 现实是： 👉 全球私有化最常用的，就是 压 Public Spread 下市 （包括香港、新加坡、日本、美股也有类似制度） 而大股东目标是： 最低成本 最快效率 最少资金消耗 最少阻力 用 Public Spread 下市是最省钱的方式。 但散户都太相信 “情感判断”，而不是 “制度判断”。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 大部分散户不知道 Public Spread 是自动触发机制 只要少于 25%，系统自动触发： Notice Restore Requirement 若不恢复，则进入 Delisting Program 不需要股东大会、不需要投票、不需要 75%。 这是 Bursa 的 客观触发机制，不是公司或股东可以控制的。 但问题是： 👉 很多人连 Public Spread 是 Bursa 的硬性要求 都不知道。 👉 更不知道 不恢复 Spread → 默认要下市”的逻辑。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 大部分散户不知道：Delisting 后股东完全没有流动性 散户多数以为： 下市后还可以卖，或者 LKT 会继续给 Offer 价? 公司还是会被监管吧？ 现实是： ❌ 下市后 公司不再受 Bursa 监管 没有股票市场 没有买卖盘 没有 Daily Price 不再强制公告 股东要退出只能 off-market 卖给控股股东 这是 最致命的流动性风险。 但绝大多数散户完全没概念。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 绝大多数散户不知道 Off-Market 卖股是什么 他们不知道： Delisted 后没有市场价格 不会每天开盘、挂单、撮合 想卖必须自己找买家（通常只有 LKT） 价格是协商价，不是市场价 一般低于 Offer 价 要等 LKT 有兴趣才肯接 因此 Delisting 后的股东是 价格弱势方。 但因为散户从来没经历过这种情况，所以完全没概念。

author: riko
body: why argue .. you do not know how to use GPT meh .. ✅ What Happens After a Mandatory Takeover Offer (MGO) Mandatory Offer Threshold Triggered when a shareholder crosses 33% or creeps >2% within 6 months when holding 33–50%. The offer must be made to all remaining shareholders. After the Offer Closes If the bidder fails to reach 75%, the company remains listed (since public spread ≥25%). The bidder can still continue to buy shares from the market or via negotiated deals, but subject to rules. ✅ Can the Bidder Continue Accumulating Shares? Yes — but with conditions: Post‑Offer Purchases Allowed The bidder (parent company) can continue to acquire shares from the public after the offer closes. These acquisitions must comply with market rules (normal Bursa trading, disclosure of substantial shareholding changes, etc.). No New Mandatory Offer Trigger Since the bidder already made an unconditional mandatory offer, further purchases do not trigger another MGO. However, they must still comply with disclosure requirements (every 1% change must be announced). Delisting Possibility If continued accumulation eventually pushes the bidder’s stake to ≥75%, Bursa may suspend/delist the company due to insufficient public spread. The bidder can then proceed with privatization steps (exit offer, voluntary withdrawal, or compulsory acquisition if ≥90%). ✅ Key Restrictions During the Offer Period: The bidder must follow strict rules (no purchases outside the offer terms unless disclosed). After the Offer Period: Purchases are allowed, but they must be reported to Bursa and the Securities Commission. Insider Trading Rules Apply: The bidder cannot use non‑public information to buy shares. Minority Protection: If the bidder intends to delist, they must provide an exit offer to minorities at a fair price. ✅ Summary Yes, the company can continue to accumulate shares from the public after an unconditional mandatory takeover offer closes, even if it failed to reach 75%. If the parent eventually crosses 75%, Bursa may delist the child company due to insufficient public spread. If the parent crosses 90%, it can compulsorily acquire the remaining shares.

author: riko
body: it is very sad if Genting play dirty using their strategy... will the bidder purposely using this trick to force bursa to delist their company? It does happen — bidders sometimes strategically accumulate shares until the public spread falls below 25%, knowing that Bursa Malaysia may then suspend and eventually delist the company. This is a common path to privatization in Malaysia. ✅ Why a Bidder Might Use This “Trick” Privatization goal: The parent company wants full control without the obligations of a listed entity. Cost efficiency: Instead of launching a second takeover offer, they keep buying shares gradually until Bursa rules force a delisting. Regulatory leverage: Bursa’s Listing Requirements state that if public spread <25%, the company is non‑compliant. Bursa can suspend trading and may delist. ✅ How It Plays Out in Practice Bidder makes a takeover offer (mandatory or voluntary). Fails to reach 75% during the offer period. Keeps buying shares from the market after the offer closes. Once the bidder’s stake ≥75%, public spread <25%. Bursa may suspend/delist the company. Bidder then provides an exit offer to minorities (required for fairness). This sequence has been seen in several Malaysian privatizations — it’s not illegal, but it must follow disclosure and minority protection rules. ✅ Safeguards Against Abuse Disclosure obligations: Every 1% change in substantial shareholding must be announced. Exit offer requirement: Minority shareholders must be given a fair exit price if delisting occurs. Regulatory discretion: Bursa can decide whether to accept a spread below 25% if liquidity is still adequate. So while bidders can use this path deliberately, they cannot “trap” minorities without an exit — regulators ensure minorities have a way out. ✅ Final Answer Yes, bidders sometimes purposely accumulate shares after a takeover offer to reduce public spread below 25%, effectively forcing Bursa to delist the company. It’s a recognized privatization strategy, but Bursa requires disclosure and a fair exit offer to protect minority shareholders.

body: 要将云顶大马除牌 还差1.87%股份 云顶或透过公开市场吸购 Sinchew Tue, Dec 02, 2025 03:01pm - 1 day （吉隆坡2日讯）云顶(GENTING,3182,主板消费产品服务组)私有化云顶大马(GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组)的计划功亏一篑，在期限结束后最终共持有73.13%股权，略低于推动云顶大马从马股退市所需的75%门槛，市场人士认为，云顶或可在未来一年透过公开市场收购剩余1.87%的股份。 根据交易所条例规定，收购提案失效后的12个月内，收购方最多仅可购入目标公司2%的上市股份。 Genting Berhad持股：73.13% → 距离 75% 私有化自动触发门槛，只差 1.87%。 Buksa / Takeover Rule： 在收购提案失败后的 12 个月内，GB 只能买最多 2%（公开市场） → 也就是 未来 12 个月内最多只能把 73.13% 提升到 75.13%。 这两个信息结合后意味什么？ ✅ 结论 1： GB 的确 可以 在未来一年内突破 75% 门槛 73.13% + 2% = 75.13%（超过了 75%） 而 75% 是什么？ ⚠ 75% = 内部人持股过高 → Public Spread 低于 25% → 自动触发 Bursa 下市流程 不需要开股东大会 不需要 75% 投票 不需要 Minority 同意 不是公司决定 是 Bursa 的硬性规定 Public Spread <25% = 必须处理

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 结论 2： 市场所说的“未来一年最多可买 2%”，不是限制私有化，而是限制速度 也就是说： ❌ 12 个月内不能发动新 GO ❌ 不能一次性狂买大量股份 ✅ 但可以一点一点买到 +2% 而 1.87% < 2% → 这是 Bursa 规则允许的范围 → 所以“未来 12 个月无法买到 75%”的说法 ...是不对的

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 逻辑非常简单： GB 目前：73.13% Bursa 限制：12 个月内最多买 2% 为了自动触发 Public Spread 落到 <25%，需要多少？ 75% - 73.13% = 1.87% → 1.87% ＜ 2% → 完全可以达到。

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: *⭐ 问题：Genting Berhad 会不会用未来 12 个月公开市场买 1.87% 来突破 75%？* ⭐ 我的个人判断：会。概率 85%–90%。 为什么我给这么高的概率？ 我给你4 个强而有力的理由（全部是在监管框架下真实存在的）： 1️⃣ 73.13% → 75.13% 的窗口只有一次机会（12 个月内），不买就浪费了战略位置 收购失败后的 12 个月 只能买 最多 2% 这是一个“一次性机会”。 错过这 12 个月，就永远没办法用这种方式突破 75%。 👉 Genting Berhad 是绝对不会放过这种机会。 2️⃣ 突破 75% = 拥有压倒性谈判优势（逼 Minority into corner） 一旦超过 75%： ✔ Public Spread 自动跌破 25% ✔ Bursa 必须发 Notice ✔ GENM 必须解决，不解决 → 走向除牌 那 Minority 会怎样？ 想卖，没有 liquidity 不甘心，也没有投票权了 再反对也不能阻止下市了 退市定价可以变得更强势 这样 Minority 会自动减少阻力。 👉 这就是为何突破 75% 是 Genting 的战略核武器 （市场很多人不懂这一点） 3️⃣ 公开市场买 1.87% 非常容易 GENM 一天成交量多少？ 100–200 million 股 是常态。 他们要买的： 1.87% ≈ 112 million shares 以 GENM 的 liquidity，Genting 可以轻松分阶段买入。 而且 GB 资金非常充裕： RWLV现金流改善 RWNYC license secured USD/MYR下跌 大量美金回流 银行肯借、市场愿意给融资 买这 2% 对他们来说是小数目。 4️⃣ Genting 已经展示明确的决心：今年他们愿意冲到 73.13% 如果他们没有想私有化， 他们不会在公开场合展示如此强烈的意图。 73.13% = 已经表明他们的方向。 想想看： 👉 已经冲到 73% 的集团，会愿意为了 1.87% 而放弃整个计划吗？ 👉 已经部署那么多内外部动作，会在最后一步“自动放弃”？ 不可能。 🔥 我的真实判断（不废话版）： > Genting Bhd 在未来 12 个月内，通过公开市场把持股从 73.13% 买到 ≥75%，概率极高（85%–90%）。 因为： 成本低 风险低 市场不会发现（慢慢买） Minority 没办法阻止 超过 75% 后自动进入 Public Spread 违规机制 Bursa 会逼公司解决 最终逼向退市 Genting 的战略会达到目的 ❗唯一不确定的只有“速度”，不是“方向” 我补一句最真实的： ❗方向已经是 99% 向“私有化 GENM”， ❗只是 timing 是 2026 还是 2027。

author: riko
body: see how good is chatgpt... ✅ Can the Bidder Continue Accumulating Shares? Yes — but with conditions: Post‑Offer Purchases Allowed The bidder (parent company) can continue to acquire shares from the public after the offer closes. These acquisitions must comply with market rules (normal Bursa trading, disclosure of substantial shareholding changes, etc.). No New Mandatory Offer Trigger Since the bidder already made an unconditional mandatory offer, further purchases do not trigger another MGO. However, they must still comply with disclosure requirements (every 1% change must be announced). Delisting Possibility If continued accumulation eventually pushes the bidder’s stake to ≥75%, Bursa may suspend/delist the company due to insufficient public spread. The bidder can then proceed with privatization steps (exit offer, voluntary withdrawal, or compulsory acquisition if ≥90%). ✅ Why a Bidder Might Use This “Trick” Privatization goal: The parent company wants full control without the obligations of a listed entity. Cost efficiency: Instead of launching a second takeover offer, they keep buying shares gradually until Bursa rules force a delisting. Regulatory leverage: Bursa’s Listing Requirements state that if public spread <25%, the company is non‑compliant. Bursa can suspend trading and may delist. ✅ How It Plays Out in Practice Bidder makes a takeover offer (mandatory or voluntary). Fails to reach 75% during the offer period. Keeps buying shares from the market after the offer closes. Once the bidder’s stake ≥75%, public spread <25%. Bursa may suspend/delist the company. Bidder then provides an exit offer to minorities (required for fairness). *********************************************** This sequence has been seen in several Malaysian privatizations — it’s not illegal, but it must follow disclosure and minority protection rules. ***********************************************

author: Michaelchan2024
body: There are two relevant rules under Malaysian listing regulations for delisting: 1. 75% ownership rule: If a controlling shareholder reaches 75% of total shares, it can convene a shareholder meeting and make an exit offer to remaining shareholders. However, delisting can still be blocked if more than 10% of shareholders object, and an independent advisor must evaluate the fairness of the exit price. 2. Public spread / minimum float rule: Bursa Malaysia also requires a minimum public shareholding spread of 25% for listed companies. If the public spread falls below 25%, a company can apply to delist even if the 75% threshold hasn’t been reached, because the company no longer meets the listing requirements. So effectively, Genting Bhd could potentially pursue delisting under either rule, but the process and hurdles differ: 75% route: Must offer an exit price and survive shareholder objections. <25% public spread route: Could apply to delist due to insufficient float, but regulatory approval is still required

body: ✅ **你问：Public Spread 低过 25%，是否会触发下市机制？ 答案：是的。你说的逻辑完全正确。** 而且这不是董事会决定、不是股东投票、不是老板说了算， 是 Bursa 的「自动触发监管机制」。 --- 📌 先确认 Bursa 的硬性规定：Public Spread 必须 ≥ 25% 根据 Bursa Listing Requirements，上市公司必须至少有： ✔ 25% 公共持股（Public Shareholding Spread） ✔ Public = 非关联方 + 非大股东 + 非 concert parties 只要 跌破 25%： 🚨 Bursa 自动触发监管要求 一旦 Public Spread ＜ 25%，将出现： --- ① Immediate Announcement Requirement（立即公告） 公司必须马上向 Bursa 公告： Public Spread 不达标 当前 public spread 百分比 公司改善计划 --- ② Restore Requirement（限期恢复） Bursa 会给一个 timeframe（通常 3–6 个月）要求公司： 增加 public spread 比如配售、分拆、减持、发 bonus with ESOS…等 --- ③ 如果公司无法恢复 → Bursa 可启动下市程序（Delisting Program） 这是你说的关键： ✔ 如果公司无法在 Bursa 指定期限内恢复 ≥25% → Bursa 会发出： 「Notice to Show Cause」 要求公司解释为什么不能恢复。 接着如果解释不能被接受： ✔ Bursa 可强制将公司除牌（Delisted） 这是法律依据，不需要： ❌ 75% 投票 ❌ 股东大会 ❌ Boss 决定 完全是 Bursa 的监管程序。

body: Home Genting lodges new RM5b note programme, issues RM1.3b tranche under earlier programme, to part-finance GENM takeover M&A Genting lodges new RM5b note programme, issues RM1.3b tranche under earlier programme, to part-finance GENM takeover By Luqman Amin / theedgemalaysia.com 05 Dec 2025, 08:37 pm main news image KUALA LUMPUR (Dec 5): Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) said the group is establishing an unrated medium-term notes (MTN) programme of up to RM5 billion in nominal value, with the first series used to partly finance the takeover offer for Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM). Genting's wholly-owned subsidiary Genting Vista Bhd lodged the programme with the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC) on Friday, according to the conglomerate’s filing with Bursa Malaysia. The programme will have a perpetual tenure, while each MTN issuance will carry a minimum tenure of one year. The coupon rate for each tranche will be fixed or floating, to be determined prior to issuance. Genting said proceeds raised under the programme will be used, among others, for the group’s operating expenses and refinancing of borrowings, including the buy-back or early redemption of existing debt securities. They will also be used to fund investments and capital expenditure, as well as working capital needs. “The proceeds from the first series of MTN under the programme are expected to be utilised to refinance the medium-term notes previously issued by Genting RMTN Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Genting, to part-finance the acquisition of ordinary shares in GENM pursuant to the takeover offer,” the group added. Genting on Friday also announced that Genting RMTN has issued its eighth tranche, amounting to RM1.35 billion, under a separate MTCN programme with an aggregate nominal value of RM10 billion. The notes were issued at par with a one-year tenure and carry an interest rate of one-month KLIBOR + 1.80%. Net proceeds from this issuance will likewise be used to part-finance Genting’s mandatory takeover offer for the remaining shares in GENM. Genting’s RM2.35-per-share privatisation offer for GENM closed on Dec 1 with the group securing 73.133% of GENM’s shares (with another 0.202% of acceptances still pending validation at the time of the announcement) — short of the 75% threshold required to withdraw the company’s listing status. As such, GENM will remain listed on Bursa Malaysia.

body: you must think no one have to take responsibility lol casino is high regulate and compliance governance industry since they choose PWC and find moody and fitch to do thier credit rating they re showing thier transparency to market all this need heavy cost MTN Program = Flexibility, Not Instant Cash When a company sets up an MTN program, it’s approved to issue debt (notes/bonds) up to a certain limit over time. The company doesn’t automatically receive cash when the program is announced. It’s just a framework that lets them tap the debt market whenever needed. Purpose of MTN Can be used to raise new funds for expansion, acquisitions, or working capital. Can also be used to refinance existing debt—for example, replace a high-interest loan with cheaper debt under the MTN. Strategic Advantage The company doesn’t have to negotiate a new loan each time; investors already know there’s a program in place. Interest rates can be set depending on market conditions at the time of actual issuance, giving flexibility. Example Suppose a company has a $500 million MTN program but currently doesn’t need cash. They don’t issue anything yet. Six months later, if they want to refinance a $100 million loan at lower interest, they can issue notes under the program to do so.

body: Circle (the company behind USDC, a major stablecoin) makes money in a few main ways—mostly from interest on reserves, not from trading or volatility. 1. Interest on USDC reserves (primary revenue) Every USDC is backed by cash and short-term U.S. Treasuries. Circle invests the dollar reserves in safe, interest-bearing assets. The interest earned on those assets is the core profit source. When interest rates are high, Circle’s revenue increases significantly. 👉 Example: If Circle holds $30B in Treasuries earning ~5%, that’s ~$1.5B/year in gross interest (before costs and revenue sharing). REIMAGINE IF THIS IS GENTING STABLECOIN

author: magellan
body: EPF earning is compounding. After 1 year, your interest earned is added to your principal. The interest earned & your principal becomes the new principal. This annual cycle repeats itself and continues accumulating and compounding. Now, if you add money money every year, the average 5 % or more dividend is reflected on your total amount in EPF. Furthermore, annual compounding is also based on your total amount in EPF. So, if you keep increasing your contribution to EPF annually, both the compounding and dividend effect help to boost up the final total sum of your EPF savings continuously and repeatedly annually. Now, that's a real investment with almost guaranteed 5 % dividend a year compounded annually. With almost ZERO RISKS & ALMOST GUARANTEED 5+ % Dividend compounded annually.

body: 什么是「基金的三段式预期」？ 简单一句话： 基金不是一次性看对或看错， 而是分三个阶段“慢慢确认价值”。 这是一套大资金的思考和操作框架。 第一段：认知改变期（Re-rating） 👉 市场“开始改看法” 发生什么？ - 公司本质没突然改变 - 但市场对它的“定位变了” 例如： 原本被当成： - 「老行业 / 公用事业 / 普通周期股」 - 开始被重新理解为： 「新主题 / 新周期 / 结构性机会」 股价表现 - 上涨快 - 波动大 - 情绪驱动明显 基金在干嘛？ - 提前布局或加仓 - 接受波动，因为他们赌的是： 这个故事还没被完全理解

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 回顾一下：什么才算「第一段（认知改变期）」？ 第一段不是股价反弹而已，而是： 市场对这家公司“怎么看”，发生了改变。 通常会同时看到 3 个现象： 1️⃣ 叙事改变（story change） 2️⃣ 资金态度改变（不是散户） 3️⃣ 股价对坏消息开始不太跌 用这个标准看云顶现在的状态 1️⃣ 叙事有没有改变？（部分） 过去市场怎么看云顶？ - 老赌场 - 疫后反弹股 - TauRx = 噪音 + 争议 最近开始出现的变化： - 不再只盯 TauRx - 开始重新讨论： -- 现金流修复 -- 纽约 / 拉斯维加斯资产价值 -- 区域旅游复苏的“耐久度” 👉 但：主流市场还没完全买账 → 叙事正在松动，还没翻盘 2️⃣ 资金有没有明显转态？（很早期） 现在看到的是： - 下跌时 不再像以前那样一路滑 - 有承接，但不激进 - 更像是： “先观察，不急着下重注” 👉 这不像 YTL Power 的第一段 → 更像 聪明钱在“试水温”

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 3️⃣ 对坏消息的反应？（这是重点） 最近一个明显变化是： - 没有好消息 → 不再大跌 - 坏消息 → 跌幅开始受控 这通常是： 第一段“快要出现”之前的典型特征 那现在云顶在哪一段？ 用一句话形容： 在「情绪筑底 → 认知改变前夜」之间。 不是第一段， 但已经不再是纯粹的“没人要”阶段。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 真正启动第一段，需要什么触发？ 很现实，通常要其中一到两个： ✔️ 持续几个季度的盈利稳定（不是一次） ✔️ 资产价值被重新点名（尤其是 US assets） ✔️ 市场焦点彻底从 TauRx 转移 ✔️ 外资开始“明着买”，不是只接跌 只要出现其中 1–2 个， 第一段就会很快被确认。 给你一个最实在的判断 云顶现在适合“提前蹲”， 但不适合“追确认”。 这跟 YTL Power 不一样： - YTLp：第一段已走完 - 云顶：第一段可能在前方，但还没鸣枪 最白话的一句话 云顶现在不是“起飞”， 而是“开始有人把跑道清出来”。

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 意思拆解: 云顶现在适合“提前蹲”，但不适合“追确认”。 1️⃣ “提前蹲” - 就是 提前布局 / 慢慢建仓 - 把仓位慢慢放进去 - 因为你判断股价未来可能有机会，但现在还没完全起飞 - 强调的是 耐心和提前准备 2️⃣ “追确认” - 就是 等股价完全确认趋势再追高 - 一旦等到大家都确认，股价可能已经涨了很高 - 这个阶段再进去，风险高、收益可能少 总结一句话 云顶现在还没完全启动，但趋势雏形已现，适合慢慢布局，不适合等到股价确认再冲进去，否则成本高、机会少。

body: Genting Bhd and its subsidiaries were downgraded in December 2025 by major credit rating agencies primarily due to increased debt from a takeover bid for Genting Malaysia (GENM) and high capital expenditure for major projects in New York and Singapore.

author: magellan
body: Debt-Funded Acquisition of Genting Malaysia. Genting Bhd launched a RM6.7 billion bid to privatize Genting Malaysia. Massive Capital Expenditure (Capex): New York Expansion Following the award of a full commercial casino license in New York, GB is committed to a US$5.5 billion (approx. RM23.2 billion) expansion project. Singapore Rejuvenation Genting Singapore is undergoing a S$6.8 billion expansion of Resorts World Sentosa (RWS 2.0). Energy Projects Significant investments are also being made in a floating liquefied natural gas (FLNG) facility in Indonesia. Weakened Credit Agencies noted that the group's "growth approach" has pushed leverage beyond safe thresholds. Moody’s projected debt-to-EBITDA to rise to 4.9x in 2025, exceeding the 4.0x trigger for a downgrade. Negative Cash Flow S&P Global predicts the group's discretionary cash flow will remain negative over the next three years, with total debt potentially rising to RM35 billion by 2028.

body: Genting Resorts World Catskills hotel’s US$561 mil municipal bond sale delayed over merger (Oct 23): Genting Group’s plan to sell the hotel and other non-casino assets at its Resorts World Catskills site to a government development corporation in New York’s Sullivan County has been put on hold until early January, again delaying a US$561 million (RM2.37 billion) municipal bond sale. The transaction is being postponed because Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) has proposed buying out investors in its Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) subsidiary, and can’t enter into other material transactions in the meantime, Walter Bogumil, chief financial officer of Resorts World US, said in a letter that was read at a meeting of the Sullivan County Resorts Facilities Local Development Corp on Monday (Oct 20). The corporation had planned to issue municipal bonds to acquire the non-gaming assets of the casino which includes hotel rooms, an event centre, spa and golf course. The bond sale had already been delayed twice to answer investor questions. Conclusion: Something will happen this month, it's either a merger between Genting and Genm or the sale of Resort World Catskillls non-casino assets. I think either case will be good for Genting. author: jameskhor
body: 1️⃣ Investment (Non-subsidiary) Used when the investor does NOT control the company. (a) Passive investment Ownership: usually < 20% Control: none / minimal Accounting treatment: IFRS 9 – Financial Instruments Measured at: FVPL (fair value through P&L), or FVOCI (fair value through OCI, equity instruments) No consolidation Dividend → income Example: Buy 5% of a listed company shares. (b) Associate Ownership: usually 20%–50% Control: significant influence, but not control Accounting treatment: IAS 28 – Equity method Recognise: Share of profit/loss Carrying value adjusted over time Not consolidated line-by-line Example: Own 30%, board seat, influence strategy. 2️⃣ Subsidiary A company is a subsidiary when the parent has control, regardless of %. Control exists if ALL apply (IFRS 10): Power over relevant activities Exposure to variable returns Ability to use power to affect returns 👉 Usually >50%, but can be <50% if control exists. Accounting treatment: IFRS 10 – Full consolidation Combine: Assets Liabilities Revenue Expenses Show NCI (Non-controlling interest) separately Example: Own 45% but control board & operations → still subsidiary. keyman sifu how you get loss of 400m mind share ?
