author: LimGohTong88
body: Here’s the latest and most accurate interpretation of that tax clause RWNYC included in its New York casino licence bid — and what it actually means for their tax rate if/when other casinos open: � Yogonet +1 ✅ How the Tax Clause Is Written (Based on RWNYC’s Application) Resorts World voluntarily proposed very high tax rates in its bid — 56 % on slot revenue and 30 % on table game revenue — which are well above the statutory minimums (25 % for slots and 10 % for other gaming). � Yogonet But RWNYC’s application includes this specific clause: If other Downstate Licensees open with lower tax rates on slots or tables, RWNYC’s tax rate should also be lowered because all proposed sites are close together and the same tax rate should apply to maintain a level playing field and avoid cannibalization. � Yogonet So the intent is tax parity across operators once the competitive landscape normalises. 📌 Does that automatically change RWNYC’s tax rate? No — it does not automatically reduce RWNYC’s tax rate to the lower rates proposed by other bidders. Here’s why: ✔️ 1. The clause is a proposal It’s part of RWNYC’s licence application, not statutory law or a binding regulation. It sets out RWNYC’s preference/condition, not a guaranteed outcome. Regulators still decide final rates. � Yogonet ✔️ 2. It only comes into effect once other casinos are operating RWNYC’s formulation is conditional: RWNYC accepts the high tax rates until other full-scale commercial casinos open. The parity adjustment (to lower rates) is tied to when those competitors actually start operations — not merely when they are licensed. � CasinoBeats That means: ✔ RWNYC pays its bid tax rates (56 %/30 %) while it remains the only open casino. ↳ No automatic downward shift just because others licensed — they must be operational. � Yogonet ✔️ 3. Regulators determine final tax conditions The New York Gaming Commission (NYGC) and the Gaming Facility Location Board ultimately set/approve tax terms. RWNYC’s clause expresses a desire for parity but does not legally compel automatic adoption of lower rates by rule. The regulatory body could accept, modify, or reject the proposal — and they make that decision at license award. � Gaming Facility Location Board 🧠 What This Means in Practice 🟡 Before other casinos open (likely until 2030) RWNYC would pay its bid rates (56 % slots / 30 % tables) if selected. That applies even if other bidders win licences but haven’t opened their casinos. � Yogonet 🟢 Once competitors start operations RWNYC’s clause says it would like its rates aligned with theirs. If e.g., Metropolitan Park opens paying 25 %/10 %, RWNYC would seek the same. But that equalisation depends on the regulator’s acceptance of RWNYC’s parity request. It’s not automatic without regulatory action. � CasinoBeats 🧩 Bottom Line — The Two Key Points RWNYC’s tax rate won’t automatically fall to 25 %/10 % just because other bidders proposed those rates. Any tax parity would only come — if approved — after other casinos are operating, and only if the regulator agrees to implement RWNYC’s parity clause. 🧠 Practical Implication RWNYC could be on the hook for its high negotiated rates for years before competitors open, potentially generating very large tax contributions to the state early. Only later — after other casinos begin business — might lower rates apply, and then only if regulators formally adopt RWNYC's parity condition.

author: JJRJSS99
body: PETALING JAYA: CIMB Research has upgraded Genting Malaysia Bhd to “buy” from “hold”. The research house also raised its target price for the integrated casino resort operator by 6% to RM2.70. Last month, Genting Malaysia was awarded a full licence for its of Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) operations, currently operating as a” racino”, a combined horse racing track or other live betting facility. The company has allocated US$5.5bil to convert the racino into an integrated casino resort, the first phase of which is expected to start operations in the second quarter of this year. CIMB Research said its higher target price factored in the earnings boost from the RWNYC casino operations. This was partly offset by a rollback in the assumption of a US$300mil debt reduction for the company’s Empire Resorts Inc, which owns Resorts World Catskills (RWC), following a delay in the sale of RWC’s non-gaming assets. “We acknowledge that Genting Malaysia’s share price may take some time to re-rate as investors could stay on the sidelines until Genting Malaysia delivers strong core earnings-per-share (EPS) growth in 2027, driven by RWNYC,” the research house said. It also does not expect dividends in the 2025 and 2027 time frame, as the company conserves cash to reduce debt and partly fund RWNYC’s expansion. The shares currently trade at 7.4 times enterprise value over forecast earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation for this year, or a 20% discount to its 10-year pre-Covid 19 mean. The research house has cut this year’s core EPS forecast by 8% to factor in the higher interest cost on debt raised by RWNYC to pay for the upfront licence fee and capital expenditure for the initial phase of expansion, while taking into consideration that new table games (250 out of a total 800) would not be sufficient to offset the impact. “However, we have raised our core EPS estimate for next year by 25% on the full-year impact from table-games operation and an increase to 400 tables by next January. “After the revisions, we expect Genting Malaysia’s core EPS to dip slightly by 1% year-on-year (y-o-y) this year before surging 39% y-o-y in 2027,” the research house added. In the third quarter ended Sept 30 last year (3Q25), Genting Malaysia’s net profit dropped 79% y-o-y to RM119.7mil, mainly due to lower foreign exchange gains. This translated to an earnings per share of 2.11 sen. This was despite higher revenue, which increased by 22% y-o-y to RM3.4bil, contributed by better performance from the leisure and hospitality business in Malaysia, Britain, Egypt, the United States and the Bahamas. In Malaysia, the group’s leisure and hospitality operations recorded a 19% increase in revenue to RM1.99bil, mainly driven by higher overall business volumes in the gaming segment at Resorts World Genting. For the nine-month period ended Sept 30, 2025 (9M25), the group’s net profit fell by 14% to RM609mil, or an earnings per share of 10.75 sen. Revenue saw an 8% uptick y-o-y to RM8.9bil in the 9M25, mainly from the leisure and hospitality businesses across all geographical segments due to a higher volume of business.

Professor Claude Wischik, TauRx Co-Founder and Chairman, who is lead author of the paper, said: “These results show HMTM has the potential to offer an accessible oral treatment option with a benign safety profile which could be delivered with minimal patient or physician burden. “The study also found starting HMTM treatment early in the disease process is important for preservation of cognitive function and that it impacts the underlying disease process in AD. “This study confirms results from earlier trials showing that HMTM has a benign safety profile, with headache (1.5%) and diarrhoea (1.2%) reported as the most frequent adverse effects.” The trial evaluated the safety and efficacy of HMTM in 598 participants with MCI and mild to moderate dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease. All participants were amyloid β-PET positive, with 44% (263) meeting the clinical criteria for MCI due to AD, and 56% (335) diagnosed with mild to moderate dementia due to AD.

author: calvininvestor
body: Interesting to join discussion here talk about how stronger MYR impact to thier financial report A strengthening MYR is beneficial for companies with a high proportion of USD-denominated debt. Since most depreciation and finance costs are in USD, a stronger MYR reduces the translated value of USD borrowings, making the balance sheet look healthier with lower net debt and improved gearing ratios. On the P&L side, the revaluation of USD debt can result in foreign exchange gains, while USD interest expenses translate into lower MYR finance costs. Overall, the balance sheet becomes more attractive, and earnings benefit from both forex gains and reduced finance expenses, although the forex gains are largely unrealised unless the debt is repaid .

author: calvininvestor
body: ROE (Return on Equity) only measures the return generated on the shareholders’ equity in the company. ROE = Net Income ÷ Shareholders’ Equity Shareholders’ Equity = initial capital + retained earnings – dividends If you want to show a high ROE, the company can: Reduce shares (share buyback) → lowers equity. Distribute all retained earnings as dividends → prevents equity from growing. Result: Equity is smaller, but net income remains the same → ROE looks very high.

author: Daim88
body: Here's the original report from NIH site. 2026 Jan 21;13(3):100480. doi: 10.1016/j.tjpad.2026.100480. Online ahead of print. Clinical, imaging and blood biomarker outcomes in a Phase 3 clinical trial of tau aggregation inhibitor hydromethylthionine mesylate in mild cognitive impairment and mild to moderate dementia due to Alzheimer's disease Background: Hydromethylthionine mesylate (HMTM) targets tau pathology and has tau-independent symptomatic activity. Objectives: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of HMTM in participants with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and mild to moderate dementia due to Alzheimer's disease (AD). Setting: 82 centres in Canada, European Union, United Kingdom and United States of America. Participants: A total of 598 amyloid β-PET positive participants were included; 44% (263) met clinical criteria for MCI due to Alzheimer's disease and 56% (335) were diagnosed with mild to moderate dementia due to AD. Intervention: HMTM 16 mg/day and 8 mg/day were compared with methylthioninium chloride (MTC) 4 mg twice weekly, intended as an inactive urinary colourant to preserve blinding with respect to possible urinary discolouration caused by HMTM. Measurements: HMTM and MTC were compared on cognitive and functional endpoints for the first 52 weeks followed by all receiving HMTM 16 mg/day to 104 weeks in a modified delayed-start trial design. Biomarker outcomes included change in plasma levels of neurofilament light chain (NfL), pTau217 and MRI measures of grey matter atrophy. Results: It was not possible to demonstrate significant differences on the co-primary clinical endpoints (ADAS-cog11 and ADCS-ADL23) at 52 weeks due to symptomatic activity in the control arm. In participants with MCI, statistically significant differences in cognitive decline (ADAS-cog13) emerged at 78 weeks (p = 0·0291) and 104 weeks (p = 0·0308) between early- and delayed-start HMTM 16 mg/day in analyses specified prior to the 24-month database lock. Statistically significant cognitive improvement over baseline score was sustained for 78 weeks in the early start MCI group, with no significant cognitive or functional decline to 104 weeks. There was a significant reduction in progression of neurodegeneration measured by NfL change (p = 0·0291) at 52 weeks in the whole population, consistent with significant reductions in progression of grey matter atrophy at 52 and 104 weeks, and a reduction in progression of tau pathology (pTau217, p = 0·0165) in MCI. Headache (1·5%) and diarrhoea (1·2%) were the most frequent adverse effects. Conclusions: Although HMTM 16 mg/day arrested progression of neurodegeneration and reduced grey matter atrophy at 52 weeks, symptomatic activity in the control arm precluded separation of treatment arms at 52 weeks on primary clinical endpoints. In participants with MCI, significant clinical separation was seen only at 78 and 104 weeks. This effect has been confirmed in a further study. HMTM was well tolerated and has the potential to offer an accessible oral treatment option with a benign safety profile which could be delivered with minimal patient/physician burden.

author: Daim88
body: Let's compares Taurx versus the recently approved anti-amyloid drugs like Lecanemab Safety Profile Comparison 1. HMTM (Hydromethylthionine mesylate) Primary Safety Risk Benign. No reported risk of brain swelling or bleeding. ARIA-E (Brain Edema) 0% reported in trials. ARIA-H (Microbleeds) 0% reported in trials. Common Side Effects Mild: Headache (1.5%) and Diarrhoea (1.2%). Administration Oral Pill taken twice daily. Monitoring Needs Minimal. Does not require regular MRI safety scans. Genomic Risk No known specific risk based on APOE status. 2. Lecanemab (Leqembi) Primary Safety Risk ARIA. High risk of brain swelling (ARIA-E) and microbleeds (ARIA-H). ARIA-E (Brain Edema) 12.6% – 20.6% of patients. ARIA-H (Microbleeds) 17.3% – 26.8% of patients. Common Side Effects Infusion reactions (26.4%), Headaches (10%–25%), and Falls. Administration IV Infusion every two weeks. Monitoring Needs Intensive. Requires frequent MRI scans to check for brain bleeds. Genomic Risk APOE4 carriers (especially homozygotes) have a significantly higher risk of severe ARIA. Taurx beat Lecanemab on every single aspect. It's like comparing the best vs the worst student in class.

author: Daim88
body: A Special Meeting of the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation (LDC) is scheduled for Monday, February 9, 2026. This meeting is critical as it serves as the official forum for the bond auction regarding the Resorts World Catskills project. Follow-up Meeting Schedule In addition to the special meeting on the 9th, the following sequence of events is scheduled to finalize the bond issuance: February 10–11, 2026: These dates are designated for bond pricing and book building. During this phase, the final interest rates and the level of investor demand for the bonds will be determined. February 10, 2026: The Sullivan County Legislature has several committee meetings scheduled starting at 9:00 AM, including the Human Resources and Management & Budget committees, which may oversee related fiscal impacts. Key Updates for the Meetings Restructured Deal: The bond has been restructured to include interest payment guarantees by Genting to mitigate earlier investor concerns regarding the resort's financial viability.

author: Daim88
body: According to the official Sullivan County IDA Meeting Calendar, the Sullivan County Industrial Development Agency (IDA) and likely the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation (LDC) are scheduled to meet on this date. Meeting Details Purpose: Discussion regarding the Resorts World Catskills bond issue. Bond Auction & Pricing: Community reports indicate this meeting will address the bond auction, with bond pricing and book building potentially following on February 10–11. Restructuring: The deal has reportedly been restructured to include guaranteed interest payments by Genting to alleviate investor concerns regarding the resort's financial stability. Context of the Meeting This meeting follows the October 2025 decision to shelve the $585 million bond issuance due to corporate restructuring at Genting Bhd. The goal of the bond sale is for the LDC to acquire non-gaming assets (hotel, golf course, event center) to provide the resort with long-term financial relief.

Leqem­bi gen­er­at­ed $134 mil­lion in fourth-quar­ter sales world­wide in 2025, jump­ing 54% from the pre­vi­ous year and 11% from the third quar­ter. The re­port comes af­ter Ei­sai last year slashed its Leqem­bi sales fore­casts for 2027 in half, cit­ing “de­layed up­take in the US mar­ket.” Bio­gen CEO Chris Viehbach­er, speak­ing dur­ing his com­pa­ny’s fourth-quar­ter earn­ings call, at­trib­uted the rise to the pro­por­tion of pa­tients who kept tak­ing Leqem­bi af­ter the ini­tial 18-month treat­ment pe­ri­od. About 70% of pa­tients pro­ceed­ed in­to what’s known as the main­te­nance phase, Bio­gen es­ti­mates. “We don't re­al­ly have clear da­ta about how many pa­tients ac­tu­al­ly go on to main­te­nance, since we re­al­ly on­ly know how many vials we sell,” Viehbach­er said. “But the da­ta that we do have sug­gests that there is this per­sis­ten­cy of about 70%.”

author: BeCoolFST
body: ATK, 1. GEN US is either making a small loss or no loss at all when considering the region performance as a whole. Therefore, the inidividual loss suffer by ER/Catskill is partly/fully mitigated by other operations in US. 2. Given the above, it actually make sense to maintain existing team of dealers. In my opinion, there are several advantages to doing this a - Since, losses are mitgated, cost is minimized in maintaining the existing dealers b- Maintaining existing dealers in anticipation of the New York license can maintain loyalty and trust between employer and employee. c - Existing dealers would have familiarised themselves with the working culture and environment of the GEN US by the time they are transferred to New York. Money cannot buy this. Common by laws also requires internal company training for new hire which will further delay effective contribution. d - According to your given timeline on training new dealers, there is no guarantee for this. Several factors will cause a delay to the hiring/training of new dealers: (i) uncertain interest of new applicants to train to become dealers, (ii) possibility of progress delay in the successful training of dealers beyond the minimum time needed, (iii) uncertain interest of existing dealers to join the new company (GEN New York). If New York is desperate, they would have to increase hiring cost to entice more applicants to take up the offer and this would eventually cost more than maintaining the existing team of dealers at ER/Catskill and later transfer them to New York. e - Bear in mind, even in item d, not everyone is willing to transfer. 3. So you see, it is not easy to transfer all dealers from ER/Catskill to New York, let alone doing a new hiring which comes with its own set of challenges. 4. Judging by the uncertainties above, it makes a lot of sense to me to take in some losses, which is partly mitgated by other US operations, because eventually you are able to better manage the onboarding of dealers for effective contributions. There are still uncertainty in this scenario, as with all plannings, but this scenarios represent the path that is most easily managed. 5. Finally, the only "twisting" here is your choice of words. There are multiple angles to look at one thing. Be mindful of your choice of words because it only lower your own character

author: ImCK
body: @DestinyL different question It might given different answer Here is response from gemini AI if asking is genting involve first light casino Yes, Genting Malaysia Berhad (a subsidiary of the Genting Group) has been heavily involved in the First Light Resort and Casino project in Taunton, Massachusetts, primarily as a financial backer and manager. However, the relationship has been complex due to long-standing legal battles regarding the tribal land's status. Here is the current breakdown of their involvement: 1. Financial Backer Genting has served as the primary financier for the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe, the project's developers. Over the years, Genting has invested hundreds of millions of dollars (estimated at over US$400 million by 2024/2025) in interest-bearing promissory notes to fund the initial development and legal costs. 2. Management Agreement Genting Malaysia was originally appointed to manage the casino for a period of seven years once it opened. Because the tribe is a sovereign nation, Genting does not own "equity" in the casino itself, but they receive interest on their loans and would receive management fees from the operations. 3. Current Status (as of 2026) A "Soft" Opening: In January 2025, the tribe opened a "Welcome Center" that serves as a temporary casino with a small number of slot machines. Funding Uncertainty: While Genting remains the tribe's historical partner, reports in recent years have indicated periods where Genting scaled back or halted funding due to the project's legal volatility. However, as of the most recent 2025 shareholder meetings, Genting continues to monitor the project and provide support as the tribe moves through multi-phase expansion plans. Legal Wins: The project was stalled for years by federal court rulings, but recent decisions have reaffirmed the tribe's land-in-trust status, allowing construction and gaming to resume on a smaller scale. Here is the real story from IB statement Genting Malaysia had in April 2016 subscribed to interest-bearing promissory notes issued by the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe in order to help finance construction of the casino project. For its US$426.3 million investment, the company was to be paid interest of between 12% and 18% per annum as well as managing casino operations for at least seven years for 30% of EBIT. However, Genting Malaysia was forced to write off its investment as an impairment loss in 2018 after the US Department of Interior (DOI) ruled the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe could not develop its planned casino because it did not satisfy the conditions under the Indian Reorganization Act that allow the Tribe to have the land in trust for an integrated gaming resort development. Genting also forfeited around US$62 million per year in interest payments. If the promissory notes are written back, Yin said Maybank IB’s core net profit estimates would be boosted by around MYR180 (US$38.5 million) annually. By right the casino resume & expanding in future will contribute more cash flow for sure . this summer AGM can ask management in more detail .

body: New reports confirm that Mark Zuckerberg earned an official salary of just 1 dollar from Meta throughout 2023, continuing a compensation approach he has followed for several years. The symbolic salary reflects his focus on long term company performance rather than traditional executive pay. Instead of relying on yearly income, Zuckerberg’s net worth rises or falls with Meta’s stock value. Industry analysts say this choice aligns with a broader trend among major tech founders who prefer equity based rewards. Supporters argue that taking only 1 dollar sends a strong message about confidence in Meta’s future. Critics note that while the gesture is notable, massive equity holdings still provide substantial financial security. Even so, the decision often becomes a talking point whenever executive compensation and corporate governance enter public debate. For Zuckerberg, the 1 dollar salary highlights a leadership philosophy centered on growth, innovation, and long term vision. It also reinforces the idea that the success of Meta directly shapes his personal financial path. As conversations continue about fairness, transparency, and responsibility in tech leadership, this symbolic move remains one of the most recognized parts of his public image. On ~$15B op ex baseline:30% labor = $4.5B (more realistic baseline). 35% labor = $5.25B. projected annual savings:On your $3B (20%) HR baseline: $900M (as you calculated)—still solid and cautious. On a more realistic $4.5B (30%) HR: $1.35B savings at 30% reduction. On $5.25B (35%): $1.575B savings. Net Saving: $900M–$1.6B annual range, with $900M as the lower-bound conservative case. author: Michaelchan2024
body: Possibility of closure of the Strait of Hormuz by Iran

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Chances are rising that the Iranians may try to close the Strait of Hormuz, through which much of the region’s oil and gas is exported. The naval units of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps rehearsed precisely such a closure of the Strait in early February, and there are indications that the Iranians have moved missile batteries to the Strait.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: The US enjoys a huge military superiority in the region. However, a closure of the Strait won’t take much effort; all the Iranians need to do is announce that they have mined the waters around this key international passage and, even if this is untrue, the announcement would effectively halt the movement of oil and liquefied natural gas through the waterway, as well as send the price of oil and the insurance prices of oil tankers soaring. The decision of the Houthis in Yemen – widely viewed as an Iranian proxy – to resume their closure of the straits out of the Red Sea will only increase the shipping pressure.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 《联合早报》整理了美伊冲突对能源市场带来的可能影响： 1）伊朗作为主要产油国与制裁影响： 尽管自1970年代以来产量因美国制裁大幅下降，伊朗目前仍是全球十大产油国之一，日产约310万桶，并拥有世界第三大原油储量，战略地位显著。 伊朗的石油开采成本极低，约为每桶10美元，在全球油价高涨时能带来巨额利润。然而，美国自1979年革命以来实施的制裁，特别是特朗普政府恢复的“极限施压”政策，限制了伊朗的出口选择。 目前，伊朗每日出口130万至150万桶原油，其中超过80%流向中国炼油厂，且价格低于市场价。 2）霍尔木兹海峡的潜在风险： 对全球石油市场而言，美伊冲突最主要的风险是伊朗屡次威胁要瘫痪的霍尔木兹海峡被封锁。 这条海峡连接波斯湾和阿曼湾，是中东主要产油国向世界其他地区输送石油的重要航道。堪称全球能源“命脉”。 在2024年，每天约有2000万桶原油通过这条海峡，相当于全球液体石油消费量的近20%。 由于它的狭窄（约50公里）和较浅（不超过60米）的地理特点，使它极易受攻击，即使是安全疑虑也会导致保险费用急剧上涨，从而严重阻碍船只通行。 目前，只有沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国拥有可行的替代输油设施，但它们的最大输送能力仅为每日260万桶，远不足以替代海峡的巨大吞吐量。 3）地区与全球经济影响： 对伊朗邻国而言，由于美国军事基地设在它们境内，它们担心伊朗可能采取报复行动，关键基础设施如油气枢纽、发电厂和海水淡化厂都面临风险。 从全球来看，油价飙升可能导致通货膨胀卷土重来，损害全球经济。 历史先例显示，1990年海湾战争、2019年沙特石油设施遇袭等历史事件中，中东地缘紧张会导致油价急剧上涨。例如海湾战争期间，布伦特原油价格暴涨近70%；2019年沙特阿美石油设施遇袭后，油价短期内飙升超20%。 如果原油价格自2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以来首次突破每桶100美元的水平，还可能对承诺提供廉价能源的美国总统特朗普在年底中期选举中造成不利影响。 总结地看，美伊冲突不仅对原油供应和价格产生直接而剧烈的影响，更可能引发连锁反应，加剧地缘政治紧张局势，并对全球经济和地区稳定构成严峻挑战。

author: Daim88
body: Genting will be major regional oil and gas/fertilizer player in 2 months. Based on reports surrounding Genting's Kasuri Block project in Indonesia, the unit is expected to become a major earnings contributor starting in 2026. While specific, audited profit figures for a $100 oil price scenario are not explicitly disclosed, projected figures at high energy prices indicate significant profitability. Projected Revenue: The energy division (comprising oil & gas) has the potential to generate approximately US$1.3 billion in revenue, driven by high gas prices and the commissioning of the Floating Liquefied Natural Gas (FLNG) facility in West Papua, Indonesia. Profit Potential: The 1.2 million-tonne-per-annum (mtpa) FLNG facility is expected to boost earnings for the group by approximately US$141 million annually. Production Capacity: The Kasuri block is set to produce around 330 million standard cubic feet per day (MSCFD) from 2027, with the first drop of LNG expected in the first half of 2026. Contractual Details: The project involves supplying natural gas to a floating LNG facility (230 mmcfd) and a domestic ammonia/urea plant (101 mmcfd), secured by a production sharing contract with Indonesia's SKK Migas. The Kasuri block's success is heavily linked to the completion of the FLNG facility, which is aimed for Q3 2026. High energy prices (e.g., $100 oil equivalent) would make the project highly profitable, with potential revenue accretion as high as RM2.64 billion (roughly US$560M) annually for the group based on some analyst projections.

Anyhow, given that Genting has so much potential and so many values waiting to be unlocked in the coming months, I wouldn't be surprised if Genting can climb back to RM 5 in the next few months. body: Aside from the Kasuri block in West Papua, Indonesia, Genting Berhad is involved in other oil and gas projects, primarily through its subsidiary, Genting Oil & Gas Limited. Their key operations outside of the Kasuri block include: Chengdaoxi Block (China): Genting operates an oil-producing field located in the shallow waters of Bohai Bay, China. This project involves a 49% working interest, which produced approximately 1.3 million barrels of oil (net to Genting) in 2024. Floating LNG Facility (Indonesia): While this is technically part of the overall Kasuri project, it is a massive, distinct project under construction by PT Layar Nusantara Gas (a 95%-owned indirect unit) and involves a 1.2 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) Floating Liquefied Natural Gas (FLNG) facility being built by Wison New Energies. Downstream Infrastructure (Indonesia): As part of the Kasuri block development, Genting is also involved in supplying natural gas for an Ammonia and Urea plant planned for construction in West Papua. Genting's energy division (Genting Energy) is also active in power generation, including coal-fired and wind power plants in Indonesia, China, and India.

author: Daim88
body: Recently there has been a bit of news about anti-amyloid drug online like below ->Hopeful new Alzheimer’s drugs face fresh scrutiny after researchers found little real-world benefit despite reducing amyloid plaques. ->"The analysis of clinical trials in people with mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia found that the effects of anti-amyloid drugs on cognition and dementia severity over 18 months were “trivial”, with improvements in functional ability “small at best”." This has risen the prospect of Taurx or other tau targeting drug becoming only game in town given the high risk of brain swelling/bleeding that come along with anti-amyloid drug. Metric TauRx (HMTM) Lecanemab / Donanemab Primary Target Tau Aggregation (Tangles) Amyloid Beta (Plaques) Key Result 82% reduction in clinical decline (CDR-SB) at 24 months. 27% – 35% slowing of decline at 18 months. Cognitive Outcome Improvement over baseline sustained for 18 months in MCI. Significant slowing but continued decline from baseline. Biomarker Impact 93% reduction in NfL change; 35% reduced brain atrophy. Clear amyloid removal on PET; consistent reduction in p-tau. Looking at the side-by-side comparison Taurx beat anti-amyloid on every aspect. The most interesting observation found that Taurx has the potential to reverse cognitive decline not just stopping it. I suggest you all hold on tight to your Genting tickets for the next 4 months where MHRA decision is likely expected. Aside from Taurx, there're plenty of surprises lining up as well in the next 2-6 months, FLNG coming online, Resort World New York coming online, Genting Malaysia privatization, and other new income source. There is serious potential for Genting to double up, triple up or even quadruple up.

author: Daim88
body: Recently there has been talks about the long period for Taurx approval process. I would like to point out that it is perfectly normal for approval to take this long especially depending on the complexity that involved. Medicines with MHRA Approval Timelines Exceeding 2 Years Tepotinib (Tepmetko) Timeline: ~2.5 years (30 months) Mavacamten (Camzyos) Timeline: ~2 years (24+ months) Aripiprazole (Abilify Maintena 960mg) Timeline: ~2 years Mirikizumab (Omvoh) Timeline: ~2 years Generic Teriparatide (Sondelbay) Timeline: ~2.5 years TauRx officially submitted its Marketing Authorisation Application (MAA) for HMTM on 01 July 2024. As of today, 18 April 2026, the application has been under review for approximately 21.5 months (656 days). Current Application Status While the application was initially accepted for an accelerated 150-day review in July 2024, the timeline has been extended due to standard regulatory "clock-stops": Request for Information (RFI): The MHRA issued a formal request for further data to confirm the drug's suitability. Response Submission: TauRx finalized and submitted its comprehensive responses to the RFI in June 2025. Current Phase: The application is back with the MHRA for final determination. Expected Decision Timeline Based on the typical time needed for the MHRA to evaluate major RFI responses for complex neurology drugs, a final decision is anticipated in mid-2026. MHRA Determination: Likely between May and July 2026. The company recently met with government officials in March 2026, signaling that the regulatory journey is in its final stages. NICE Recommendation: The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) is already preparing for a potential rollout, with funding decisions typically following 90 days after MHRA approval.

Scientific American's post - short Drugs that were once hailed as possible breakthroughs in the battle to treat Alzheimer’s have no meaningful clinical effect on the disease’s progression, a new Cochrane review found. Cochrane reviews have a reputation in the medical and life sciences fields as a gold-standard, independent analysis of the evidence for and against specific health interventions or treatments. The drugs assessed in the new review, published on Thursday, target beta-amyloid proteins, which form plaques that seem to accumulate in the brains of people with Alzheimer’s. The drugs not only seem to have no beneficial effect but also increase the risk of brain bleeding and swelling, the review found.

author: abc333
body: Recent clinical scrutiny has exposed the limitations of Amyloid-targeted therapies, which offer only marginal cognitive benefits alongside severe safety risks. As the industry pivots away from these flawed hypotheses, TauRx’s HMTM stands out as the premier alternative. By directly inhibiting Tau aggregation with a superior safety profile, it represents the most viable path to stabilizing Alzheimer’s. Global pharmaceutical giants have clearly recognized this intrinsic value; they see in TauRx a rare strategic asset that combines molecular efficacy with oral accessibility. Whether through regulatory breakthrough or imminent acquisition, HMTM is now positioned as the definitive gold standard for the next generation of dementia care.

body: Reports from CDC Gaming and other industry sources on April 20, 2026, confirm that Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) is set to launch live table games next week. ​Here is a breakdown of the situation: ​The Details ​Launch Date: The "live" table games (Blackjack, Baccarat, Roulette, etc.) are scheduled to open next Tuesday (April 28, 2026). ​Historical Context: This marks the transition of RWNYC from a "racino" (which only allowed video lottery terminals and electronic table games) to a full-fledged commercial casino. ​The Catalyst: Genting New York LLC was approved for a full commercial casino license by the New York State Gaming Commission. This followed a rigorous selection process where they were one of the three winning bidders for the downstate New York licenses. ​Why This Matters for Investors ​Revenue Boost: Analysts (including Fitch) estimate that the addition of live table games could significantly ramp up earnings, with projected EBITDA of approximately US$215 million for 2026 and reaching over US$460 million by 2028. ​Competitive Edge: Being the first in New York City to offer "live" dealers gives Genting a massive head start over potential competitors who are still in the early stages of development. ​Stock Sentiment: For holders of Genting Berhad (3182) or Genting Malaysia (4715), this is a major fundamental milestone that has been anticipated for years.

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: 云顶集团（Genting Berhad）15大潜在爆发点（Super Stock Thesis） ​一、 核心博彩与旅游板块 (Casino & Tourism) ​纽约市名胜世界 (RWNYC) 赌场大奖： 竞逐纽约下州（Downstate New York）正规赌场执照。一旦获批，其电子博彩中心将升级为拥有桌上游戏的完整赌场，估值将大幅跳升。 ​2026 旅游马来西亚年 (Visit Malaysia 2026)： 国家级旅游盛事将吸引大量外籍游客，云顶名胜世界（RWG）作为马来西亚旅游的“心脏”将直接受益。 ​新加坡名胜世界 (RWS) 扩张 2.0： 新加坡圣淘沙名胜世界的升级计划正在推进。随着新设施陆续竣工，将吸引更高消费能力的全球游客。 ​拉斯维加斯名胜世界 (RWLV) 业绩反转： 随着拉斯维加斯大型活动和会展业务回归，RWLV 的入驻率和利润率正在持续改善，进入盈利贡献期。 ​二、 能源与种植板块 (Energy & Plantations) ​Kasuri 区块天然气生产与 FLNG： 在印尼 Kasuri 区块的天然气项目正处于关键期。FLNG（浮式液化天然气设施）建设进度已超过 70%，预计 2026 年贡献首批液化天然气。 ​电力生成板块 (Power Generation)： 集团在中国（如舟山燃气发电厂）及东南亚的电力资产提供极其稳定的现金流。 ​石油生产板块 (Oil Production)： 随着地缘政治局势波动，集团的油气上游资产在油价高企时具备极强的盈利爆发力。 ​棕榈油价格飙升 (Palm Oil Price)： 云顶种植（Genting Plantations）受益于原棕油（CPO）价格的大涨，为集团贡献了丰厚的利润红利。 ​三、 医疗与生物技术 (Medical/Biotech) ​TauRx 医药： 集团持股的 TauRx 正在进行阿尔茨海默症药物（HMTM）的最后阶段审批。这被视为医药界的“圣杯”，一旦成功，云顶将转型为拥有高科技生物资产的巨头。 ​四、 财务政策与市场预期 (Financial & Corporate) ​派息潜力 (Dividend Potential)： 随着资本支出高峰期过去及各业务现金流转正，市场预期云顶将逐步提高派息率，回馈股东。 ​估值差收窄 (Valuation Gap Closure)： 目前云顶（GENT）股价对比其持有的子公司资产（如 RWS、GENM 等）价值有巨大的折价（Holding Co Discount），市场情绪回温将修补这一差距。 ​高呼“低估”股票 (Shouting Undervalued)： 多家投行和分析师指出目前股价并未反映其多元化资产的真正价值。 ​私有化云顶马来西亚 (Genting Malaysia Privatisation)： 市场长期猜测为了优化结构，林氏家族可能会通过母公司私有化云顶马来西亚（GENM），这通常会伴随高溢价。 ​五、 宏观经济红利 (Macro Environment) ​令吉 (MYR) 走强： 强劲的令吉有利于降低进口成本和外债负担，增强马股对外国机构投资者的吸引力。 ​特朗普降息政策预期 (TRUMP Policy)： 若美国推行低利率政策，将全球性地降低融资成本，对于云顶这种重资产、有贷款负债的集团是极大的财务减负。

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: 1. UK (MHRA): The Frontrunner ​The UK is the most likely first win for TauRx. ​The Status: The application is currently under a "150-day accelerated assessment." However, in late 2025, the MHRA requested "supplementary information," which effectively paused the clock. ​Why the high rating? Recent data published in January 2026 (LUCIDITY trial) showed that HMTM significantly slows cognitive decline over 104 weeks. The UK government and the Aberdeen hub are highly motivated to see this succeed as a "British win" in life sciences. ​The Bottleneck: The MHRA is traditionally cautious with Alzheimer’s drugs that lack a traditional placebo group (TauRx used a low-dose "active placebo"). I expect a positive decision by Q3 2026 if the supplementary data satisfies their concerns about the trial design. ​2. USA (FDA): The Higher Bar ​The FDA is a much tougher gatekeeper than the MHRA. ​The Status: TauRx has not yet formally announced a completed New Drug Application (NDA) submission to the FDA, though they are in active talks. ​Why the lower rating? The FDA is "Amyloid-centric." They have recently approved drugs like Leqembi and Donanemab. TauRx’s HMTM targets Tau, which is a different (and many argue better) pathway, but the FDA’s statistical requirements for "placebo-controlled" trials are extremely rigid. ​Expected Deadline: If they file their NDA by mid-2026, a decision (likely after an Advisory Committee meeting) wouldn't arrive until early 2027. ​The Advisor’s "X-Factor" ​There are two things that could swing these percentages dramatically in the coming months: ​The "Oral" Premium: Unlike current approved treatments that require IV infusions (expensive and logistically difficult), TauRx is a pill. Regulators are under immense political pressure to approve a treatment that can be distributed cheaply and easily. This adds a "hidden" +5-10% to their chances. ​The Clinical "Skepticism": Because TauRx used a very low dose of the drug as their "placebo," some scientists argue the results are "muddied." If the MHRA or FDA decides the trial was technically "failed" due to this design choice (even if the drug works), the approval could be denied or delayed by a request for a new trial. ​Final Take: TauRx is currently in the "valley of death" between a successful trial and a regulatory green light. The 75%+ rating for the UK reflects my confidence in the recent January 2026 data and the favorable regulatory environment in Britain. The FDA remains a coin-flip (with a slight edge) until a formal filing date is set.

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: ​1. Resorts World New York City (RWNYC): The "Gold Mine" ​RWNYC is currently the "star pupil" of Genting Malaysia's (GENM) portfolio. ​The Full Casino License: This is the big win. As of early 2026, Genting has secured one of the three full commercial casino licenses in New York. This allows them to move from just "slots" (VLTs) to live dealer table games (Baccarat, Blackjack, etc.). ​Revenue Projection: Analysts expect revenue to jump from US1 billion to US3 billion over the next few years. They are already investing US$1 billion by the end of 2026 to install 400 live tables and 4,000 new machines. ​Domestic Resilience: Because it's located in Queens, it doesn't need "international tourists" to survive. It serves the massive, high-wealth New York domestic population that is currently spending record amounts on local entertainment. ​2. Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV): The "Recovery Play" ​Unlike New York, Vegas depends more on people flying in. However, the current US trend helps here too: ​The "Fly-Domestic" Surge: As Americans opt for "Domestic Milestones" (weddings, big birthdays) over European trips, Vegas remains the #1 destination. RWLV is finally seeing its EBITDA margins improve as room occupancy stabilizes at higher rates. ​Infrastructure Synergy: The Boring Company’s "Vegas Loop" connection and the growing convention business in 2026 are helping RWLV capture a larger share of the domestic business traveler market. ​3. Impact on Genting Berhad & Genting Malaysia ​Since you track these closely, keep these figures in mind for your Q2 2026 reviews: ​Genting Malaysia (GENM): Their US & Bahamas segment is now outperforming their Malaysian operations in terms of growth rate. In Q4 2025, while Malaysian revenue dipped slightly (down 3%), the US operations surged by over 10%. ​The "Forex" Shield: Because these assets earn in USD, they provide a natural hedge for the Group. When the Ringgit is weak, the earnings from New York and Vegas look even better on the Malaysian balance sheet.

body: Looking back from 2027 or 2028, many may regret a 'buy-in, buy-out' strategy driven by short-term volatility. Those with the conviction and holding power to stay the course until then are likely to see substantial rewards. As retail investors, it is vital to maintain a positive mindset and share genuine insights that foster collective success. While some criticize the leadership during periods of underperformance, one cannot ignore how Genting has built a formidable global empire that competes with the world’s elite gaming and hospitality players. Despite inevitable hurdles like Genting HK or the ramp-up of Resorts World Las Vegas, the group's ability to scale internationally remains a testament to its long-term strategic ambition.

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: 1. Unmatched Global Footprint ​Unlike many regional players, Genting is one of the few Asian entities that successfully "exported" its brand. By establishing a presence in Singapore, the UK, the US (New York and Las Vegas), and the Bahamas, the management has diversified its geographical risk. They aren't just a Malaysian success story; they are a global household name in integrated resorts. ​2. Resilience and Crisis Management ​The top management has navigated extreme headwinds, including the COVID-19 pandemic and the total restructuring of their cruise operations (Genting HK). Their ability to keep the core machinery running—Genting Malaysia and Genting Singapore—while simultaneously launching a multi-billion dollar project like Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV) shows incredible financial endurance and operational grit. ​3. Strategic Asset Heavyweight ​The criticism often targets the high capital expenditure (CAPEX) of RWLV. However, in the gaming industry, location and scale are the ultimate moats. By securing a massive footprint on the Las Vegas Strip, the management has ensured that Genting Berhad is positioned for the next 30 to 50 years of tourism growth, not just the next few quarters.

author: Michael Lee
body: ​云顶集团（Genting Berhad）的新皇冠明珠：能源转型全解析 ​1. 盈利质量的本质蜕变 ​长期以来，能源业务在云顶内部仅被视为“副业”，但到 2026 年 4 月，这一格局已发生质变： ​收入多元化： 过去款待业占收入约 80%，但随着中国天然气发电厂及印尼项目的推进，能源板块预计每年将贡献超过 13 亿美元。 ​稳定性 vs. 波动性： 博彩业易受“运气”、政策监管及税收波动影响；而 Kasuri 气田 依托长期固定合约，提供极其稳健的现金流。这使云顶进化为真正的能源玩家，而不再仅仅是赌场运营商。 ​2. Kasuri 区块与 FLNG：区域领先的“先发优势” ​云顶在印尼布局的这手“妙棋”，正被许多投资者忽略： ​“Alam Guyub” FLNG（浮式液化天然气装置）： 截至 2026 年 3 月，工程进度已突破 70%，船体已下水。预计将在 2026 年上半年产出第一滴 LNG（液化天然气）。 ​印尼首创： 这是印尼史上首座 FLNG 设施。作为行业先驱，云顶在与印尼政府（SKK Migas）未来的特许权谈判中拥有巨大的话语权和筹码。 ​垂直整合利润： 通过同时掌控气田（Kasuri）和加工设施（FLNG），云顶实现了从“开采”到“液化”的全产业链利润收割，确保利润最大化。 ​3. 高价值的战略伙伴关系 ​与全球最大的尿素生产商 PT Pupuk Kalimantan Timur 签署的供气协议（GSA）是“定海神针”： ​合同保障： 承诺连续 18 年、每天供应 2.3 亿立方英尺天然气。 ​估值地板： 这种“防弹式”的收入来源，为云顶母股（Genting Berhad）的估值提供了极其稳固的底部支撑。 ​4. 为什么这是为您量身打造的“皇冠明珠”？ ​作为价值投资者，您深知市场往往在“第一桶金”到账前反应迟钝： ​当前情绪： 多数分析师仍停留在用圣淘沙和云顶马来西亚的表现来评估母公司。 ​重估催化剂（Re-rating）： 一旦 FLNG 在今年晚些时候开启商业运营，市场将迎来重大的估值修复。 ​溢价理由： 能源板块符合 ESG 转型趋势且具有高度可预测性，其估值倍数理应高于波动较大的博彩板块。

author: Joe18
body: Issues to raise on coming 58th AGM: 🎰 Genting Singapore – Persistent Underperformance Premium market share has reportedly fallen to a historical low, with competitors generating materially higher EBITDA despite comparable scale. What exactly has gone wrong operationally and strategically, and what is the concrete, time-bound plan to reverse this decline? The ongoing “RWS 2.0” upgrading has been repeatedly cited as justification for weak results. At what point does this explanation cease to be acceptable, and when will shareholders see measurable returns on the multi-billion investment? Despite a strong net cash position, there has been no meaningful return of capital. Is capital being inefficiently retained at the subsidiary level while the holding company faces funding pressures? 🎲 Genting Malaysia – Weak Core Operations Resorts World Genting continues to face declining volumes and rising costs, despite overall reported profit recovery. Why is the Group losing momentum in its core Malaysian asset, and what specific, measurable actions will reverse this trend? Costs appear to be structurally rising faster than revenue. Can Genting commit to a clear margin recovery target and timeline, and what concrete cost actions will deliver this? 🌱 Genting Plantations – Governance&Capital Discipline Failure The RM97 million regulatory fine indicates a serious breakdown in compliance and oversight. Who is accountable for this failure, and what disciplinary or structural actions have been taken? A special dividend was declared despite a sharp earnings collapse. How does the Genting justify distributing capital under such circumstances, and does this reflect a lack of discipline in capital management? 🏢 Genting Berhad – Value Destruction at Holding Level Despite stable revenue, the Group reported losses. Provide a precise breakdown of how much of the loss is attributable to impairments, financing costs, forex, and overheads. Recurring impairments raise serious concerns about investment decisions. Which major investments are currently generating returns below the cost of capital, and why should shareholders believe further impairments will not occur? Given the persistent underperformance across parts of the portfolio: Is the Board prepared to undertake a strategic review, including divestment of underperforming assets, or will capital continue to be deployed without adequate returns? 🤖 Group-Wide – Structural Cost Problem Ignored The Group operates in labour-intensive sectors, yet there is no clear articulation of a technology-driven cost strategy. Has Genting conducted any serious evaluation of AI-driven automation or humanoid robotics to reduce structural labour costs? If so, what are the timelines and targets? If not, why not? Competitors globally are aggressively adopting automation. Is the Group at risk of falling structurally behind due to inaction in this area?

body: 根据《中国报》2026年4月23日的报道，以下是关于云顶纽约赌场开幕详情的深度汇总： ​1. 开幕核心信息 ​开幕日期： 2026年4月28日（下周二）。 ​地点： 位于纽约皇后区（Queens）的纽约云顶世界（Resorts World New York City, RWNYC）。 ​主持嘉宾： 云顶集团执行主席丹斯里林国泰将亲临现场主持剪彩仪式。 ​特别嘉宾： 嘻哈界传奇人物 Nas 也将参与剪彩，共同见证这一历史时刻。 ​2. 设施与规模 ​该赌场的开幕标志着纽约市400年历史上首个商业赌场的诞生。经过重新装潢，设施主要集中在第3层： ​博彩桌： 拥有超过 240张赌台，提供包括廿一点（Blackjack）、骰子（Craps）、百家乐（Baccarat）及轮盘（Roulette）等热门游戏。 ​游戏位置： 总计提供超过 1500个游戏席位。 ​老虎机： 配备了超过 2500部老虎机。 ​仪式亮点： 届时除了剪彩，林国泰还将进行象征性的“掷骰子”仪式，正式开启现场博彩业务。 ​3. 对当地经济与就业的影响 ​为了配合这次业务的质飞跃，云顶大马（GENM）进行了大规模的招聘： ​新增岗位： 成功创造了 1250个新就业岗位，其中包括 950名新聘请的赌台荷官。 ​员工总数： 目前当地员工总数已翻倍至 2200人。 ​未来预期： 预计到2026年夏季，员工人数将进一步增加至 2700人。 ​4. 战略意义 ​此次开幕意味着纽约云顶世界从原本仅提供电子博彩（VLT）的场所，正式转型为拥有现场荷官与赌桌的全功能商业赌场。这不仅增强了其在当地娱乐版图的竞争力，也为云顶集团在北美市场的版图扩张写下了重要的一页。

body: Based on the current regulatory landscape and the recent "anti-amyloid" headlines, here is a personal rating of the success probability for TauRx (HMTM). ​Keep in mind that while the news is a massive narrative win, regulators (MHRA and FDA) focus on specific data endpoints from the LUCIDITY trials. ​1. UK (MHRA) Approval: 75% – 80% ​The UK is currently the "home turf" for TauRx and represents their strongest chance of success. ​The "Cochrane Effect": The recent Bloomberg report highlighting the failure of amyloid drugs (Lilly/Eisai) creates a massive opening for the MHRA. If the UK’s health system (NHS) decides amyloid drugs are too expensive and ineffective, they will be under immense public pressure to approve an alternative. ​Accelerated Pathway: TauRx is currently under a 150-day accelerated assessment. This signals that the MHRA views this as a high-priority, urgent medicine. ​The "Pill" Advantage: The MHRA prefers HMTM’s delivery (a simple daily pill) over the complex, high-risk IV infusions required by competitors. ​Why not 100%? The MHRA is historically rigorous. They will scrutinize whether the "sustained cognitive improvement" seen in the LUCIDITY results (published Jan 2026) is truly significant or just a temporary stabilization. ​2. USA (FDA) Approval: 55% – 60% ​The FDA is a much tougher hurdle, and the path is currently less clear than in the UK. ​Skepticism of Past Data: The FDA has been critical of TauRx in the past, particularly regarding how they analyzed subgroups in earlier trials. While the new LUCIDITY data is stronger, the FDA tends to require very "clean" primary endpoints. ​Political Pressure: The FDA was heavily criticized for its "lax" approval of Aduhelm (the first amyloid drug). Because of that backlash, they may now be over-correcting by being extra harsh on the next wave of Alzheimer's drugs. ​Biomarker Scrutiny: The FDA loves biomarkers. While TauRx showed good results in blood-based biomarkers (NfL and pTau217), the FDA might want to see even more definitive "brain-clearing" evidence before granting full approval. ​Upside: If the UK approves first (which is likely), it puts significant pressure on the FDA to follow suit, especially given the "failure" of the amyloid class they previously championed. ​Comparison Summary

author: WDCQ_I_am_legend
body: The report from the International Energy Agency (IEA) highlights a significant shift in the global energy landscape due to the ongoing conflict involving Iran. The central finding is that the global natural gas market is expected to remain "tight" for at least the next two years, primarily due to infrastructure damage and shipping blockades. ​1. The "Effective Closure" of the Strait of Hormuz ​The conflict has led to the functional closure of the Strait of Hormuz. This is a critical chokepoint for global energy because: ​Volume: Approximately one-fifth of the world's total oil and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) supply passes through this narrow waterway daily. ​Direct Impact: The IEA head, Fatih Birol, described this disruption as the "biggest crisis in history," surpassing previous energy shocks in scale. ​2. Targeted Damage to LNG Infrastructure ​Unlike previous oil shocks that focused on shipping lanes, this crisis involves direct physical damage to production facilities: ​Qatar Strikes: Iranian strikes on the Ras Laffan Industrial City in Qatar—a primary hub for global LNG exports—reduced the country's export capacity by roughly 17%. ​Repair Timeline: Qatar's energy minister indicated that repairing the sophisticated liquefaction equipment could take up to five years. ​Supply Deficit: The IEA estimates a cumulative loss of 120 billion cubic meters of LNG supply through 2030 because of these disruptions. ​3. Impact on Global Markets (2026–2027) ​The report notes that the "expansion wave" of global LNG—which many countries were relying on to lower prices—will now be delayed by at least two years. ​Prolonged Tightness: Markets that were expected to stabilize in 2025 will now remain volatile through 2026 and 2027. ​Demand Destruction: In response to high prices, several Asian countries are already implementing "fuel-switching" measures (moving away from gas to other energy sources) to mitigate costs. ​Comparison to Ukraine Crisis: The IEA noted that while the Russia-Ukraine war removed about 75 billion cubic meters of gas from the market, the current crisis has removed nearly twice that amount (140 BCM). ​4. Why LNG is More Vulnerable than Oil ​The IEA emphasizes that the LNG market is "structurally less resilient" than the oil market for three reasons: ​Lack of Strategic Reserves: Unlike oil, most nations do not have massive underground "strategic stockpiles" of gas to tap into during a war. ​Limited Spare Capacity: Almost all LNG plants worldwide were already running at maximum capacity; there is no "extra" gas ready to be turned on elsewhere. ​Rigid Infrastructure: LNG requires specialized terminals and tankers; you cannot simply reroute it through pipelines or trucks as easily as oil.

body: From a purely market-timing perspective, the current situation is exceptionally favorable for the Genting Kasuri project and its FLNG (Floating LNG) facility. ​If we look at the timeline and the global energy crisis described in the IEA report, Genting is hitting the market at a "perfect storm" moment for a new producer. ​1. Exceptional Market Timing ​The IEA report highlights a supply deficit through 2026 and 2027. Genting’s FLNG facility (the Alam Guyub) is scheduled for: ​Sail-away: Q2 2026. ​First Drop of LNG: Q3 2026. ​Full Production: Right as the "two-year tightness" predicted by the IEA reaches its peak. ​While Qatar and other Middle Eastern giants are dealing with infrastructure damage that could take five years to fix, Genting is bringing 1.2 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of brand-new capacity online in a region (Southeast Asia) that is desperate for stable, non-Middle Eastern supply. ​2. The "Location Premium" ​The report mentions that buyers are now placing a high premium on security of supply by source. ​Geopolitically Safe: Unlike the Strait of Hormuz, the route from West Papua (Teluk Bintuni) to major buyers in North Asia (Japan, Korea, China) does not pass through Middle Eastern chokepoints. ​Lower Freight Costs: Being closer to Asian markets during a time of high energy prices makes Genting’s LNG more competitive and profitable. ​3. Pricing and Revenue Boost ​Since the IEA predicts prices will remain volatile and elevated through 2027: ​Higher Margins: If Genting has uncontracted "spot" volumes or price-indexed contracts, the revenue from the Kasuri block could be significantly higher than originally projected when the $1 billion EPCIC contract was signed in 2024. ​Project De-risking: High global prices make it much easier for Genting to finalize the remaining project financing and recoup its investment quickly. ​4. Strategic Milestone for Indonesia ​As the first FLNG facility in Indonesia, this project was already a "jewel in the crown" for Genting’s diversification. In the current global context, it transforms from a "growth project" into a critical energy asset.

If you are seeking the only one company with the highest probability for significant capital gains right now, the advisor's pick is: ​Genting Berhad (GENT / 3182) ​While there are many stable performers on Bursa, Genting Berhad currently presents a unique "Value Unlock" and "Growth Catalyst" profile that makes it the strongest candidate for capital appreciation in 2026. ​1. The Undervaluation Gap ​As of April 2026, Genting Berhad continues to trade at a significant discount to its SOP (Sum-of-Parts) value. Historically, the parent company trades at a discount to its subsidiaries (Genting Malaysia, Genting Singapore), but this gap has widened excessively. ​The Opportunity: Analysts are currently highlighting a Fair Value Upside of ~64% based on current price targets (averaging around RM4.72, with some high-conviction bulls eyeing higher). ​Price Momentum: The stock has recently seen a ~15% spike following news regarding potential international expansion, suggesting the market is beginning to close that valuation gap. ​2. The New Frontier: International Licensing ​The primary "Capital Gain" engine for Genting in 2026 is its aggressive push into the US market—specifically the New York downstate casino license. ​The Catalyst: Securing a full-scale casino license in New York would be a transformative event, fundamentally re-rating the stock's long-term earnings potential. Even the high probability of this license is currently acting as a floor for the stock price. ​3. Recovery of Global Tourism (VMY 2026) ​With Visit Malaysia Year 2026 in full swing, the domestic leisure and hospitality sector is seeing record-breaking numbers. ​Genting's core assets (Resorts World Genting) are beneficiaries of this influx of high-spending international tourists. ​Their diversified portfolio—including the energy sector (Genting Plantations and energy assets)—provides a robust cash flow buffer that many pure-play hospitality stocks lack. ​4. Technical Setup & Sentiment ​In late April 2026, the technical indicators for Genting Berhad are showing signs of a "breakout" from a long-term consolidation pattern. ​Earnings Growth: Analysts are projecting a 55.5% earnings growth rate for 2026, far outpacing the broader market average of ~10.8%. ​Profitability: After years of post-pandemic recovery, the company is forecast to hit a new peak in profitability, which is the ultimate driver for stock price appreciation. author: AngTayKor
body: Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) has raised US$1.25 billion, or about RM4.96 billion, from perpetual guaranteed notes issued as part of a refinancing exercise. GOHL Capital Holdings Ltd, the funding vehicle, priced two tranches of subordinated perpetual capital securities following its book-building process on April 22, according to Genting’s bourse filing on Thursday. The notes are guaranteed by Genting Overseas Holdings Ltd, a direct unit of Genting. Series 1 Securities (US$750 million) carry a distribution of 7.625%, with a non-call period of 5.5 years — first call date on Oct 29, 2031. Series 2 Securities (US$500 million) carry a distribution of 8.3%, with a non-call period of 10 years — first call date on April 29, 2036. A subordinated keepwell deed, a solvency pledge, will also be signed with Genting. The notes, rated Ba2 by Moody’s and BB+ by Fitch Ratings, are part of its refinancing exercise to extend the group’s debt maturity profile. Earlier this week, the group offered to buy back up to US$1.5 billion (about RM5.93 billion) of its 4.25% notes due in 2027. Proceeds from the new note issuance will go towards repaying the 2027 notes. Shares of Genting rose three sen or 1.19% to RM2.56 at the time of writing on Thursday, valuing the group at RM9.89 billion. Source: TheEdge - 24 Apr 2026 --------------- Rolling over old debts at abt 8% p.a. Have not issued new debts for RWNYC expansion yet, probably at around 8% p.a also.

author: AngTayKor
body: External control using CPAD placebo data under trial TRX-237-080 was already submitted on our earlier RFI submission during end May 2025. Then CHM came back with a new long set of ridiculous RFI questions. Can sense its the EAG members from CHM using dirty tactics trying to veto / delay UK approval progress. But MHRA is on our side as they have given Taurx waiver to skip Organic Anion Transporter pre-phase 1 lab test, but Taurx did this 6 months lab test anyway. HMTM definitely can work. It will go down in history books as a cheap & effective disease modifying AD drug that can work but got delayed by over 10 years because of blue pee effect that we are unable to replicate safely for the entire trial duration for placebo patient group. In Singapore, the paid compassionate program under Dr Siow had abt 50 patients before it was shut down. Years ago, I spoke to the Taurx director in charge of this program to enquire HMTM's performance on those Singapore patients. I was told abt 75% of patients saw cognition score improvement (reversal) compared to their baseline score before taking the drug. Abt 15% patients totally halt cognition score decline. The other 10% patients saw continual decline. This paid compassionate program will start off with 8mg daily dose. After 6 months if no improvement, increase dosage to max 16mg daily. My view is 16mg is still not the optimal dosage especially for more severe patients, and shd be increased to 32mg daily as HMTM's side effects are minimal & non-fatal. We already tried 250mg daily dose on one of our earlier trials, side effects were non-fatal & very manageable but with higher % cases. Anyway the paid compassionate program was already stopped by HSA Health Science Authority Singapore after the approval of lecanemab because there is an approved disease modifying drug & they dont want to risk extending the duration for an unapproved drug. Those government scholars at HSA will not want to further risk their career by sticking their neck out to continue on HMTM's paid compassionate program even though the program's results n safety records were fantastic. Any patients who had brain bleeding & died when using lecanemab is ok because its an approved drug. That's how things work in reality here.

author: AngTayKor
body: A.I: The multi-month gap between the sailaway from Zhoushan and the final commissioning in West Papua is standard for complex offshore projects like the Alam Guyub. This duration accounts for the physical transit, complex installation, and high-risk system testing that can only be done at the gas field.1. Slow Transit via TowingUnlike self-propelled cargo ships that take 7 to 14 days, the FLNG vessel has no independent propulsion. It must be towed by specialized tugboats from China to West Papua. This is a slow, high-caution operation that is highly dependent on favorable weather and sea conditions.2. On-Site Installation and MooringOnce the vessel arrives at Teluk Bintuni, it isn't ready to operate immediately. It must be:Moored: Secured to its permanent location using a specialized turret mooring system.Connected: Hooked up to the undersea pipelines from the Asap, Kido, and Merah (AKM) gas fields.3. Site-Specific Commissioning TestsA major portion of the "missing months" is dedicated to final commissioning tests that cannot be performed at the shipyard.Gas-In Operations: For the first time, actual "feed gas" from the local reservoir is injected into the facility to test the entire processing and liquefaction chain.Containment Integrity: The LNG storage tanks undergo a Secondary Barrier Tightness Test (SBTT). This often involves a "gas trial" where the vessel receives a small amount of LNG via side-by-side transfer to cool down the tanks and verify their integrity.Performance Verification: Contractors must prove the facility can meet its guaranteed 1.2 MTPA production rate under real-world conditions.4. Safety and Regulatory HandoverThe final phase involves a labor-intensive procedure where technicians inspect thousands of connections and instruments. Only after these safety and performance benchmarks are met can the facility be officially handed over from the contractor (Wison) to the owner (Genting) for commercial operations

The comments from Genting Singapore’s Executive Chairman and Acting CEO, Lim Kok Thay, were made in response to shareholder questions during the company’s 41st Annual General Meeting held last month – the minutes of which were made public on Friday. RWS reported a 3% decline in revenue to SG$607.6 million (US$478 million) and a 24% drop in Adjusted EBITDA to SG$179.0 million (US$141 million) in 1Q26, while MBS saw net revenues rise 28% to US$1.49 billion and Adjusted EBITDA by 30.2% to US$788 million. The quarter included an all-time low in rolling chip market share at RWS of just 20%.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: ​A "non-linear" spike means the price pattern shatters. Because oil is an absolute necessity for global shipping, aviation, and manufacturing, when buyers realize there physically isn't enough oil available to go around, price increases accelerate aggressively out of nowhere. author: magellan
body: There's a stk operator or syndicate operating in many stks. It is not rare that an owner of the company can also play the stk as well. Perhaps, possibly or probably, there may be one operator or syndicate operating this stk. Simply put, you can't beat the owner or stock operator or syndicate or combined. That's why it is common knowledge and sense that most retailers - over 90 % lose money in the stk mkt. The longer you play, the higher the chance you will lose. Long-term play can only be investments in blue chip investment grade stks normally yielding high dividends. They are less volatile and do move up and down though. Their financial results are usually good and positive. They normally show consistent growth and growth potential over the long run. They are relatively stable. Their finances are usually in order. They do not expand exponentially and are not overly geared with extreme high debts. Most analysts, fund managers and investment banks give add, buy, outperform ratings on these stks. There is rarely any or NO RPTs. Does GB fit these criteria ?

author: ownet
body: RM100 million net profit is not an illusion manufactured by a one-time asset dumping scheme. While there is a line item for asset disposal, the bulk of this massive turnaround comes from a genuine structural pivot in operational cost management and segment earnings. Here is the exact data breakdown from the financial statement to show you where the money actually came from: On the surface, it looks like this RM120.8 million asset sale is what saved the quarter. However, you must track where that gain went. That disposal took place at the broader group level. When you look at the Condensed Consolidated Income Statement (Page 1), that RM120.8 million gain was completely washed out by a massive spike in Other Expenses, which surged to RM1,172.2 million (up from RM1,003.3 million last year) due to the heavy ramp-up costs of converting the New York property into a full commercial casino.

body: Genting Singapore is just one of four Genting companies LKT gets paid from and historically the smallest slice. His base salary there has always been modest (roughly S2M–S4M), with bonuses making up the rest. In 2025, the most recently verified figure, his total was S7.5M (S3.6M base + S$3.9M bonus). The big controversy was 2020, when a S$35M Japan casino bonus was accrued on paper and made headlines but it was never actually paid because Genting Singapore failed to win a Japan casino licence . To be precise, his title is acting CEO + Executive Chairman — not a full permanent CEO appointment. He has been Chairman of Genting Singapore since November 1993 and Executive Chairman since September 2005, so this is essentially a return to a hands-on leadership role after years of delegating day-to-day operations to Tan Hee Teck. With this dual role now in place, Genting Singapore has become his primary active executive responsibility and his pay from this entity is expected to carry more weight going forward compared to previous years.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: LKT's pay from Genting Singapore alone is broadly comparable to the top Singapore blue-chip CEOs. However, the full picture is starkly different: When all Genting entities are combined, LKT's total remuneration of RM192M+ (roughly S$55M+) in peak years dwarfs every CEO on this list by 5 to 10 times. Even in a moderated year like 2023 at RM192.64M, that translates to roughly S$55M — nearly 7x Singtel's CEO, 8x SIA's CEO, and 10x Sembcorp's CEO. The key structural difference is that LKT benefits from a family-controlled conglomerate model, drawing executive pay from multiple listed subsidiaries simultaneously — something no professional CEO at a government-linked company (GLC) like Singtel, SIA, CapitaLand, or Sembcorp can do. GLC CEOs are hired professionals with a single pay source, governed by stricter public accountability norms, while LKT as a founder-family executive faces fewer such constraints across entities he controls.

body: Maybank: Impact of gaming tables and lower slot machine tax in New York to boost Genting Malaysia earnings from Q2 by Ben Blaschke Sat 23 May 2026 at 06:38 After an opening quarter that fell short of expectations on rising global costs, Genting Malaysia should see a significant improvement in earnings in the June 2026 quarter – primarily on the addition of gaming tables and reduced gaming machine tax rates at Resorts World New York City (RWNYC). As reported by Inside Asian Gaming Genting Malaysia booked a 10% year-on-year increase in group-wide revenue to MYR2.87 billion (US$724 million) in 1Q26 but fell to an MYR25.2 million (US$6.4 million) net loss on pre-opening expenses in New York and higher payroll costs elsewhere. In a note, Maybank Investment Bank analyst Samuel Yin Shao Yang said the company’s earnings should strengthen from 2Q26 onwards, with a seasonally weaker post-CNY period at Resorts World Genting in Malaysia more than offset by table games revenue and lower gaming machine tax rates at RWNYC. As one of three companies to win a full casino license in downstate New York in December, RWNYC launched the city’s first table game operations on 28 April with 250 tables now operational. Yin said the property will also benefit from the lower gaming machine tax which has fallen from 68% to 56% following conversion from video lottery to slot machines. “The impact of this is significant as we estimate that this would boost FY26 earnings by US$68 million or US$100 million on a full year basis.” The analyst also estimates that the addition of more table games in the coming years could see them contribute US$85 million to Genting Malaysia’s earnings by 2028. With this in mind, Yang said he does “not discount the possibility that [parent company] Genting Berhad will attempt to takeover Genting Malaysia again,” after lifting its stake from around 49.4% to just below 75% over the past year.

author: DDLYGLOW
body: For Resorts World New York City (RWNYC), the licensing fee and its accounting treatment are significant drivers for Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) following the full commercial casino license win in late 2025. ​Based on current financial data and regulatory filings for the 2025/2026 period: ​1. The License Fee & Amortization Period ​While the New York State Gaming Commission set a minimum "bar" of USD 500 million, Genting's winning bid was more aggressive to secure the license. ​License Fee: USD 600 million. Genting offered a USD 100 million premium over the state's minimum to strengthen its bid. ​Amortization Period: 30 years. Under New York's downstate casino regulations and Genting’s specific proposal, the full commercial casino license is granted for a 30-year duration. In accounting terms, this "Intangible Asset" will be amortized (spread out) over the life of the license. ​2. Accounting Impact on Genting Malaysia (GENM) ​The payment of a USD 600 million (~RM 2.5 billion to RM 2.8 billion depending on exchange rates) fee triggers several specific movements in the Genting Malaysia Berhad consolidated accounts: ​Balance Sheet (Statement of Financial Position) ​Asset Recognition: The USD 600 million is capitalized as an Intangible Asset (specifically a "Gaming License"). It is not expensed all at once. ​Debt/Cash Impact: Since GENM typically funds such large outflows through a mix of internally generated funds and new debt, you will see an increase in Long-term Borrowings and a decrease in Cash and Bank Balances. ​Income Statement (Statement of Profit or Loss) ​Annual Amortization Charge: The fee is divided by the 30-year life. ​$ \frac{\text{USD 600,000,000}}{30 \text{ years}} = \text{USD 20,000,000 per year} $ ​Impact: GENM will record an annual non-cash depreciation/amortization expense of approximately USD 20 million (~RM 85-95 million). This reduces the "Accounting Profit" but does not affect the "Cash Flow" after the initial payment. ​Taxation ​Deferred Tax: The difference between the accounting amortization and any tax-deductible allowances provided by New York state law will create a Deferred Tax Asset or Liability entry. ​Strategic Context for Shareholders ​Key Note: Although the amortization adds a yearly expense, the revenue upside is the focus. With the license ratified in December 2025 and live table games launched on April 28, 2026, analysts expect RWNYC to significantly increase its EBITDA.

The key structural difference is that LKT benefits from a family-controlled conglomerate model, drawing executive pay from multiple listed subsidiaries simultaneously — something no professional CEO at a government-linked company (GLC) like Singtel, SIA, CapitaLand, or Sembcorp can do. GLC CEOs are hired professionals with a single pay source, governed by stricter public accountability norms, while LKT as a founder-family executive faces fewer such constraints across entities he controls

body: PETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd and Genting Malaysia Bhd (GenM) continue to face near-term headwinds from rising operating costs, softer regional gaming trends and margin pressures, although earnings momentum are expected to improve gradually on the back of Resorts World New York City’s (RWNYC) casino expansion and stronger performance at Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV). Genting’s earnings performance mostly came in below research houses’ and consensus expectations due to lower earnings for GenM and Genting Singapore (GenS). GenS saw a 7.8% year-on-year (y-o-y) decline in the first quarter of 2026 (1Q26) gaming revenue, suggesting continued loss of market share to its peer Marina Bay Sands, while non-gaming revenue grew by only 8.3% y-o-y, insufficient to mitigate the decline in gaming revenue. For 1Q26, RWLV showed strong performance due to increased convention attendance as well as improvement in high-end play, with increased table volumes and hold percentage within management’s range. On a quarter-on-quarter (q-o-q) basis, Genting’s 1Q26 results were impacted by lower fresh fruit bunch production in the plantation segment and softer property activities. The group’s core net profit rebounded from a RM96mil loss in 4Q25 to a profit of RM116mil in 1Q26, attributable to better margins, lower depreciation charges, absence of other losses recognised in previous quarter, and positive tax effect. Phillip Capital Research said while the sequential improvement for Genting is encouraging, earnings remain below 1Q25 levels, with sustained recovery at Resorts World Sentosa and the ramp-up of RWNYC’s commercial casino operations key to driving a stronger earnings recovery through 2026. Rising operating expenses and softer win rates remain key risks.

body: Genting Berhad could surge unexpectedly due to a combination of cyclical recovery and hidden upside across its diversified portfolio. Its exposure to global leisure and gaming—especially through Resorts World Genting and international assets—positions it to benefit strongly from a rebound in tourism, particularly from China and regional travelers. At the same time, improving performance in its plantation and energy segments adds earnings stability, while any recovery in its U.S. and U.K. casino operations could provide additional upside surprises. The group’s relatively depressed valuation, ongoing cost discipline, and potential for stronger-than-expected visitor spending create room for positive earnings revisions, making it a classic “under-the-radar” candidate for a sharp re-rating if multiple segments outperform simultaneously.

Engaging in medical research and development entails elevated risks and an extended gestation period for potential breakthrough discoveries, given the inherent uncertainty in results and success rates. Nevertheless, we maintain an optimistic outlook, believing that these investments will ultimately yield breakthroughs that can significantly enhance and improve the well-being of humanity. TauRx Pharmaceuticals Ltd’s UK marketing authorisation application for HMTM, an oral anti-tau treatment for Alzheimer’s disease, has been accepted by the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency and is now under review. Genting Berhad is building its first stem cell facility, “Fontaine Vitale” in the Sanur Special Economic Zone, Bali, Indonesia which aims to be a world class medical and wellness destination. author: Good123
body: Many investors continue to view Genting Berhad primarily as a gaming company, but this perception significantly understates the group's true value. In reality, Genting is one of Malaysia's most diversified conglomerates, with substantial exposure across leisure and hospitality, integrated resorts, plantations, power generation, oil and gas, property development, and life sciences. Through its listed subsidiaries, the group owns world-class assets spanning Malaysia, Singapore, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Bahamas, and other international markets, providing geographical diversification that few Malaysian companies can match. While gaming remains an important earnings contributor, Genting's integrated resort model generates revenue from hotels, retail, food and beverage, entertainment, conventions, and tourism-related activities, creating multiple income streams beyond casino operations. The group also benefits from recurring cash flows from its plantations and energy businesses, which help provide resilience during economic cycles. This diversified structure enables Genting to capture growth opportunities across different industries while reducing reliance on any single business segment. As global tourism continues to recover and international travel demand remains strong, Genting's hospitality and resort assets are well positioned to benefit. At the same time, the group's diversified portfolio, strong asset base, international footprint, and long track record of execution provide investors with exposure to multiple growth engines within a single corporate platform. Rather than being viewed solely as a gaming stock, Genting Berhad can be regarded as a diversified global consumer, tourism, hospitality, and infrastructure group with significant long-term value creation potential.

author: Good123
body: More importantly, even within the Leisure & Hospitality segment, non-gaming revenue accounted for roughly 37% (RM8.45 billion out of RM23.0 billion), showing that Genting already earns substantial income from hotels, attractions, retail, conventions, food & beverage, and entertainment. For profits, the picture is even more diversified because: Plantations often contribute disproportionately high profits during strong palm-oil cycles. Power provides stable recurring earnings. Oil & Gas contributes depending on production and commodity prices. Property contributes project-based profits. Non-gaming tourism assets can offset gaming cyclicality. A strong investment thesis would be: Genting should not be viewed solely as a casino operator. It is a diversified global conglomerate with exposure to tourism, hospitality, entertainment, plantations, power generation, oil & gas, and property development across multiple countries. While leisure and hospitality remains its core earnings engine, the group's non-gaming businesses and international asset portfolio provide diversification, recurring cash flows, and multiple avenues for long-term value creation. This diversified structure makes Genting substantially more resilient than a pure gaming company and positions it to benefit from tourism growth, consumer spending, commodity cycles, and infrastructure demand simultaneously.

body: Change in revenue level: Current run-rate is roughly 2x+ higher than historical level...from about 13m/week historically to ~28m/week currently, which is a meaningful structural improvement.
