author: DestinyL
body: I checked with Gemini, the main costs are dealer salary and the 600m license apportioned, as well as new tax rates. Profit projected to improve at about 100%, while GGR improved about 120% even though there are new costs involved. This is due to table games tax is much lower at 30% and gives big margin, even though the GGR revenue is much lower than slots. Based on latest week, roughly 21.7m from slots and 8.4m from table games. However, I believe the administration costs (admin and building costs) are relatively fixed and not in the equation, so there could be slightly more upside. Who knows F&B and hospitality revenue might also go up.

author: neohts
body: Genting Property unveils RM80 bil Johor Tech Smart City in Kulai. KULAI (June 12): Genting Property Sdn Bhd on Friday unveiled Johor Tech Smart City, a 2,300-acre integrated development within the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ) in Kulai, Johor. The project has an estimated gross development value of RM80 billion and is set to create over 10,000 jobs. The project, launched by Johor Menteri Besar Datuk Onn Hafiz Ghazi alongside Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) executive chairman Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay, is being developed by Genting Property — the property arm and wholly-owned subsidiary of Genting Plantations Bhd (KL:GENP) — together with its agriculture technology subsidiary ACGT Sdn Bhd.

author: neohts
body: Johor Tech Smart City is planned as a technology- and agriculture-driven ecosystem comprising a 500-acre AgTech Campus and a 1,700-acre Knowledge AI Campus. The project aims to combine smart farming, artificial intelligence (AI), advanced infrastructure and sustainable urban planning within a single master-planned development. Speaking at the launch event, Genting Plantations chief executive and executive director Datuk Indera Lim Keong Hui said the project is an important investment in Johor’s future growth. “Johor Tech Smart City reflects our long-term commitment to investing in transformative developments that create sustainable value for both the state and the nation,” he said. Keong Hui added that the development combines Genting Property’s township development experience with ACGT’s agriculture technology capabilities and global partnerships to support Johor’s economic growth, innovation ecosystem and future readiness.

author: neohts
body: Onn Hafiz said the project reflects Johor’s efforts to build a competitive, innovation-driven and sustainable economic ecosystem. “Johor Tech Smart City demonstrates what can be achieved through strong public-private collaboration and a shared long-term commitment to Johor’s sustainable development,” he told the press. He added that the blueprint for the JS-SEZ is still being finalised and is expected to be signed by the Malaysian and Singapore governments by year end. To support the development, Genting Property and ACGT have partnered with several international technology and planning firms. These include Huawei, architectural and planning firms B+H and Surbana Jurong, as well as agriculture technology companies China Shouguang Vegetable Industry Group, DAYU Irrigation, XAG and AIRSAT. Genting Property currently has two major developments in Johor: Genting Indahpura in Kulai and Genting Pura Kencana in Batu Pahat.

body: The stock has closed below 2.20 for three days in a row now (June 25, 26, 29) — all between 2.17-2.19, with no bounce back above 2.20 yet. That's a stronger signal than just one bad day; it suggests the breakdown is sticking, not just a one-off dip. A close above or below 2.20 tomorrow will say a lot: >> Holds below 2.20 (4th day): confirms the breakdown, makes 2.20 solidly resistance now >> Closes back above 2.20: would be the first sign sellers are losing control, could signal a false breakdown >> Volume matters too: a bounce on low volume is weak; a bounce on high volume (above the 4.3M avg) would be more convincing

body: Singapore has unveiled the next phase of the Greater Sentosa Master Plan (GSMP), a 20-year transformation of Sentosa and Pulau Brani. Key highlights: >> New attractions at Brani West, Imbiah Canopy, Sensorium, and an elevated forest walkway. >> Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) will add the Waterfront Lifestyle Development (target: 2030) and the highly anticipated Super Nintendo World. >> Siloso, Palawan, and Tanjong beaches will be rejuvenated with new beach clubs, coastal activities, floating boardwalks, and an islet-hopping experience. >> A new Island Heart Transport Hub and People Mover System will improve connectivity, replacing the current Sentosa Express. >> The transformation will be rolled out progressively from the early 2030s, with the goal of doubling annual visitors from the current 16 million. >> A public exhibition is being held across Singapore for residents to learn about and provide feedback on the plans. This is a positive long-term development for Singapore's tourism industry. If executed well, Greater Sentosa could become one of Asia's premier leisure destinations, attracting more international visitors and creating new business opportunities. It should also benefit tourism-related businesses, especially Genting Singapore, whose integrated resort is expected to gain from higher visitor traffic and the new attractions in the surrounding area. However, the financial benefits will likely materialize gradually over the next decade rather than immediately.

body: Peer-reviewed publications report that TauRx’s existing drug targeting the tau protein – a key hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease – halted progression of neurodegeneration, and that participants with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) who received 16 mg/day experienced statistically significant cognitive improvement over 18 months. Participants also displayed no evidence of statistically significant cognitive or functional decline over a period of two years. Trials also confirmed the drug has a benign safety profile, with headache (1.5%) and diarrhoea (1.2%) reported as the most frequent adverse effects at the 16 mg/day dose. A decision on the company’s MHRA application is expected this year.

body: CIMB Research remains positive on Genting Malaysia (GENM) and keeps a Buy recommendation with a target price of RM2.50. >> 2H2026 is expected to be much stronger than 1H2026. >> Resorts World Genting (RWG) should recover as domestic tourism strengthens and visitor numbers improve. >> Malaysia's tourism remains healthy, with Chinese tourist arrivals up 25% YoY, while domestic travel and spending continue to grow. >> Resorts World New York City (RWNY) has become a major earnings driver after launching full commercial casino operations. Gaming revenue has risen sharply and is expected to continue growing. >> Resorts World Las Vegas is also showing signs of recovery, supported by higher convention traffic and stronger premium gaming. >> Although 2026 earnings are expected to decline about 50% YoY, this is mainly due to a weak first half. Earnings should improve significantly in the second half. >> 2027 is expected to be the real turnaround year, with core EPS forecast to jump 125% as RWNY ramps up further. >> GENM is viewed as undervalued, trading at about 7.3x 2027 EV/EBITDA, around a 22% discount to its pre-pandemic historical average.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: The report reinforces the view that 2026 is a transition year, while 2027 could mark the beginning of a much stronger earnings cycle. The key drivers are: >> Recovery in RWG visitor numbers, >> Continued growth at Resorts World New York City, >> Improving performance at Resorts World Las Vegas. If these catalysts materialize as expected, GENM's earnings and share price could see a meaningful re-rating over the next 12–18 months. The main risk remains whether RWNY delivers the projected earnings growth.

body: Business is performing exceptionally well, generating $317.3 million in Total Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) in just the first 11 weeks of the fiscal year. This strong performance is driven by a critical transition noted in the report: the property ceased operating as a limited VLT (Video Lottery Terminal) facility and launched as a full commercial casino on April 28, 2026. ​Performance Analysis ​Steady Growth: Weekly GGR started at $27.2 million in early May and has steadily climbed, consistently breaking the $30 million mark in recent weeks (hitting a peak of $30.86 million for the week ending July 5, 2026). ​Revenue Drivers: Slots and Electronic Table Games (ETGs) remain the dominant moneymaker, bringing in $230.3 million (roughly 72.6% of total revenue), while the newly introduced live Table Games have already contributed a substantial $87 million. ​Next Projections ​Annual Revenue Estimate: The business is currently maintaining an average weekly run-rate of approximately $28.85 million. If this pace is sustained across the remaining 41 weeks of the fiscal year, Resorts World NYC is projected to hit a total annual GGR of roughly $1.5 billion for FY 2026/2027. ​Growth Outlook: Expect table game revenues to continue climbing as the casino matures, optimizes its marketing, and fully capitalizes on its new commercial casino status.

author: bearsong
body: Genting Berhad’s upcoming Floating LNG (FLNG) project in the Kasuri Block is projected to generate approximately $141 million (around RM660 million) in incremental annual earnings (EBITDA) once it reaches full commercial operation. The revenue and profit trajectory is broken down into the following key expectations: ​Revenue Horizon: Revenue generation is structured around a highly visible, long-term supply framework. The facility has an approved 18-year gas supply contract delivering 230 million standard cubic feet per day (mmscfd) directly to the 1.2 million metric tons per annum (mtpa) FLNG vessel, supplemented by another 17-year domestic supply contract of 101 mmscfd. ​Earnings Ramping (2026–2027): With the FLNG facility targeted for mechanical completion in Q3 2026, initial revenues will begin trickling in late this year. Full-scale earnings and net profit contributions will realize incrementally over the course of 2027. ​Broader Corporate Impact: The $141 million annual earnings boost from the LNG sector will help drive the parent group's broader financial recovery. Following a flat performance in 2025, market consensus indicates that Genting Berhad's overall net income is expected to scale by double-to-triple digits going into 2026 and 2027 as non-gaming energy revenues bridge the gap with its recovering core hospitality assets.

This breaks down not just the parent company's direct stakes, but also what the major subsidiaries own underneath them, including recent 2025/2026 corporate updates. 1. The Ultimate Holding CompanyCompany: Genting Berhad (GENT)Role: Core investment holding and group management arm.Market Capitalization: ~RM 8.43 billion (Bursa Malaysia)Major Controlling Shareholder: The Lim Family via Kien Huat Realty Sdn Bhd, which holds an ~43.6% controlling stake in the parent company.2. Core Listed Subsidiaries & Sub-Holdings Genting Berhad directs its global resort, leisure, and agricultural operations through three listed giants: A. Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM)Genting Berhad's Ownership: 73.86% (Increased aggressively from 49.3% after a late-2025 takeover bid and early-2026 market accumulation).Current Market Capitalization: ~RM 10.32 billion (Bursa Malaysia)Key Assets & Sub-Subsidiaries:Resorts World Genting (RWG): The flagship mountain resort, casino, and theme park complex in Malaysia.Genting UK: 100% owned by GENM. Operates over 30 land-based casinos in the UK plus Resorts World Birmingham.Resorts World New York City (RWNYC): The highly lucrative electronic gaming machine (EGM) facility at Aqueduct Racetrack.Empire Resorts Inc.: 100% owned by GENM (GENM bought out the remaining 51% from the Lim family for $41 million in May 2025). Through Empire, GENM owns Resorts World Catskills and Resorts World Hudson.Resorts World Bimini: Luxury resort and casino asset in the Bahamas.B. Genting Singapore Limited (GENS)Genting Berhad's Ownership: 52.60%Current Market Capitalization: ~SGD 7.55 billion (Singapore Exchange - SGX)Key Assets & Sub-Subsidiaries:Resorts World Sentosa (RWS): Mega-integrated resort spanning Universal Studios Singapore, S.E.A. Aquarium, luxury hotels, and one of Singapore's two exclusive casino licenses. RWS contributes heavily to the group's overall cash flow.C. Genting Plantations Berhad (GENP)Genting Berhad's Ownership: 55.40%Current Market Capitalization: ~RM 5.11 billion (Bursa Malaysia)Key Assets, Joint Ventures & Sub-Subsidiaries:Upstream Plantations: Controls roughly 243,200 hectares of landbank across Malaysia and Indonesia.Genting Property Sdn Bhd (100%): Handles property development projects in Malaysia.Genting Simon Sdn Bhd (50% JV): A partnership with global retail giant Simon Property Group. They own and operate Johor Premium Outlets and Genting Highlands Premium Outlets.Genting MusimMas Refinery (72%): A major downstream palm oil refinery based in Sabah.3. Wholly Owned Unlisted Subsidiaries (100% Direct Directorship) Genting Berhad chooses to keep two of its most capital-heavy growth vectors completely private: Resorts World Las Vegas LLC (RWLV): 100% Direct Owned. The group's massive $4.3 billion integrated luxury casino resort on the Las Vegas Strip, operating under the Hilton, LXR, and Conrad banners.Genting Energy Limited: 100% Direct Owned. Handles utility and hydrocarbon assets across Asia:PT Lestari Banten Energi (49%): A 660MW coal-fired power station in Banten, Indonesia.SDIC Genting Meizhou Wan Electric Power (49%): Supercritical thermal power generation plants in Fujian, China.Genting Oil Kasuri Pte Ltd (95%): Oversees gas development blocks in the Kasuri Basin of West Papua, Indonesia.4. Life Sciences & Biotechnology Ventures Genting Berhad acts as a direct investor in genomics and healthcare technologies, seeking alternative long-term growth channels: ACGT Sdn Bhd (100%): Focuses on molecular diagnostics and oil palm genomics.Genting AgTech / Celixir Partnership: Direct stakes in biotechnology labs targeting cellular therapeutics and medical innovations.

author: bearsong
body: Comprehensive Summary of Robert DeSalvio's GGB Interview & Strategic Takeaways In his featured GGB Magazine interview and podcast, Robert (Bob) DeSalvio, President of Genting New York State and Genting Americas Inc., provided a deep dive into the operational execution and long-term vision behind transforming Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) from a racino into a premier commercial integrated resort: 1. Key Operational Highlights & Record Yields Unprecedented Slot Productivity: DeSalvio revealed that during the initial rollout phase, 2,500 slot units averaged over $1,200 in daily win per unit, setting an unprecedented operational benchmark across the U.S. gaming sector. Live Table Game Growth: The introduction of live table games generated immediate momentum, with weekly performance outperforming upstate New York commercial casinos and live tables producing over $7.4 million weekly (contributing to three-week GGR stretches averaging ~$27 million). Speed to Market: Because RWNYC operates on an active 73-acre footprint at Aqueduct, Genting rapidly added 1,400 new slot units alongside dedicated themed gaming zones and progressive jackpot links without waiting for ground-up construction. 2. The $5.5 Billion Master Expansion Plan DeSalvio detailed the multi-stage master plan to elevate RWNYC into a full 5.6 million-square-foot resort: Gaming Capacity⟶6,000 Slots & 800 Live Table Games Hospitality⟶2,000 Hotel Rooms Entertainment⟶7,000-Seat Multi-Purpose Arena Dining & Retail⟶30+ Food, Beverage & Retail Outlets Economic Engine: Annual Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) is projected to more than double from ~$1.0 billion to $2.2+ billion, while creating over 2,200 direct jobs and thousands of construction positions. First-Mover Edge: Despite prospective downstate competition, RWNYC's operational head start and direct proximity to John F. Kennedy (JFK) International Airport position it to capture both local tri-state gamers and pre/post-flight international traffic. 3. Synergies Across Genting’s East Coast Portfolio Beyond Queens, DeSalvio oversees a connected gaming web designed to route players across Genting properties: Genting Americas Portfolio Resorts World New York City (Queens, NY) Primary volume engine & high-yield table floor. Resorts World Catskills (Sullivan County, NY) Primary volume engine & high-yield table floor Luxury 1,700-acre resort targeting VIP weekend getaways. Resorts World Hudson Valley (Newburgh, NY) Regional slot facility (growing to ~$2.1M/week GGR). Resorts World Bimini (Bahamas) Fly-and-play flyaways for NYC VIP loyalty database. 4. What This Means for Genting Berhad (3182) & Genting Malaysia (GENM) Cash-Flow Diversification: Scaling RWNYC into a $2.2B+ GGR asset provides Genting Group with a massive, high-margin U.S. Dollar cash stream that buffers cyclicality in Asian gaming markets (Gentings Singapore & Malaysia). Valuation Re-rating Catalyst: As full downstate licensing is finalized, unlocking the full equity value of RWNYC provides tangible support to Genting's fundamental Sum-of-Parts (SOP) valuation base.

author: Ka Keat
body: Resorts World New York City doubles down on the speed of its massive $5.5 billion first-of-its-kind integrated resort, officially breaking ground on Phase Two of the project less than 3 months after the property’s grand opening. “In less than 3 months after opening our doors as the first casino in New York City’s history, we are already moving towards a day when the city will have a first-of-its-kind integrated resort,” said Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay, Executive Chairman of the Genting Group. “Not only are we keeping every commitment we made in our proposal to the state, but we are running well ahead of schedule in starting to build outside of our existing building.” Elements of Phase Two that will get started after groundbreaking include: The development of an additional 400-room hotel tower to add on to the current Hyatt Regency. The Kenny “The Jet” Sports and Media Complex which will open three years earlier than initially pledged and shift to the middle of the Resorts World campus to be more accessible to the entirety of the project. A 7,000 seat multi-purpose arena 1,200 additional hotel rooms under the luxury Crockfords brand The central plaza A state-of-the-art parking garage Largest casino in the USA in Gross Gaming Revenue The full expansion is projected to create 10,000 jobs, including an estimated 5,000 union construction jobs, and will add 200,000 m² of new gaming, entertainment, dining, retail, and convention space to the existing one-million-square-foot property. “The excitement around this project hasn’t stopped since the day we submitted our bid,” said Robert DeSalvio, President, Genting Americas East. “It carried us through our licensing process and through the first 12 weeks of operating New York City’s first live table games. Today, that same excitement is present as we break ground on Phase Two, which will bring new infrastructure, new parking, and the next wave of hotel rooms.” With just two floors of gaming operation opened since opening on April 28, Resorts World has increased tax and racing support payment by over 30 percent compared with the same period last year, paying $170 million in casino taxes and racing support in the first 12 weeks of operation. With these numbers, Resorts World New York City is already the largest casino in the United States in terms of Gross Gaming Revenue. Further, with the addition of 1,400 slot machines on July 21 and more gaming tables by the end of the year, RWNYC is expected to significantly grow casino tax and racing support payments to a billion dollars a year, including $425 million for education, $425 million for the MTA and $150 million in support for the state’s horse-racing industry. To put this into perspective: the states of New York, Nevada, and Pennsylvania each currently generate approximately $1 billion annually in commercial casino tax revenue from all of their casinos. Resorts World New York City, as a single property, is projected to generate approximately $1 billion in annual casino tax revenue…On its own. Resorts World New York City has operated in Southeast Queens for 15 years and is New York State’s largest taxpayer. The property employs approximately 2,500 people and has invested more than $1.1 billion in Southeast Queens. It welcomes an average of 5 million guests annually.

author: bearsong
body: A Sum-of-the-Parts (SOTP) valuation is the primary method equity research analysts (e.g., Maybank, Kenanga, Citi, PublicInvest) use to value Genting Berhad (KLSE: GENT / 3182). Because Genting is a conglomerate holding company, its fair value is calculated by adding up the market value (or enterprise value) of its core operating subsidiaries, subtracting net holding company debt, and applying a holding company conglomerate discount (typically 35% to 40%). Illustrative SOTP Valuation Framework for Genting Berhad Here is how sell-side investment analysts structure Genting's SOTP model: Operating Division / HoldingStake OwnedValuation BasisEstimated Total Value (RM Million)Value Per GENT Share (RM)Genting Malaysia (GENM)~73.1%Listed Market Cap / Target Price~RM 9,500 – RM 10,500~RM 2.50 - 2.75Genting Singapore (GENS)~52.7%Listed Market Cap in SGD (converted to MYR)~RM 19,000 – RM 21,000~RM 5.00 - 5.50Genting Plantations (GENP)~50.6%Listed Market Cap / Target Price~RM 2,200 – RM 2,500~RM 0.60 - 0.65Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV)100.0%Development Cost / EV/EBITDA Multiple~RM 6,500 – RM 7,500~RM 1.70 - 1.95Genting Energy & Power100.0%P/E or DCF of power & O&G assets~RM 1,200 – RM 1,500~RM 0.30 - 0.40Gross Asset Value (GAV)—Sum of all business segments~RM 38,400 – RM 43,500~RM 10.10 - 11.25(Less: Net Debt at Holding Level)—Corporate borrowings minus cash(~RM 4,500 – RM 5,500)(~RM 1.20 - 1.45)Net Asset Value (NAV)—Equity Value before discount~RM 33,900 – RM 38,000~RM 8.90 - 9.80Conglomerate Discount (40%)—Standard holding discount applied(~RM 13,500 – RM 15,200)(~RM 3.55 - 3.90)Target Price / Fair Value—Implied Fair Value per Share~RM 20,400 – RM 22,800RM 5.35 – RM 5.90Key Takeaways from the SOTP ModelGenting Singapore (GENS) is the Core Anchor: GENS (Resorts World Sentosa) accounts for over 50% of Genting Berhad's total gross asset value. Its strong net-cash balance sheet and SGD strength provide the heavy lifting for GENT's intrinsic value.The Structural Discount Gap: Genting Berhad currently trades in the ~RM 2.15 – RM 2.25 range. Even after applying a conservative 40% conglomerate discount, consensus analyst target prices sit between RM 2.80 and RM 5.50, reflecting a massive gap between market price and underlying asset value.

author: AngTayKor
body: RWLV is actually well positioned for convention business, though it is not the absolute closest hotel. Distance Las Vegas Convention Center → Resorts World Las Vegas Distance: about 2 miles (3 km). Walking time: 35–40 minutes. � So it's walkable, but most convention attendees would either: take the Vegas Loop, use the RTC bus, or take a short taxi/Uber. Vegas Loop advantage One of RWLV's biggest strengths is that it has a Vegas Loop station. Resorts World → LV Convention Center Underground Tesla Loop ride takes just over 1 minute between the two stations. For convention visitors, this is often more convenient than walking. Hotels closest to the Convention Center If purely by walking distance: Renaissance Las Vegas Hotel – about 4-minute walk. Westgate Las Vegas – adjacent to the Convention Center. Las Vegas Marriott / nearby Hilton Garden Inn properties. Conrad at Resorts World – about 15-minute walk according to convention travel guides, or a very short Vegas Loop ride. � Navan For RWLV's business Although RWLV isn't physically the closest hotel, it is still a major beneficiary because: It is a large integrated resort with nearly 3,500 rooms. Convention delegates often prefer newer luxury properties. The Vegas Loop significantly reduces travel time. It has extensive F&B, gaming and entertainment, making it attractive for corporate groups. So if I had to score RWLV's convention positioning: Walking convenience: 7.5/10 Overall convention appeal (including Vegas Loop): 9/10 This is one reason analysts continue to view convention recovery as an important driver of RWLV's EBITDA. The property doesn't need to be the closest hotel—it needs to be one of the most attractive places for convention attendees to stay, and the Loop connection helps achieve that. RWLV doesn't rely solely on the Loop. It is simply an additional advantage that many competing resorts don't have. For RWLV specifically, having a station inside the resort is a competitive benefit because convention guests can get from the hotel to the LVCC much more conveniently than many other Strip properties. That's one reason convention business is viewed as an important earnings driver for the resort.

author: Ka Keat
body: Genting Malaysia could report a core net loss in 2Q26 after the FIFA World Cup and the Middle East conflict weakened gaming activity in Malaysia and the UK, according to Maybank Investment Bank. The brokerage cut its FY2026 core net profit forecast by 28 percent to MYR480 million ($119 million), from MYR662.7 million ($164 million). Its assumptions now point to a 5 percent decline in gross gaming revenue (GGR) at both Resorts World Genting and Genting UK, compared with previous forecasts of 2 percent growth and flat performance, respectively. Maybank said the second quarter is normally seasonally weaker following Chinese New Year, but channel checks indicated that 2Q26 could be unusually soft. Higher diesel prices linked to the Middle East conflict reportedly affected VIP and mass-market play at Resorts World Genting. The conflict may also have discouraged Middle Eastern customers and travelers transiting through the region from visiting Genting UK’s London VIP clubs. The FIFA World Cup, held between June 11th and July 19th, also diverted gaming spending from the two operations, Maybank said. The brokerage did not rule out a 2Q26 core net loss, compared with a MYR10.2 million ($2.5 million) core profit in the previous quarter. However, Maybank cut its FY2027 and FY2028 profit forecasts by only 4 percent, saying the ‘negative catalysts are transient’. It expects core net profit to more than double to MYR975.2 million ($241 million) in 2027.

author: bearsong
body: Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) is experiencing strong early revenue growth in Q1 FY2026/2027 following its conversion to a full commercial casino on April 28, 2026, driven by resilient slot play and expanding live table game volume. 1. Core Financial Performance (13-Week Data Deep Dive)Revenue BreakdownTotal Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR): $378.29 Million (13-week total)Slot/ETG Revenue: $271.27 Million (~71.7% of total revenue)Slot Wagering Handle (Credits Played): $3.87 BillionSlot Hold Rate: 7.01%Table Games Revenue: $107.02 Million (~28.3% of total revenue)Table Game Drop (Wagering Volume): $577.87 MillionTable Game Hold Rate: 18.52% (stabilized above the initial May low of ~14%)Profitability & Tax Analysis Under the approved commercial license terms, RWNYC operates at higher statutory tax rates compared to regional peers in exchange for immediate NYC market entry: Gaming Taxes Paid =$271.27\56%,Slot Tax: $151.91 + $107.02\30\%,Table Tax: \$32.11\$184.02\Million Net Gaming Revenue (After Taxes): ~$194.27 MillionEstimated EBITDA (13-Week Period): ~$75M – $85M (EBITDA margin of ~38%–43% relative to net gaming revenue).Tax Cut Impact: The tax rate reduction on slots (from 68% as a VLT facility down to 56%) is projected to boost annual earnings by ~$100 Million, partially offsetting higher labor costs associated with operating 242 live dealer tables. 2. Operational & Business Efficiency TrendsSlot Capacity Expansion Trend: Weeks 1–12 : 2,465 to 2,502 Slots/ETGs Avg Win/Unit/Day: ~$1,100 – $1,250 Week 13 : 3,716 Slots/ETGs (Expanded) Avg Win/Unit/Day: ~$822 (Capacity Dilution) Slot Floor Expansion: On the week ending July 26, 2026, active slot capacity expanded by ~1,215 machines to 3,716 total units. While total weekly slot GGR rose to $21.35M, the average Win/Unit/Day dipped from ~$1,100–$1,250 to $822 due to early floor dilution—a normal ramp-up curve as player traffic adjusts to the expanded gaming floor.Table Game Productivity: The property operated a fixed 242 live tables across all 13 weeks. Weekly table GGR grew steadily from $4.9M in Week 1 to $11.1M by Week 12 (~$3,400 to $6,500 GGR/table/day), reflecting player adoption and improved hold percentage.Promotional Discipline: Marketing promotional spend remains low, accounting for <$10M total in slot promo credits (~2.6% of GGR) and <$200K total in table promo credits, keeping player acquisition costs under control. 3. Strategic Strategic Position & OutlookMonopoly Advantage (2026–2029): As the only active full commercial casino in New York City, RWNYC holds a 3- to 4-year lead over competing greenfield developments (e.g., Willets Point and Bronx projects), which are not scheduled to open until ~2030.Annualized Trajectory: On its current pace, RWNYC is operating at an annualized GGR run-rate of ~$1.51 Billion, with projections to reach $2.0B+ annually as its $5.5B phase-two expansion (up to 6,000 slots and 800 tables) is completed.

Annualized Run-Rate (Current): Based on the average weekly run-rate of ~$30 million recorded throughout June and July 2026, RWNYC is on pace for $1.5 billion to $1.6 billion in gross gaming revenue in its first full year of commercial operation. ​ Capacity Additions (Late July 2026): Opened a expanded floor section adding 1,400 new slot machines (bringing total slot count to 3,900 units), which is expected to generate incremental slot revenue lift in Q3/Q4 2026. ​ Phase Two Target (Jan 2027): Adding 150 additional table games within existing indoor space to reach 400 total tables, positioning annual revenue toward $2.2 billion. 4-Year Monopoly Lead: While prospective greenfield projects in Manhattan, Queens, or the Bronx face multi-year construction, zoning, and licensing cycles, RWNYC is already operational.

body: Genting Berhad’s share price has the potential to improve over the medium term, supported by stronger earnings from its key leisure and hospitality businesses. Key catalysts include the expansion and ramp-up of Resorts World New York City, continued recovery at Resorts World Las Vegas, higher visitor arrivals and gaming volumes at Resorts World Genting, and the eventual opening of the long-awaited outdoor theme park in Malaysia. In addition, easing interest rates, stronger consumer travel demand, and improving investor sentiment toward undervalued Malaysian equities could lead to a re-rating of the stock. While near-term risks such as higher operating costs and elevated capital expenditure remain, many analysts continue to maintain a positive long-term outlook, with consensus target prices generally above the current market price, suggesting meaningful upside if execution improves.

author: Good123
body: Genting Berhad is a globally diversified and fundamentally solid business, with operations spanning leisure and hospitality, gaming, plantations, power generation, oil and gas, property development, and biotechnology across Malaysia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, Egypt, China, India, Indonesia and the Bahamas. Its flagship integrated resorts—Resorts World Genting, Resorts World Sentosa, Resorts World New York City and Resorts World Las Vegas—are globally recognised assets with high barriers to entry and strong long-term tourism demand. This broad geographic and business diversification reduces reliance on any single market, while its substantial asset base, recurring cash flows and decades-long operating track record provide resilience through economic cycles, making Genting Berhad one of Malaysia's strongest global conglomerates with significant long-term value.

author: Good123
body: Genting Berhad has maintained a long history of rewarding shareholders through regular dividend payments, reflecting its commitment to returning cash to investors even during challenging business cycles. As earnings continue to recover, driven by stronger tourism, gaming, and hospitality operations across its global resorts, together with contributions from its diversified businesses, the company's cash flow is expected to strengthen further. This provides a solid basis for sustaining—and potentially increasing—future dividends, particularly as major expansion projects mature and begin contributing more meaningfully to profitability. While future dividends are never guaranteed and remain subject to board approval and financial performance, the improving earnings outlook supports expectations for stronger shareholder returns over the longer term.

author: Good123
body: RESORTS WORLD LAS VEGAS LLC Resorts World Las Vegas LLC is a wholly owned unlisted principal subsidiary of Genting Berhad. The Company developed and operates Resorts World Las Vegas, which commenced operations on 24 June 2021. Resorts World Las Vegas is the first ground-up integrated resort built on the Las Vegas strip since 2010. As the Genting Group’s third mega integrated resort, Resorts World Las Vegas embraces technology, innovation and inclusivity, supported by the pillars of elevated service, harmony, loyalty and luxury. Resorts World Las Vegas features three of Hilton’s premium brands, namely Las Vegas Hilton, the resort’s full-service brand; Conrad Las Vegas, Hilton’s lifestyle luxury brand; and LXR, Hilton’s network of independent luxury properties, which operates as Crockfords Las Vegas, Genting’s world-famous ultra-luxury brand. Resorts World Las Vegas offers 3,506 guest rooms and suites, an innovative cutting-edge gaming floor powered by sophisticated modern technology, world-class food and beverage options, a 5,000-seat theatre, unique nightlife experiences, upscale retail outlets and 250,000 square feet of meeting and event space. The integrated resort intertwines the timeless traditions of the international Resorts World brand with Las Vegas sensibilities, to create a bold new approach to hospitality in the city with stunning design, progressive technology and world-class guest service.

body: Genting Berhad is well positioned to benefit from Visit Malaysia 2026 (VM2026) as the campaign is expected to drive higher international tourist arrivals, particularly to its flagship integrated resort, Resorts World Genting. More visitors would support increased hotel occupancy, theme park attendance, gaming revenue, retail spending, food and beverage sales, and convention activities, strengthening earnings across multiple business segments. As fixed operating costs are already largely in place, higher visitor volumes could translate into stronger operating leverage, improved margins, and higher profitability. Furthermore, ongoing geopolitical tensions in parts of Europe and the Middle East may encourage some travellers to choose destinations perceived as stable and accessible. While Europe remains one of the world's leading tourism regions and many destinations there continue to operate normally, some travellers may opt for alternative holiday destinations in Asia because of regional conflicts, security concerns, or travel uncertainty. Malaysia offers a compelling combination of political stability, competitive travel costs, excellent connectivity, world-class tourism infrastructure, and diverse cultural and natural attractions. Together with VM2026's international marketing efforts and expanding airline connectivity, this could boost tourist arrivals and benefit Genting Berhad's hospitality, leisure, gaming, retail, and entertainment businesses. Combined with the group's diversified global operations, recurring dividend history, and resilient business model, a sustained recovery in tourism could provide a meaningful catalyst for stronger earnings growth and long-term shareholder value.

author: Good123
body: ANOTHER sizeable oil palm estate is up for sale in Johor via an expression of interest exercise, this time with an asking price of about RM400 million, or around RM8.20 per sq ft (psf). Said to be one of the largest tracts of privately held freehold development land in Kluang, the 1,124-acre agricultural estate is close to three industrial parks — Sinaran Industrial Park, Matahari Industrial Park and Wawasan Industrial Park — along Jalan Mersing. Industry observers point to a pattern that has repeated itself across the peninsula for decades. Well-connected and established neighbourhoods such as Bangsar in Kuala Lumpur, Bandar Utama in Petaling Jaya and Puchong, Selangor, were rubber and oil palm estates before being redeveloped into townships. “The Johor Premium Outlets complex sits on what used to be an oil palm estate owned by Genting Plantations Bhd (KL:GENP). Large plantation owners have increasingly treated land bank not as a permanent crop asset but as a store of value to be unlocked when location catches up to the land,” an agent tells The Edge.

author: Good123
body: Genting plantation bhd would benefit too :) Against that backdrop, industry observers say that plantation owners holding ageing, lower-yielding estates near growth corridors must weigh their options as replanting a mature estate is capital-intensive and takes years to bear fruit again, while selling the same land for industrial, energy or residential development can realise many times its value as farmland — sometimes 10 times or more per acre. Whether the Kluang estate is ultimately converted into a township, industrial park or simply changes hands as a land bank will likely depend on rezoning approvals from Majlis Perbandaran Kluang and the broader Johor government. However, the size and pricing of the deal make it one to watch as an indication of how far the plantation-to-township conversion trend has spread beyond the traditional Kulai-Iskandar corridor in the state.

author: Good123
body: It could be positive, but it depends on what Genting Berhad does with the proceeds. If Genting sells its plantations and power businesses at attractive valuations, it could: Unlock hidden value if those assets are undervalued by the market. Raise significant cash to reduce debt, strengthen the balance sheet, or fund expansion of its higher-growth integrated resort and gaming businesses. Allow management to focus on its core strengths in global hospitality, gaming and tourism, where Genting has a strong competitive advantage. Improve return on equity (ROE) and earnings quality if the divested businesses generate lower returns than the core leisure business. Potentially support higher dividends, share buybacks, or special dividends if excess cash is returned to shareholders. However, there are trade-offs. The plantations and power divisions provide diversified and relatively stable earnings, helping cushion the Group during downturns in tourism and gaming. Selling them would make Genting more dependent on the cyclical leisure and gaming sector. Overall, if the disposal is executed at a premium valuation and the proceeds are deployed efficiently into high-return projects or returned to shareholders, it could be a significant catalyst for a higher valuation and share price. If the assets are sold cheaply or the proceeds are invested in low-return projects, the benefits would be much less compelling.

body: Fitch: Proposed issue of perpetual securities won’t alone mitigate risk of ratings downgrade following New York license, Genting Malaysia investments

author: Johnchew123
body: Fitch Ratings said in a Monday note that Malaysian gaming giant Genting Berhad risks a ratings downgrade if it doesn’t effectively reduce its debt in the short-term, warning that the group’s leverage is high for its current “BBB” rating. That’s despite Genting Bhd subsidiary GOHL Capital Holdings Limited proposing to issue perpetual securities in what is likely an effort to improve its balance sheet and provide a greater runway to get its finances back on track following a series of recent substantial investments. These investments include the acquisition of a much larger stake in Genting Malaysia, obtaining a full casino license in New York and the US$5 billion expansion of its Singapore IR Resorts World Sentosa.

author: Johnchew123
body: Fitch said it will treat the perpetual securities – to be issued in two tranches – as half debt, half equity, allowing Genting to reduce its leverage from 5.5x currently to 4.8x. However, the agency notes that this essentially provides accounting relief rather than cash deleveraging and the outlook for Genting therefore remains at “Negative.” “Genting’s leverage is currently high for its rating and the Negative Outlook reflects the risk that it may be unable to deleverage to a level consistent with its rating,” Fitch said. “We expect Genting’s EBITDA net leverage to peak at around 5.5x in 2025 on large capex plans and investments, including the acquisition of an additional stake in Genting Malaysia Berhad. The ratio should then fall to around 3.5x by 2028.” On the group’s “BBB” rating, Fitch added, “Although the proposed [issue of perpetual securities] improves credit metrics, incremental earnings and demonstrated commitment to deleveraging are key for Genting to maintain its rating.

author: Johnchew123
body: 2Q26 is especially important, as the economic impact of the Iran war will become clearer and Genting New York LLC will have rolled out its new gaming tables and its outperformance, relative to our forecasts, could mitigate the forecast rise in leverage.” With all eyes on Resorts World New York City (RWNYC), which won a full casino license late last year and expects to relaunch with gaming tables by mid-2026 as part of its Phase 1 expansion, Fitch said the property’s performance will be crucial to the Genting Group’s ability to deleverage rapidly. “We estimate [RWNYC] to generate EBITDA of around US$215 million in 2026 as the casino ramps up,” it said. “Our forecast assumes that by 2028, EBITDA from [Genting New York] will reach around US$460 million based on the tax regime in its proposal. The casino has first-mover advantage in New York and benefits from a dense population and high-income flows. “However, delays in ramp-up by [RWNYC] or its inability to convert its asset into a high-margin casino, together with slower recovery at Genting’s other gaming operations, are risks to our forecast deleveraging path. Macroeconomic uncertainties, including potential second-order impact from a prolonged Iran conflict, which may affect tourism arrivals and consumer sentiment, could also affect operations and profitability.

author: Johnchew123
body: Genting has pledged total investment of US$5.5 billion to expand RWNYC, of which US$1.1 billion has been spent. The remaining US$4.4 billion, which includes licence fees of US$500 million and US$350 million on the renovation of existing facilities to be incurred in 2026, will be phased over five years.

author: i3ronda
body: Look at YTL Power (YTLP) its share price once fell from around 2.50 to 0.60, leaving it at only about 20% of its previous peak. Look at where the share price is today. The share price can head south while the company is still spending heavily on Capex. But once the Capex cycle peaks and starts normalising, free cash flow can recover rapidly. As KK mentioned, the key is to look beyond the current Capex burden and focus on what happens once the investment cycle matures. Isn’t this essentially what we are seeing with Genting today? Heavy Capex can weigh on cash flow and sentiment in the short term, but once the Capex peak is behind us and free cash flow starts to recover, the market can re-rate the stock significantly. YTLP is a good reminder: share price weakness during a heavy investment cycle does not necessarily mean the underlying business is deteriorating. Sometimes, the market simply needs to wait for the CapEx cycle to turn.

body: With 3,900 slots generating US$30m weekly GGR and 400 live tables generating US$15m weekly GGR, RWNYC's Q1 2027 could have a very high EBITDA run rate even though hotel/dining capacity remains limited. I'll use the tax rates we've been using: Slots: 56% tax Tables: 30% tax 1. Net gaming revenue after gaming tax Slots US$30m × 44% = US$13.2m/week Tables US$15m × 70% = US$10.5m/week So total after gaming tax: US$23.7m/week Over 13 weeks: US$308.1m net gaming revenue 2. Operating cost This is where the difference between slots and tables becomes important. Slots require relatively little incremental labour. Tables require dealers, supervisors, surveillance, pit personnel, cage operations, etc. I'd model approximately: Weekly net revenue EBITDA margin Weekly EBITDA Slots $13.2m 75–80% $9.9–10.6m Tables $10.5m 45–55% $4.7–5.8m Total $23.7m $14.6–16.4m That produces approximately: Q1 2027 EBITDA: US$190–213m I'd put my central estimate around US$200m EBITDA for the 90-day period. Why this could be particularly powerful The mix is actually quite favourable. The slots are generating: $30m GGR → $13.2m after tax → ~US$10m EBITDA/week while tables: $15m GGR → $10.5m after tax → ~US$5.2m EBITDA/week So despite tables producing half the GGR, they could contribute roughly half the EBITDA because of their much higher post-tax revenue but substantially higher labour cost. And this is before giving much credit to hotel, F&B, entertainment, parking, etc. Because RWNYC currently has relatively limited hotel rooms and ancillary offerings, I would not aggressively add non-gaming EBITDA. Perhaps another US$5–15m for the quarter once those businesses are included. My Q1 2027 estimate If your assumptions actually materialise: RWNYC Q1 2027 EBITDA: ~US$195–220m Best estimate: ~US$205m. That would imply an annualised EBITDA run rate of roughly US$820m.

author: Johnchew123
body: Banking group Nomura has downgraded Genting Singapore Ltd, on what the institution termed the “slow ramp up” of business following upgrades to the group’s Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) property in Singapore. Maybank Investment Bank Bhd has maintained the casino firm at ‘hold’, though it noted in a Wednesday memo that Genting Singapore “came in below… expectations again largely due to elevated transformation related costs”. Nomura’s change was flagged in a Tuesday memo, following Genting Singapore’s first-quarter results. The casino firm posted net profit of just under SGD65.2 million (US$51.2 million) for the three months to March 31, down 55.0 percent from a year earlier. First-quarter adjusted earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation, and amortisation (EBITDA) stood at nearly SGD179.0 million, a 24.1-percent decrease from the prior-year period. Nomura analysts Tushar Mohata and Alpa Aggarwal wrote, referring to property upgrades and a second phase of development at Resorts World Sentosa, known as RWS2.0: “The pace of recovery from RWS2.0 investments has proven materially slower than anticipated, prompting us to reassess our thesis.” Though they added: “Downside is cushioned by the SGD0.04 dividend per share commitment providing circa 6-percent yield support, and eventual recovery potential as RWS2.0 assets mature, though timing remains uncertain.” The analysts highlighted that VIP rolling market share at Resorts World Sentosa “dropped to an all-time low of 20 percent,” versus the property’s rival in the Singapore duopoly, Marina Bay Sands, run by a unit of Las Vegas Sands Corp. “Genting Singapore’s first-quarter adjusted EBITDA was a significant miss, accounting for 18 percent and 19 percent of our previous and Bloomberg consensus estimates for full-year 2026, respectively,” the Nomura team added.

author: Johnchew123
body: ongoing information technology infrastructure modernisation, higher marketing and promotion expenses, “pre-opening costs for new activations, phased asset refresh and hotel renovations continuing through 2026, and enterprise integration investments”. The institution stated it was lowering its full-year 2026 EBITDA estimates by 26 percent, to about SGD759 million, and its net income estimates by 36 percent, to circa SGD356 million. It also expected consensus estimates to be “revised lower materially to reflect the weaker operating trends and higher cost base”. Maybank said – citing management commentary – that “transformation costs” at Resorts World Sentosa were likely “to remain elevated through 2026”. Its analyst Samuel Yin Shao Yang stated, referring to upward pressure on global costs for oil: “Genting Singapore is also wary that the continuing conflict in the Middle East has driven up costs.” “At the same time, higher airfares are weighing on travel demand and softening consumer sentiment,” Mr Yin added.

body: Look at Robert Kuok’s journey: sugar → plantations → hotels → cooking oil → property, and eventually a highly diversified business empire spanning multiple industries. LKT's journey is also becoming increasingly diversified: hospitality → plantations → crude oil → property → life sciences, with interests extending across various sectors. The starting points may be different, but the underlying philosophy looks surprisingly similar — build a strong core business, accumulate assets and reinvest and diversify into new industries. This is why we shouldn't look at LKT simply as a “casino/hospitality businessman.” Gent business interests have been evolving over decades, just as Robert Kuok’s empire evolved far beyond its original sugar business. The real question is not what the business looks like today, but what the business could become 5 - 10 years or even 20 years from now.

author: AngTayKor
body: With 3,900 slots generating US$30m weekly GGR and 400 live tables generating US$15m weekly GGR, RWNYC's Q1 2027 could have a very high EBITDA run rate even though hotel/dining capacity remains limited. I'll use the tax rates we've been using: Slots: 56% tax Tables: 30% tax 1. Net gaming revenue after gaming tax Slots US$30m × 44% = US$13.2m/week Tables US$15m × 70% = US$10.5m/week So total after gaming tax: US$23.7m/week Over 13 weeks: US$308.1m net gaming revenue 2. Operating cost This is where the difference between slots and tables becomes important. Slots require relatively little incremental labour. Tables require dealers, supervisors, surveillance, pit personnel, cage operations, etc. I'd model approximately: Weekly net revenue EBITDA margin Weekly EBITDA Slots $13.2m 75–80% $9.9–10.6m Tables $10.5m 45–55% $4.7–5.8m Total $23.7m $14.6–16.4m That produces approximately: Q1 2027 EBITDA: US$190–213m I'd put my central estimate around US$200m EBITDA for the 90-day period. Why this could be particularly powerful The mix is actually quite favourable. The slots are generating: $30m GGR → $13.2m after tax → ~US$10m EBITDA/week while tables: $15m GGR → $10.5m after tax → ~US$5.2m EBITDA/week So despite tables producing half the GGR, they could contribute roughly half the EBITDA because of their much higher post-tax revenue but substantially higher labour cost. And this is before giving much credit to hotel, F&B, entertainment, parking, etc. Because RWNYC currently has relatively limited hotel rooms and ancillary offerings, I would not aggressively add non-gaming EBITDA. Perhaps another US$5–15m for the quarter once those businesses are included. My Q1 2027 estimate If your assumptions actually materialise: RWNYC Q1 2027 EBITDA: ~US$195–220m Best estimate: ~US$205m. That would imply an annualised EBITDA run rate of roughly US$820m.

body: We must understand the logic behind the downtrend from ~RM5(2024) to ~RM2(2026): 1) Genting business not growing much, but had since taken more debt to do expansion in RWNYC, RWLV, and take GenM private. 2) This leads to dividend cut to preserve cash. Dividend funds don't like it and sell. 3) Debt over Equity is high. Credit ratings company don't like it and downgraded GB ratings. Further sell off by funds who can only invest in companies with higher rating. Now, what's going to happen in 2026-2027: 1) RWNYC has ramped up faster than expected. Table games GGR has exceeded expectations past few weeks. It has become the highest grossing casino in USA now. RWLV has also recovered and made RM200M ebitda last quarter. Las Vegas Convention centre has brought in many business travelers to RWLV after it has completed the upgrade end of last year. Next year, GB can bundle RWLV and RWNYC together and seek listing in the USA. Proceeds from the listing can immediately pare down the debt of GB. 2) There after, GB has superb free cash flow to pay high dividends again. Dividend funds will subsequently come in and share price will go up. 3) With much lower debt/equity, credit rating companies will upgrade GB. More funds are allowed to purchase GB stock, and share price will lift up further. We don't need to see Feng shui lao to understand this, just some basic business knowledge is enough to see what's in the pipeline.

author: EngineeringProfit
body: Genting's collapse from the RM5 region is arguably a balance-sheet and capital-allocation story rather than simply a deterioration of its underlying franchises. The company has deliberately loaded itself with major investments—most importantly the increased ownership of GenM and the enormous RWNYC development—while RWLV has been working through its ramp-up and regulatory issues. This suppresses near-term free cash flow and dividend capacity precisely when investors are most sensitive to leverage. The potential inflection point is 2026–27: if RWNYC develops into a high-EBITDA casino, RWLV continues its recovery and RWS improves, Genting could move from a capital-hungry expansion phase into a cash-generation and deleveraging phase. Falling net debt could then restore dividend capacity, improve credit-rating outlook and trigger a valuation rerating. The key investment question is therefore not whether Genting has good assets—it clearly does—but whether those assets can generate enough incremental FCF to overcome the enormous capital requirements before shareholders become impatient.

author: Johnchew123
body: Genting Singapore (SGX: G13 ) has reported net profit after tax of $156 million for 1HFY2026 ended June 30, plunged by 34% y-o-y. Genting Singapore explains that the lower bottom line was due to higher depreciation, lower interest income and asset refresh works. Revenue in the same period was down marginally by 1% y-o-y to $1.2 billion. The lower revenue was mainly due to lower gaming revenue while partially offset by higher non-gaming revenue. Gaming revenue stood at $804.4 million, 4% lower y-o-y while non-gaming revenue rose 6% y-o-y to $398.8 million, supported by refreshed attractions, hospitality and experiential offerings. As at June 30, Genting Singapore held cash and cash equivalent worth $2.9 billion on its balance sheet. In conjunction with the results, Genting Singapore’s board of directors has declared an interim dividend of 2 cents per share. Meanwhile, Genting Singapore shares that the RWS 2.0 remains on track for completion in 2030, in tandem with the government’s timeline to enhance connectivity and overall offerings under the Greater Sentosa Master Plan.

author: Johnchew123
body: Casino operator Genting Singapore Ltd posted first-half net profit attributable to shareholders of nearly SGD156.1 million (US$121.9 million), down 33.5 percent from the prior-year period. Aggregate revenue for the first six months of 2026 stood at about SGD1.20 billion, down 0.9 percent from a year earlier, according to a Thursday announcement. Genting Singapore is the operator of Resorts World Sentosa (pictured), one of Singapore’s two casino resorts. The firm is a subsidiary of Malaysian conglomerate Genting Bhd. The company proposed a one-tier, tax-exempt interim dividend of SGD0.02 per ordinary share, the same amount as a year ago. The dividend is due to be paid on September 22. First-half adjusted earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation, and amortisation (EBITDA) fell by 8.0 percent year-on-year, to SGD389.7 million. Genting Singapore’s gaming revenue in the six months to June 30 was SGD804.4 million, 4.2-percent lower than in the prior-year period. As of June 30, the group’s trade receivables amounted to SGD614.7 million, the majority of which related to casino debtors. It compared with an amount of SGD591.3 million a year earlier.

author: moonlightsonata
body: Revenue Declined 3% Despite Significant External Headwinds Q1 revenue stood at 607,435, compared with 585,503 in Q2, representing a 3.6% decline. This was achieved despite challenging external conditions, including the Middle East crisis and the FIFA World Cup, which created additional pressure on international tourism and consumer spending. Operating Efficiency Improved Impressively Despite the decline in revenue, profitability improved significantly Q1 EBITDA: 174,447 — 28.7% EBITDA margin Q2 EBITDA: 208,797 — 35.7% EBITDA margin Q1 Adjusted EBITDA: 178,951 — 29.5% adjusted EBITDA margin Q2 Adjusted EBITDA: 210,812 — 36.0% adjusted EBITDA margin This represents a major improvement in operating efficiency, with adjusted EBITDA margin expanding by approximately 6.5 percentage points from Q1 to Q2. Contrast with Marina Bay Sands In comparison, Marina Bay Sands experienced a 10% decline in revenue, while its EBITDA margin fell from approximately 53% to 49%. The contrast is significant: while revenue declined, the business demonstrated much stronger margin resilience and operating efficiency, with EBITDA margins expanding rather than contracting. The key takeaway is not simply that revenue fell it is that profitability improved substantially despite lower revenue and a challenging operating environment.

author: i3ronda
body: Gent is actually in a much healthier financial position than the headline debt figure suggests. Gent reported RM1.826 billion of adjusted EBITDA in 1Q 2026. If we simply annualise that figure, it would be around RM7.3 billion of EBITDA per year. Yes, Gent has around RM43 billion of debt, but it also has substantial cash and, more importantly, a business that generates billions in recurring EBITDA every year. EBITDA is not the same as free cash flow, so we shouldn’t assume the entire RM7.3 billion can go directly toward debt repayment. However, it clearly demonstrates that Genting has strong earnings and cash-generation capacity to service its debt and gradually deleverage. As major capex projects move past their peak spending phases, more of that operating cash flow can potentially translate into free cash flow and debt reduction. So we shouldn't simply look at it as “RM43 billion debt versus RM17 billion cash” and conclude that Genting is heavily stretched. We should also consider its RM7 billion+ annualised EBITDA, recurring cash generation and substantial asset base. The debt is certainly large, but Genting is far from being in a distressed financial position. Its earnings power gives it a meaningful capacity to service and gradually reduce the debt. If EBITDA remains at a healthy level and capex requirements moderate, deleveraging could become increasingly visible over the next few years. In short, the debt number may look intimidating at first glance, but when you look at Genting’s earnings power, cash generation and asset base, the group is actually in a much healthier financial position than the headline debt figure suggests.

author: i3ronda
body: * Bursa Malaysia has officially backed the proposal to expand the FBM KLCI from 30 → 50 constituents. This was reported on 30 July 2026. * The current 30 stocks cover around 59% of Main Market market capitalisation. Expanding to 50 would raise coverage to about 70%. * The biggest objective is to reduce the heavy concentration in banks/financials. Financials currently make up roughly 43% of KLCI; under the proposed 50-stock version, this could fall to the mid-30% range. * More sectors such as technology, energy, industrials, property/REITs and healthcare would receive greater representation. * There is also a proposal for a 10% maximum weighting for any single company. * The consultation has already taken place. If approved, implementation is proposed for either 21 December 2026 or 21 June 2027.

author: i3ronda
body: 16岁丧父失学、19岁南来当木匠，林梧桐47岁押上全部积蓄开山，3年筑出25公里云顶路，功成后设基金扶助病老与清寒学生 1965年8月，47岁的林梧桐站在乌鲁加里山脚，准备修一条通往海拔约1800公尺高原的道路。 眼前没有饭店，没有缆车，更没有后来灯火通明的云顶娱乐城；只有热带雨林、陡峭山势，以及一个让许多朋友摇头的计画。 那时的林梧桐已经不穷了。 他做过机械买卖、采矿与工程承包，盖过水坝、桥梁和灌溉设施，早已从当年的外来木匠变成颇有实力的承包商。即使就此停下，他也能过上富足安稳的生活。 他却把多年攒下的资金投进一座尚未产生收入的荒山，还出售橡胶园筹措约250万令吉。别人不愿加入，他便自己承担；别人认为山路难以完成，他就带著工程人员一段段往上开。 后来的人容易把这段历史写成“富豪眼光精准”，仿佛他只是提早看见一门必然赚钱的生意。但在最初几年里，没有任何结果保证他的判断正确，山上每推进一公里，花掉的都是他已经赚到手、原本可以留下来的财富。 林梧桐敢押上这一切，或许因为他很早就知道，人生并不存在真正稳妥的起点。

author: bearsong
body: How Index Inclusion Directly Drives Share Prices When a stock like Genting Berhad (GENT) or Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) joins a benchmark index, the resulting price action typically unfolds across three distinct phases: Phase 1: Pre-Inclusion Announcement ("Front-Running" & Position Building) What happens: Institutional fund managers and arbitrage traders anticipate index changes months before implementation. Impact on Share Price: Active funds start buying the stock early to get ahead of the mandatory index funds. This creates upward price pressure leading up to the official announcement and rebalancing date. Phase 2: Implementation Date (Forced Passive Buying) What happens: On the effective date (e.g., 21 December 2026 or 21 June 2027), every Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) and passive institutional fund tracking the expanded FBM 50 must execute market orders to match the exact index weighting. Impact on Share Price: This triggers a concentrated surge in trading volume. For large mid-caps like Genting, this structural demand provides strong price support on the day of rebalancing. Phase 3: Post-Inclusion Dynamics (Long-Term Structural Benefits) Expanded Foreign Capital Coverage: International institutional investors (such as BlackRock, Vanguard, and global sovereign funds) often restrict investments to a country’s flagship benchmark index. Re-entering the top index opens up a wider pool of foreign capital. Higher Liquidity Premium: Daily trading volume (liquidity) permanently increases. Stocks with higher liquidity generally command better valuation multiples (Price-to-Earnings ratios) compared to illiquid mid-cap stocks.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: 今天大约 5pm 到 GenS 做 onsite inspection。 之前几次来，停车场经常有 超过 60% 空位，总让我想起 2005 年去 Intel Penang。那么大的 car park，也是空荡荡的。 也许七、八十年代为了吸引 Intel 来投资，政府给了很大的土地弹性，让 Intel 自己规划，要多大就划多大。现在回头看，确实有点可惜。 Genting 不同，car park 是建在 building 里面，不会占用那么多宝贵的土地。 不过今天明显好一些，停车场大约 60% occupied。 5pm 在 casino entrance 看了 15 分钟，还是 sibet jialat，小猫两三只 nia 😂。 到了 6pm 左右，人流开始增加，餐厅也陆续坐满，比几个月前明显热闹。 当然，一次现场观察不能代表整体业绩，但至少感觉： RWS 人流似乎正在慢慢回来。 不过到了 8:30pm，我又回到 casino entrance 看了 5 分钟，结果还是sibet jialat，小猫两三只 nia 😂。 所以今天的观察也挺有意思：餐饮人气不错，但 casino 主入口的人流，还是偏冷清。

body: 我通常也会顺道去看看其他旅游景点，今天走了一圈，发现到处都是人山人海。 原来这三个星期耒 Sentosa 正在举办 Sentosa Grill 。Fest 😋，明天就是最后一天，难怪整個 Sentosa 都那么热闹。 沿途的美食摊位生意兴隆，坐无虚席，人气真的很旺。 这样一比较，Genting 的现场人流就显得有点尴尬了，一个热闹、一个冷清。 当然，GrillFest 是特别活动，不能完全拿来比较。 但问题还是值得想一想：同样是在 Sentosa，为什么其他地方人潮不断，Genting 却显得那么冷清？ RWS 2.0 要做到 2030 年，看来还有一段很长的路要走。

author: Ka Keat
body: Reporting a net loss driven by ramp-up expenses and interest costs does not matter for GENM's core investment thesis, provided operating cash flow remains intact. In fact, this exact dynamic played out in 1Q26 when GENM reported a small net loss of RM25.2 million ($6.4M) despite revenue growing 10% to RM2.87 billion, purely because finance costs jumped 34% (to RM246.7 million) alongside pre-operating costs for the NY launch. If Q2 or Q3 repeat this accounting loss, savvy institutional investors will look right past it for four key reasons:

author: Ka Keat
body: 1. Distinction Between "Cost Burden" and "Structural Inefficiency" Temporary Ramp-Up Costs: Upfront dealer training, new employee onboarding (adding 1,250 staff), and launch marketing are one-off or temporary operational friction points. They peak during the first 6–12 months and decline as the labor force becomes proficient. Accounting Interest vs. Operational Yield: Debt service is fixed (~$74M USD/year on the $925M property facility). As the 242 live tables and 3,920 slots ramp up toward full capacity, revenue grows dynamically while interest costs remain flat. This causes operating leverage to take over and expand margins.

author: Ka Keat
body: 2. The EBITDA-to-Interest Safety Cushion The primary metric credit agencies and banks monitor during a capex ramp is the Interest Coverage Ratio (EBITDA÷Interest Expense): Group Baseline: GENM generates over RM2.6B–RM3.0B in Group EBITDA annually, against total group finance costs of ~RM800M–RM900M (~3.0x coverage). RWNYC Standalone: As weekly table run-rates hit ~$9.8M+ in Q3, RWNYC generates ~$280M+ USD (~RM1.26B) in annual property EBITDA, which covers its own property debt interest (~$74M USD) nearly 3.8 times over. Even if high non-cash depreciation and interest wipe out bottom-line Net Profit (NPAT), the cash generated is more than enough to service the debt comfortably.

author: Ka Keat
body: 3. Historical Precedent in Gaming Megaprojects Every major integrated resort expansion follows this identical "J-Curve" pattern: Construction & Launch: Debt hits balance sheet → Interest & pre-opening expenses peak → Headline Net Loss reported. Floor Stabilization (6–18 months): Revenue scales → Operating EBITDA expands rapidly. Deleveraging Phase: Excess cash flow repays principal debt → Interest costs drop → Net Profit explodes upward. (This same accounting drag occurred during the early launch phases of Resorts World Sentosa and City of Dreams Manila before both turned into massive cash machines).

author: Ka Keat
body: Key Takeaway for Investors A net loss caused by interest and ramp-up costs is simply the accounting price of growth. The red flags to watch for are not headline net losses, but rather: Drop in weekly GGR or table hold rates below baseline expectations. Failure of Resorts World Genting in Malaysia to maintain its RM2.0B+ annual EBITDA base. If GGR and EBITDA continue scaling upward, the accounting loss will naturally disappear as the asset matures.

author: Ka Keat
body: Post-2029, when the full Integrated Resort (IR) expansion is complete (6,000 slots, 800 live tables, hotel towers, convention space, and arena), Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) is projected to generate $310 Million to $360 Million USD (~RM 1.38 Billion to RM 1.60 Billion) in standalone Free Cash Flow (FCF) annually. What Does This FCF Mean for Genting Malaysia (GENM)? Dividend Support: $350M USD in annual FCF equates to ~RM 1.56 Billion in parent-level cash inflow. This provides steady dividend coverage (~15–18 sen per share potential) for GENM shareholders. Competitor Buffer (Hard Rock Opening): Even if Hard Rock at Willets Point opens in 2030 and trims RWNYC's EBITDA down by 5%–10% (~$540M EBITDA), standalone FCF will remain above $310M USD (~RM 1.38 Billion) per year, keeping the asset highly profitable.

author: Ka Keat
body: Key Context Incremental vs. Total Dividend: This 15–18 sen represents the dividend capacity supported specifically by RWNYC's post-2029 standalone cash flow. Combined Group Dividend Potential: Adding this to Resorts World Genting's (Malaysia) baseline dividend capacity (~10–12 sen per share) implies GENM could theoretically support total group annual dividends of 25 to 30 sen per share once RWNYC debt is amortized post-2029.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: After reading Ka Keat's report, I see the GENM story a little differently now. The key for me is not whether GENM reports a small loss in 2Q26. I'm looking at the whole chain: 242 tables → GGR/table → ~US$30m weekly GGR → EBITDA → FCF → debt reduction → dividend. At the moment, the revenue engine looks encouraging. RWNYC is sustaining around US$30m weekly GGR, and table utilisation is already high. The missing piece is EBITDA. If the US$30m+ weekly GGR starts translating into meaningful and growing EBITDA, then the current accounting losses become much less concerning. So after reading the report, my focus has shifted from “Will GENM make a profit in 2Q?” to: “Is RWNYC's revenue now strong enough to drive EBITDA and eventually free cash flow?” If the answer is yes, then the longer-term story of FCF → debt reduction → higher dividend becomes much more credible. That's the part I will be watching closely in the 2Q results. The current situation is actually quite interesting because we are somewhere in the middle of that pipeline. 1. 242 tables → GGR per table Current status: 🟢 Good RWNYC is operating essentially all of its current 242-table capacity. So the question is no longer whether it can fill the tables, but how much each table generates. Using the reported data, table GGR has been around the level that translates to roughly US$5,000–6,000 per table per day in the stronger weeks. What we want: US$6,000 → US$7,000 → US$8,000 If that happens, RWNYC can grow without needing to add many more tables. --- 2. GGR per table → Total GGR Current status: 🟢 Encouraging RWNYC's total weekly GGR has been around US$30m, which annualises to roughly: US$30m × 52 = US$1.56b GGR That's a meaningful revenue base. The important thing is that we are seeing sustained GGR rather than a one-week launch spike. --- 3. Total GGR → EBITDA Current status: 🟡 This is the big question This is where I would be most careful. US$30m GGR does not mean US$30m profit. New York takes substantial gaming tax, and RWNYC still has payroll, marketing, utilities, security and other operating costs. GENM's 1Q26 results showed the problem clearly: group revenue increased 10% to RM2.87b, but adjusted EBITDA fell 13% to RM644.7m because of higher operating/payroll costs and the RWNYC transition. So now we need to see: US$30m GGR → meaningful RWNYC EBITDA That hasn't been fully demonstrated yet. --- 4. EBITDA → Cash flow Current status: 🟡 Not proven Once EBITDA improves, we then need to subtract: >> Interest >> Taxes >> Maintenance capex >> Other cash expenses What remains is free cash flow. This is what ultimately matters for GENM's balance sheet. --- 5. Cash flow → GENM net profit Current status: 🟡 Still under pressure GENM reported a RM25.2m net loss in 1Q26, despite RM2.87b revenue. Finance costs and RWNYC pre-opening expenses were major factors. So I would not yet say the RWNYC GGR has translated into meaningful GENM net profit. That's the next stage we want to see. --- 6. Net profit → Debt reduction Current status: 🟡 Future catalyst If RWNYC starts generating significant FCF, GENM can use that cash to: pay interest → repay debt → reduce finance costs This is powerful because lower debt eventually means lower interest expense, allowing even more of the operating profit to reach the bottom line. --- 7. Debt reduction → Dividend Current status: 🟡 Long-term potential This is where your original dividend thesis comes in. The ideal sequence is: RWNYC GGR 🟢 ↓ EBITDA 🟡 → 🟢 ↓ FCF 🟡 → 🟢 ↓ Debt reduction 🟡 → 🟢 ↓ Net profit 🟡 → 🟢 ↓ Dividend capacity increases 🟢 My overall scorecard today Stage Current status 242 tables utilised 🟢 Good GGR/table 🟢 Encouraging ~US$30m weekly GGR 🟢 Good RWNYC EBITDA 🟡 Need confirmation FCF 🟡 Need confirmation GENM net profit 🟡 Still weak Debt reduction 🟡 Not yet the main story Higher dividend 🟡 Longer-term So we are not yet at cash machine → dividend. We're currently at: The revenue engine appears to be working. Now prove that the revenue can be converted into EBITDA and free cash flow. And that is why GENM's 2Q26 results are particularly important. GENM's latest official investor-relations page still lists only the 1Q26 report for 2026, so I would not treat any 2Q number as confirmed until GENM releases it. For me, the single most important transition to watch is: US$30m/week GGR → rising EBITDA If we see that, the rest of the chain becomes much more credible.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: How should we interpret RWNYC's US$6,000 → US$7,000 → US$8,000 target? It's not unreasonable, but.. Think of it this way: Table/ productivity Interpretation US$3,000/day Weak US$4,000–5,000 Improving US$6,000 Good US$7,000 Very good US$8,000+ Strong US$10,000+ Excellent / premium-market territory RWNYC's current roughly US$5,000–6,000/table/day therefore looks respectable for an early-stage operation, particularly because it is still ramping up.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: And this is what I would watch for GENM If RWNYC can move: ~US$5,000 → US$6,000 → US$7,000/table/day while keeping 242 tables fully utilised, that's a very positive operating signal. For example: 242 × US$6,000 × 365 = US$530m annual table GGR At US$7,000: 242 × US$7,000 × 365 = US$619m At US$8,000: 242 × US$8,000 × 365 = US$707m So moving from US$6k to US$8k would add roughly US$177m of annual table GGR without adding another table. That's exactly what operating leverage means.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: And then, if the future expansion increases the table count from 242 toward the planned larger capacity, you potentially get both productivity growth and capacity growth. For GENM, that is the number I would like to see: 242 tables × rising GGR/table/day → rising RWNYC EBITDA → rising FCF → lower debt → eventually higher dividends. So yes — US$6k is already encouraging; US$7k would make me more confident; US$8k would be a very strong signal.

author: Michaelchan2024
body: I would use a 10 point dashboard. GENM / RWNYC dashboard What to watch/ Current view/ Why it matters 1. Weekly RWNYC GGR 🟢 ~US$30m Revenue engine 2. GGR/table/day 🟢 Improving Measures table productivity 3. Slot/ETG GGR 🟢 Important Major part of RWNYC revenue 4. RWNYC EBITDA 🟡 Critical Shows whether GGR becomes operating profit 5. GENM Group EBITDA 🟡 Confirms improvement reaches the group 6. Operating cash flow 🟡 More important than accounting profit for debt 7. Finance costs 🔴 Watch closely High interest can eat up profit 8. Net debt / leverage 🟡 Shows whether cash is actually reducing debt 9. Resorts World Genting EBITDA 🟢/🟡 Malaysia remains the earnings/cash-flow base 10. NPAT & dividend 🟡 The final outcome for shareholders Two additional things I would watch 11. RWNYC ramp-up costs Look for whether payroll, marketing and pre-opening expenses are falling as a percentage of revenue. That's the evidence that the J-curve is working. 12. Future expansion economics Don't just look at the planned 800 tables / 6,000 slots. The question is: > Will the additional capacity generate attractive returns on the additional capital invested? If the existing 242 tables are already producing strong GGR/table/day, expanding capacity becomes much more attractive. --- The most important 5 for me If I had to simplify everything, I would monitor only: ① Weekly GGR → Is RWNYC maintaining US$30m+? ② GGR/table/day → Is productivity moving toward US$6k → US$7k → US$8k? ③ EBITDA → Is GGR actually becoming profit? ④ Free cash flow + debt → Is RWNYC generating cash and reducing leverage? ⑤ Dividend → Is the improved cash flow eventually reaching shareholders? So the story becomes: > GGR → Productivity → EBITDA → FCF → Debt reduction → NPAT → Dividend And I would add one very important ...don't forget: > Resorts World Genting must continue to perform. GENM doesn't have to rely entirely on RWNYC. If RW Genting maintains its EBITDA base while RWNYC ramps up, the overall GENM investment thesis becomes much stronger. That's the combination I would want to see: Malaysia remains the cash-flow anchor, while New York becomes the growth engine.

author: AngTayKor
body: With 3,900 slots generating US$30m weekly GGR and 400 live tables generating US$15m weekly GGR, RWNYC's Q1 2027 could have a very high EBITDA run rate even though hotel/dining capacity remains limited. I'll use the tax rates we've been using: Slots: 56% tax Tables: 30% tax 1. Net gaming revenue after gaming tax Slots US$30m × 44% = US$13.2m/week Tables US$15m × 70% = US$10.5m/week So total after gaming tax: US$23.7m/week Over 13 weeks: US$308.1m net gaming revenue 2. Operating cost This is where the difference between slots and tables becomes important. Slots require relatively little incremental labour. Tables require dealers, supervisors, surveillance, pit personnel, cage operations, etc. I'd model approximately: Weekly net revenue EBITDA margin Weekly EBITDA Slots $13.2m 75–80% $9.9–10.6m Tables $10.5m 45–55% $4.7–5.8m Total $23.7m $14.6–16.4m That produces approximately: Q1 2027 EBITDA: US$190–213m I'd put my central estimate around US$200m EBITDA for the 90-day period. Why this could be particularly powerful The mix is actually quite favourable. The slots are generating: $30m GGR → $13.2m after tax → ~US$10m EBITDA/week while tables: $15m GGR → $10.5m after tax → ~US$5.2m EBITDA/week So despite tables producing half the GGR, they could contribute roughly half the EBITDA because of their much higher post-tax revenue but substantially higher labour cost. And this is before giving much credit to hotel, F&B, entertainment, parking, etc. Because RWNYC currently has relatively limited hotel rooms and ancillary offerings, I would not aggressively add non-gaming EBITDA. Perhaps another US$5–15m for the quarter once those businesses are included. My Q1 2027 estimate If your assumptions actually materialise: RWNYC Q1 2027 EBITDA: ~US$195–220m Best estimate: ~US$205m. That would imply an annualised EBITDA run rate of roughly US$820m.
